videos.overview: Nedumaran meets Chidambaram aka Chika, who wins hearts with his cooking. Ragupathi nominates him for a Star Chef competition. Upset, Nedumaran decides to cook for a hunting party.

videos.title: Web of Deceptions
videos.overview: Nedumaran reports illegal hunting and leaves Chika alone in the forest. Chika gets arrested. At the resort, Nedumaran spins a tale about Chika’s missing, all for a Star Chef award.

videos.title: Hidden Feelings
videos.overview: Vetri is heartbroken to see Aishu’s ex-boyfriend. A complaint about a pantry dish has Nedumaran fuming. Rajan admits his feelings to Riya. Vetri is thrilled as Aishu lifts the ban.

videos.title: Old Flame
videos.overview: Nedumaran complains to Ragupathi about the pantry. Aishu and Selvin catch up after ages. Veni spies on Priya. Ramya confides in Aishu about Vetri while Ragupathi collapses in pain.

videos.title: Stricken Ragupathi
videos.overview: Priya becomes cautious when Veni and Vetri visit her house. Ragupathi is hospitalised and Nedumaran assumes that he will be taking over the resort in his absence.

videos.title: Who is the Alpha?
videos.overview: Nedumaran stops Rajan's staff meeting and lets everyone know who the boss is. Aishu is selected for the Star Chef event. Vetri is shocked as Nedumaran replaces the pantry staff.

videos.title: Rebuffed
videos.overview: Veni scolds Vicky for being rude to Vetri. Nedumaran insults Vetri for questioning about the pantry. Ragupathi tells Rajan to take charge of the resort. Ramya proposes to Vetri.

videos.title: The Next CEO!
videos.overview: Nedumaran takes complete control of the resort, and everyone worries as word spreads that he'll be the next CEO. Ragupathi recovers and immediately calls for an investor's meeting.

videos.title: Bittersweet Departure
videos.overview: RR Resort is in chaos after Nedumaran walks out with his team. Rajan handles the situation calmly. Aishu bids farewell to Vetri. Nedumaran leaves the Kitchen with bitter emotion.

videos.title: Seizing the Day
videos.overview: Vicky exploits the situation at the resort. Vetri asks Riya to help him join the Kitchen team. While admitted in the hospital, Vetri’s mother reveals the truth about his father.

videos.title: Strengthening Ties
videos.overview: Rajan confidently meets the resort's investors and explains his future plans. Since Vicky struggles to run the Kitchen with reduced staff, Riya and Rajan offer him a solution.

videos.title: Nedumaran's Minion
videos.overview: Vetri asks for help from Veni and others for the Star Chef competition and goes in search of a former winner. As Nedumaran trains Aishu, he brews a sinister plan for the resort.

videos.title: Durai, the Savior ?
videos.overview: Rajan entrusts Vicky with arranging dinner for the investors. Nedumaran plots to take over RR Resort with Luther's help. Vetri waits desperately for Durai, but will he help him?

videos.title: Persistant Chef
videos.overview: Nedumaran trains Aishu for the competition at home. A stressed Aishu meets Selvin, but she cannot get Vetri out of her mind. Hearing his struggles, Durai agrees to help Vetri.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Durai sets to train Vetri if he passes three tests. Vicky informs Nedumaran about Vetri’s move. He tells Vetri he will run the kitchen during the training. Vetri clears two tests.

videos.title: The Dead Kitchen
videos.overview: Vetri clears Durai's tough task with ease, and he promises to train him. Ragupathi, Riya and Rajan feel betrayed as Vicky executes his plan and shows his colours to the investors.

videos.title: Ragupathi's Reassurance
videos.overview: The situation at the resort worsens when board members pull back. When the employees begin to fear for their jobs, Ragupathi calls for a staff meeting.

videos.title: Dark Grief
videos.overview: Durai sees Chidambaram in Vetri and tells him about how he knew his father and his tragic past. When Veni calls Aishu to vent her frustration, the latter learns a startling truth.

videos.title: Good Luck
videos.overview: Just when Vetri completes his training, he gets a call from his sister that his mother is hospitalised. On the day of the competition, Nedumaran warns the organiser about Vetri.

videos.title: The Champion Returns
videos.overview: When Vetri goes to register for the competition, they question the legitimacy of Durai's signature. However, all hope is not lost.

videos.title: Chef's Culinary Clash Begins
videos.overview: Durai wishes Vetri and leaves. Aishu confronts Selvin for hiding about partaking in the competition. Nedumaran briefs Aishu. Meanwhile, will Vetri be able to handle the rounds?

videos.title: Memory of a Father
videos.overview: Vetri freezes before the first round. Later, he recalls his childhood memories with his father and that inspires him to make his first dish of the competition.

videos.title: The Sous Chefs
videos.overview: In the new round, Veni becomes Vetri's sous chef and Vicky becomes Aishu's. Veni's presence distracts Vicky, who misses her a lot.

videos.title: A Friend in Need
videos.overview: Selvin wins an advantage and chooses a toughest ingredient to break his opponents. Durai's training helps Vetri, but he uses his time to help Aishu. Selvin’s query confuses Vetri.

videos.title: A Helpless Son
videos.overview: Aishu asks Nedumaran why he's so hell-bent on her winning the competition. Just before the finals, Vetri receives a devastating call from his sister about his mother's condition.

videos.title: The Final Dish
videos.overview: While Vetri stands still, feeling helpless, a timely help from a benefactor saves the day. However, when Vetri presents his final dish, the judges get upset with his presentation.

videos.title: The Star Chef Rises
videos.overview: The judges and viewers are moved after Vetri shares the concept behind his dish. Once the competition ends, Aishu tells her father her wish.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Everyone awaits the arrival of their new CEO at RR Resort, but their identity shocks them. Vetri settles his debts and returns to the resort, but his choice surprises Ragupathi.

_verifiedMetadata.name: D/O Prasad Rao: Kanabadutaledu
_verifiedMetadata.description: A father desperately searches for his missing daughter, uncovering hidden secrets and betrayals along the way. The investigation tests family bonds while revealing dark truths beneath seemingly normal lives.

videos.title: A Father's Worst Nightmare
videos.overview: Prasad Rao reluctantly allows his daughter, Swati, to shift to Hyderabad for work. He returns home after helping her with shifting. Later, he is forced to travel to Hyderabad when Swati goes missing.

videos.title: The Truth That Broke Me
videos.overview: Swati's disappearance reaches the media, forcing the police to get involved. Officer Revika Joseph and Prasad Rao discover Swati’s body, but Prasad Rao’s knowledge of her location raises questions.

videos.title: The Silence After Her Last Breath
videos.overview: The news about Swati’s death and Prasad’s health reaches their hometown and also makes national headlines. Meanwhile, Officer Revika finds a lead about Swati’s whereabouts on the day of her death.

videos.title: A Room Full Of Secrets
videos.overview: Revika interrogates Swati’s roommates and searches her phone. While the clues lead her to a potential suspect and a shocking discovery, she decides to keep the details of the case away from the media.

videos.title: The Case With No Crime
videos.overview: Prasad Rao regains consciousness but cannot remember Swati’s death, shocking the family. Revika tracks down the suspect and interrogates him, while Swati’s postmortem reports flip the investigation.

videos.title: A Father's Justice
videos.overview: Prasad Rao collapses in the mortuary. The postmortem reports lead Revika to close the case. Later, investigating a couple of deaths in Swathi’s hometown brings Revika in front of Prasad Rao again.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
_verifiedMetadata.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Ee Puzhayum Kadannu
_verifiedMetadata.description: Tragedy befalls a happy meddle-Class family after their father Aravindan's sudden demise. Now his daughters must find hope while overcoming the conflicts in life

_verifiedMetadata.name: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket
_verifiedMetadata.description: A washed-up PT teacher, a legendary coach and a generation of misfit students come together to save a legacy.

videos.title: First Innings
videos.overview: Rangan, once a celebrated cricket hero, is now working as a PT instructor. Rukmani, the head of MNCA, hopes that new batch of players will help restore the academy’s legacy.

videos.title: Campus Oath
videos.overview: The juniors take a tour of the academy. Coach Natraj warns to adhere to discipline when the boys’ team returns from a disqualified match. Hostel nights reveal ragging antics.

videos.title: Morning Runs
videos.overview: Coaches Natraj and Selvam test the players' diving skills and patience after they face Rukmani’s fury for being late. Rukmani battles threats that could shut the academy forever.

videos.title: Ghost Practice
videos.overview: Falling for the seniors’ ghost tale, the juniors dare each other to pre-dawn practice. Rishi impresses at the nets, making Velu jealous. Mani, Thangam and Theo’s bond gets strong.

videos.title: Dream Wakeup
videos.overview: Rukmani faces the MNCA’s sponsors who warn about Matheyan’s uncontrolled anger. A fight in the canteen creates cracks between the juniors and seniors. Mani dreams about Thangam.

videos.title: Footwork and Footwear
videos.overview: Matheyan and Jackie help Mani make a video to impress his dad and get money to buy shoes for Thangam. An astrologer predicts that someone from Rangan’s past will reenter his life.

videos.title: Hidden Torture
videos.overview: Seniors turn training into bullying, masked as combined drills, leaving Veera terrified. Thangam’s breakthrough in bowling is hidden by strong family pressure to get married.

videos.title: Revenge Storm
videos.overview: Veera’s gangster father storms MNCA over ragging, forcing Rukmani into a public apology. Rajasekar’s inspection ends with a brutal shutdown threat, and he now vows revenge.

videos.title: Mani’s Mission
videos.overview: Mani confronts Rukmani about the academy shutting down. Rukmani exposes Rajasekar’s drug expulsion past. Thangam and Rishi worry about their parents’ decision about the academy.

videos.title: Pair Up Pressure
videos.overview: Theo and Matheyan form senior-junior training pairs. Rangan takes Mani to spy on Anchor Cricket Academy’s high-tech facilities. A kitchen disaster brings Rishi and Thangam closer.

videos.title: Hidden Feelings
videos.overview: Rukmani is shaken by Rajasekar’s threats. Preparations for the 50th-year alumni gala begin. Mani hides his feelings for Thangam while Rukmani sets to train young Valli in cricket.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Rangan is shocked to see Thangam’s photo among his marriage proposals. Thangam’s growing discomfort around Rangan leads to accusations and outrage and everyone turns against him.

videos.title: Mistakes and Misfires
videos.overview: Shattered by Rukmani's mistrust, Rangan nearly quits cricket, but his aunt persuades him to return only to face cold stares. Rukmani later apologises for overreacting.

videos.title: Golden Jubilee Begins
videos.overview: As the event unfolds, excitement masks rising tensions. Mani lifts Thangam's spirits. Velu's bid to rejoin the team backfires, leading to a clash that Theo halts.

videos.title: Shadows of the Past
videos.overview: Thulasi's speech revives a painful past tied to Rangan. Shaken by the memories, Rangan retreats. Rukmani finds him and together they step forward to face Thulasi and the truth.

videos.title: Rangan’s Return
videos.overview: Rukmani firmly shuts Rajasekar down. A tense match sees Velu steady the students until Rangan joins and turns it around. The alumni win, but the academy begins to heal.

videos.title: Unspoken Wounds
videos.overview: As alumni celebrate Rangan's return, Thangam seethes in silence. Amid cricket talks with the management, Rangan mentions players now battle inner struggles more than the game.

videos.title: The Weight of the Past
videos.overview: Flashbacks reveal Rangan's fall, a former Ranji captain silenced for opposing injustice. Thulasi introduces a new MNCA scheme. Rangan and Thulasi silently acknowledge their past.

videos.title: Lines of Trust
videos.overview: When allegations arise against Rangan, Thulasi ensures fairness. Thangam bravely reveals her fear came from family pressure, while Rangan maintains a calm demeanour in response.

videos.title: Open Challenge
videos.overview: Thangam defends Rangan, while others oppose him. Thulasi and Rukmani plan to save the academy. A cricket match brings peace until Girish and Matheyan ignite a rivalry.

videos.title: Cracks in Between
videos.overview: Unresolved tension leads to emotional fallout as Mani's jealousy erupts publicly. Meanwhile, Thulasi and Rangan find unexpected comfort in cricket, uncovering past truths.

videos.title: Inner Battle
videos.overview: Thangam tries to reconcile the differences between Rishi and the boys’ team, but they refuse to heed her words. Meanwhile, Rishi contemplates transferring to another school.

videos.title: Unstable Ground
videos.overview: Selvam's dismissal plunges the academy into chaos, with Natraj managing both teams. Meanwhile, Rukmani and Rangan uncover sexism and ego during the replacement search.

videos.title: Crossing the Boundary
videos.overview: What starts as a bold underground match quickly descends into open conflict, leading to chaos and violence. Rangan arrives just in time to prevent history from repeating itself.

videos.title: Anger Beneath Bruises
videos.overview: Girish fails to threaten Rangan. Rishi doubts himself as Girish provokes him. Rangan hides the injured boys from Ms. Rukmani. Jackie blames Rishi, but the juniors defend him.

videos.title: Damage Control
videos.overview: The girls hide the boy's wounds, but tension grows when Rukmani sees Rishi bruised. Rangan protects the team despite suspicion. Away from the academy, Rangan confides in Thulasi.

videos.title: Dreams, Doubts and a Blowback
videos.overview: A counselling session uncovers the dreams of the students as well as Rishi’s feelings. Motivated by Thulasi, Rangan offers support to the students and gains Rukmani’s trust.

videos.title: They Are My Team
videos.overview: Rangan defends his students against misleading police evidence. Theo’s video unveils the truth, yet the damage persists. Natraj storms out in anger, and Rukmini distrusts Rangan.

videos.title: Fault Lines
videos.overview: Rangan officially steps in as the coach, but Padma openly rejects him. Natraj’s harsh words humiliate Mani targeting his friendship with Theo. Mani discovers scars on Rishi’s hand.

videos.title: Pressure Points
videos.overview: Girish faces Rajasekar’s anger over fake evidence. Thulasi encourages Rangan. While Thangam thinks Mani is in love with Theo, Vinay confronts Rukmani over Rishi’s safety.

videos.title: Hidden Battles
videos.overview: Mani fakes illness to escape the academy ground. He learns about Rishi's hidden struggles and his reluctance toward an acting career imposed by his dad. A bond forms between them.

videos.title: Midnight Panic and Confessions
videos.overview: Thangam, Matheyan and others search desperately for Mani as he lies drunk on Rishi’s terrace. Next day, on the ground, Mani explodes, confessing his love for a stunned Thangam.

videos.title: Shifts and Challenges
videos.overview: Mani feels anxious remembering his argument with Thangam. Rishi faces his dad’s pressure to leave cricket. Rangam changes the batting order, facing the wrath of Padma.

videos.title: Voices Under Noise
videos.overview: Theo turns to Matheyan for advice with the girls’ team. At the nets, Rangan’s intense drills test focus and adaptability. Theo calmly guides Padma. Rishi confesses his fear.

videos.title: Silent Drift
videos.overview: Thangam worries about her growing feelings for Mani. Rangan seeks Rukmani’s approval for new players. Rishi confides in her about his dad’s plan. Theo and Matheyan share a moment.

videos.title: One Last Chance
videos.overview: Seeing Valli secretly practicing, Rangan recognises her natural reflexes and determination. Mani pleads with Vinay to give Rishi one chance. Thangam decides to stay away from Mani.

videos.title: Closed Gates
videos.overview: When Rukmani and the principal can't help Rangan to have Valli join the girls’ team, he contacts Thulasi. While Rishi pushes Mani to focus on cricket, the girls doubt Theo’s moves.

videos.title: Unsaid Feelings
videos.overview: Thulasi proposes a scheme to Rangan to legitimise Valli’s entry into the team. Rishi trains Mani. Theo and Matheyan sneak out to celebrate his birthday and confess their feelings.

videos.title: Surface Fractures
videos.overview: During a midnight ride, Theo and Matheyan nearly hit a drunken woman. Later, Rangan introduces Valli to the girls' team, which provokes resistance from most of the team members.

videos.title: Shifting Bonds
videos.overview: Padma suspects Valli manipulated her way onto the team, but Rangan supports her. Later, Rishi guides Mani through each ball in a practice match.

videos.title: Gossip and Revelations
videos.overview: Valli endures harsh mockery regarding her background, which also impacts her father. Although she contemplates quitting, Rangan refuses to allow her to give up.

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: Natraj reveals the final lineup and surprises the boys with a celebratory meal. As unity grows, Matheyan confides in Theo about Natraj’s emotionally charged coaching style.

videos.title: Unsteady Minds
videos.overview: Thangam tells Rangan about Valli's poor practice. Theo and Mani have a disagreement from misunderstandings about their friendship, while Thangam remains unfocused during the match.

videos.title: Choices Left Unspoken
videos.overview: Thangam, confused by her emotions, explores love online and eventually opens up to Theo. Meanwhile, Mani decides the best way to cope with his intense feelings is to bury them.

videos.title: Terrace Party
videos.overview: Mani tells everyone he moved on from love to friendship with Thangam. He tricks everyone, including Varsha, into attending a party by falsely stating that it is Rishi's birthday.

videos.title: Viral Turn
videos.overview: The boys struggle in practice after the party and Nataraj punishes them. To showcase Valli's talent, Rangan records her and posts a social media clip that quickly gains attention.

videos.title: Rising Tensions
videos.overview: News of an NRI-funded fellowship by Dhoorai sparks rivalry in the academy. The girls tease Rangan about Thulasi, while Rukmani hints she knows about them, making Thulasi shy away.

videos.title: Night Unravels
videos.overview: Shaken after the practice match, Rishi battles anxiety triggered by Nataraj. Rangan's first visit to Thulasi's house turns tense during an unexpected talk with her grandfather.

videos.title: Unseen War
videos.overview: Rangan and Thulasi spend time together and she talks about her life with Rajeev. Natraj vows payback after a drunk Rishi attacks his house and hurts him.

videos.title: Silent Pressure
videos.overview: Rajasekar realises the flaw in his academy. While Natraj targets Rishi, Padma’s selfish gameplay creates cracks in the team. Mani meets Thangam’s parents and wins their trust.

videos.title: Sudden Arrival
videos.overview: Rishi is shaken by the harsh realities of class divide between students. Rangan’s bold call on field leaves Padma shaken. Matheyan panics when his mother arrives at the academy.

videos.title: Facing Nightmare
videos.overview: Seeing his drunk mother, Matheyan fears his nightmare may come true. While Theo becomes his anchor, Rangan confronts Natraj and declares that he will stand as Matheyan’s guardian

videos.title: Tournament Heat
videos.overview: At an event, Rangan's return is celebrated, but Natraj becomes increasingly insecure. Later, Matheyan feels shattered when Natraj publicly removes him as team captain.

videos.title: Beginning of the Battle
videos.overview: On the field, MNCA starts strong, but Natraj’s provocation hurts Matheyan. MNCA faces a crushing defeat. Rangan helps Matheyan confront his pain. Rukmani faces Rajasekar’s taunts

videos.title: Fear to Fire
videos.overview: Padma discourages the girls, but Theo shuts her down. MNCA's nerves show early. Despite doubts, Rangan shifts focus to strategy, backing his bowlers and trusting their instincts.

videos.title: Falling Apart
videos.overview: Velu ignores Matheyan’s suggestion. Rishi chooses to fight his battle. Rukmani confronts Natraj for benching Rishi, his poor decisions and rigid leadership that cost MNCA heavily.

videos.title: Narrow Loss
videos.overview: As pressure builds before a crucial game, the MNCA boys struggle while the girls deliver a win. Rukmani intervenes in Natraj's decisions, restoring team balance but angering him.

videos.title: Momentum Shift
videos.overview: Just when the boys think their journey is over, Rangan shows Matheyan a slim chance to qualify. Matheyan then reshapes the batting order, despite Natraj's resistance.

videos.title: Silent Sabotage
videos.overview: As the MNCA boys' hopes rest on Anchor's results, Girish plays a calculated game, benching his main players. Meanwhile, in the girls' camp, Padma returns with a change of heart.

videos.title: Against the Odds
videos.overview: Natraj loses his authority and vents his frustrations on the team. He humiliates Matheyan, leading Rukmani to dismiss him. Rangan steps in to assist them.

videos.title: Interrupted Moments
videos.overview: During a group photo, Theo spots Rangan and Thulasi holding hands. Rishi’s father is happy with his success. Rangan and Thulasi share a moment, but Rukmani’s call interrupts them.

videos.title: Rukmani's Treat
videos.overview: Rukmani takes the teams for a celebratory dinner. While Rishi flirts with Varsha, Theo exposes Rangan’s secret. As Thangam tries to confess to Mani, a message from Anu stuns all.

videos.title: Rumours and Rivalries
videos.overview: With no coach for the boys' team, debates over Natraj and Rangan spark clashes. Meanwhile, Thangam grows jealous of Mani's date, with Rishi and Theo secretly stirring trouble.

videos.title: Shift in Bonds
videos.overview: Rumours swirl about Rangan and Thulasi, leaving them unsettled. Mani's approaching date fuels Thangam's restlessness, pushing her to finally confess her love.

videos.title: Awkward Beginnings
videos.overview: The boys learn of Thangam's confession to Mani and spread it across the academy. Mani struggles to cope with the news. Meanwhile, Rangan and Thulasi hesitate to text each other.

videos.title: Date Plan
videos.overview: Matheyan devises a plan to ease Mani's and Thangam's awkwardness. Meanwhile, on the field, Padma's growing isolation leads to emotional outbursts.

videos.title: Unsteady Hearts
videos.overview: Padma’s sudden move to Anchor shocks the MNCA team, and they feel betrayed. Rangan’s reunion with Dharani helps him release past guilt. Thulasi worries about Rajeev’s threats.

videos.title: Triple Date
videos.overview: The triple date begins with excitement for Rishi, Varsha, Mani, Thangam, Theo, and Matheyan. Each relationship finds its rhythm, turning unspoken emotions into something real.

videos.title: Love and Leverage
videos.overview: Rangan helps Matheyan to strengthen their bond. While Padma faces isolation and backlash in her new environment, a viral post turns Thulasi and Rangan’s lives into controversy.

videos.title: Silent Battles
videos.overview: Rishi asks Matheyan support Rangan through the ongoing controversy. Thulasi faces pressure from the media and her party. Padma begins to feel the emotional cost of her decision.

videos.title: Cracks Beneath the Calm
videos.overview: Rishi accepts calmly when Varsha decides to leave the academy. Rangan and Rukmani realise Rajasekar is behind the rumours. While Thulasi faces pressure, Girish targets Matheyan.

videos.title: Lines Crossed
videos.overview: Rajiv’s video as Thulasi’s supportive husband gains sympathy. Matheyan confronts Girish for targeting his mother, while Rangan faces Rajasekhar and declares his stand for Thulasi.

videos.title: New Year Break
videos.overview: Matheyan struggles with his feelings about his mother. Rukmani calmly manages tensions, advising Rangan. She announces a New Year break to help everyone regain clarity and reset.

videos.title: Holiday Begins
videos.overview: Love finds room to grow for Mani and Thangam during the break. Theo brings a nervous Matheyan to her home and introduces him to her parents.

videos.title: Love Under Pressure
videos.overview: Thangam lies to her mother and leaves for Mani's house. At Theo's house, Matheyan faces parental inquisition about his parents, making him uncomfortable and Theo furious.

videos.title: Between Holding and Losing
videos.overview: Matheyan's deep fear of rejection surfaces during a tense exchange with Theo, making her confront her parents. Thangam's mother realises she is hiding something and warns her.

videos.title: Strength and Silence
videos.overview: Despite Mani's concern and meddling, Matheyan and Theo struggle with their circumstances. Rangan introduces new training methods to the boys' team.

videos.title: The Counter Move
videos.overview: Baskar comes prepared with his complaints, but Thulasi is way ahead when she presents video proof. However, Rajasekar has another plan up his sleeve, thanks to Girish.

videos.title: Where Hearts Drift
videos.overview: Rangan anticipates Rajasekhar's move and has a plan prepared. Triggered by the Anchor boys, a casual game at the local ground turns unpleasant as pride curdles into insecurity.

videos.title: The Distance Between Us
videos.overview: A light-hearted moment spirals when Jackie takes offence to a casual remark. Rangan attempts to restore unity, but miscommunication and bruised egos continue to widen the rift.

videos.title: When Control Slips
videos.overview: Tensions explode as Matheyan hits Jackie in front of everyone, leaving both teams shaken. Matheyan later feels guilty, while Jackie is torn between anger and humiliation.

videos.title: Cracks Deepen
videos.overview: Burdened by team issues, Rangan finds clarity from Thulasi. He helps Matheyan face his family struggles and problems with Jackie, urging resolution over avoidance.

videos.title: What Still Matters
videos.overview: Thulasi and Rangan enjoy playful moments together in Chennai. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the boys at the academy despite the girls' efforts to help.

videos.title: Rangan's Challenge
videos.overview: Matheyan visits his mother at a bar, and she promises to quit drinking. At the academy, the seniors accuse Rangan of favouritism, and his challenge leaves him in shock.

videos.title: Healing and Breaking
videos.overview: Rangan reveals that the girls versus boys match is a strategy to push unity among boys. While Mani isolates himself, ignoring Thangam, Matheyan prepares his mother for rehab.

videos.title: Emotion vs Ego
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam try to outperform each other during practice. Hurt turns into determination when the girls realise the boys are looking down on them.

videos.title: Mind Over Momentum
videos.overview: The girls begin intense training to secure a victory over the boys. Meanwhile, the boys' team faces challenges due to changes and instability within the team.

videos.title: Deal with Divide
videos.overview: Amid the challenges faced by the boys' team and their ongoing conflict with the girls' team, Mani receives an offer from Velu. Will this proposal disrupt or resolve the conflict?

videos.title: The Cost of Pride
videos.overview: As the girls thrive on unity and leadership, the boys struggle to find common ground. Will teamwork triumph, or will the boys rise above their differences?

videos.title: Last Ball, Last Chance
videos.overview: The girls win against the odds, while the boys face the consequences of their mistakes. Mani and Thangam reconcile, but Thangam's possessiveness sparks tension with Anu.

videos.title: When Everything Falls Apart
videos.overview: Matheyan and Jackie put their differences aside and reunite, surprising everyone. Meanwhile, Anu's world is turned upside down by a sudden expulsion from Anchor Academy.

videos.title: Dreams or Duty?
videos.overview: Anu starts a new chapter at MNCA as Theo feels jealous about her arrival. Rishi makes the difficult decision to quit cricket to support his father through a financial crisis.

videos.title: Between Missing and Moving On
videos.overview: The academy struggles to move on after Rishi's departure. When exam dates are announced, cricket takes a backseat. Meanwhile, Thulasi heads into a crucial divorce hearing.

videos.title: When Silence Hurts
videos.overview: Exam pressure replaces cricket. The juniors desperately search for study notes and help. Thulasi's divorce hearing takes a major setback when Rajeev refuses a mutual separation.

videos.title: Preparation and Crisis
videos.overview: Velu orders the seniors to not help the juniors, but two of them ignore him. Rangan receives a golden opportunity, but the situation gets worse for his beloved MNCA and Rukmani.

videos.title: MNCA Under Threat
videos.overview: As Rangan hunts for sponsors, the MNCA crisis snowballs, leading to a meeting with the trustees. Anu and Jackie bond over physics, creating tension between Mani and Thangam.

videos.title: Renewed Hope
videos.overview: The exams finally arrive. Thangam receives good news, which becomes a welcome respite for the academy. Rukmani begins accepting MNCA's possible end, but Rangan stays hopeful.

videos.title: Costly Clash
videos.overview: Theo's parents visit her at the academy, but she misunderstands their intentions. While Rangan gives a tour to a potential investor, an unwelcome sight greets them.

videos.title: Love in Fragments
videos.overview: Matheyan rejoices as his mother slowly returns to her old self. At the advertisement shoot, Thangam and Girish grow closer, stirring jealousy in Mani.

videos.title: Weight of Staying
videos.overview: Anu steals the spotlight in a practice match, leaving Thangam jealous, especially as Mani cheers for her. Elsewhere, Rangan is shaken upon learning about the attack on Thulasi.

videos.title: Under Evaluation
videos.overview: Rangan spends a restless night, troubled by the unachievable condition he imposed on the Chennai club. Later, Matheyan is deeply unsettled by his mother's unexpected health scare.

videos.title: Before Impact
videos.overview: Rukmani shocks Rangan by deciding to sell MNCA's assets. Meanwhile, competition drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu, while Anu and Thangam clash openly on the field.

videos.title: Hearts Start to Align
videos.overview: As tensions build across the academy, personal bonds start affecting the game. Rangan reveals the funding deal with Chennai Club to Rukmani and later shares it with Thulasi.

videos.title: Shifting Equations
videos.overview: Thangam confronts Mani over his lies, straining their relationship. Kalyani collapses during practice and shocks Rangan by revealing that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Choice Within
videos.overview: As Kalyani faces an unexpected pregnancy and a life-changing choice, Rangan helps her find her answer. Meanwhile, growing selection pressure drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu.

videos.title: Shift in Play
videos.overview: Kalyani's absence leaves the girls' team struggling. Mani's growing insecurity over Girish drives a wedge between him and Thangam, hurting both their relationship and their game.

videos.title: Words That Hurt
videos.overview: As Kalyani's departure weighs heavily on Rangan, he lashes out at Thulasi. Her emotional distress quickly becomes the subject of discussion at her workplace.

videos.title: Practice, Pressure, Promises
videos.overview: Worried the academy is nearing its end, Matheyan plans a surprise proposal for Theo with Mani and Thangam's help. But Matheyan's bike crashes, leaving her with a knee injury.

videos.title: Parallel Hearts
videos.overview: After Matheyan's proposal, he and Theo revel in their new relationship, while Mani and Thangam fight. The academy travels to Chennai for its most significant challenge yet.

videos.title: One Team, Many Battles
videos.overview: Rangan mocks the team's low spirits, but Theo stands by them and tries to light up the mood. A stop at a Dhaba turns chaotic as a clash with Anchor Academy erupts into a fight.

videos.title: Her Birthday, His Forever
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam decide not to speak until the tournament ends. Rangan's birthday proposal plans for Thulasi take an unexpected turn after Rajeev humiliates them.

videos.title: Beyond the Game
videos.overview: Jackie uncovers MNCA's financial crisis and Rangan's secret sacrifice for the academy. Meanwhile, disaster strikes as Theo suffers a serious knee injury, ruling her out for weeks.

videos.title: Out of Sync
videos.overview: Anu's surprise captaincy takes a tense turn when a crucial call involving Thangam sparks misunderstandings between the two. Later, Rajasekhar's taunts rile up Rangan and Rukmani.

videos.title: Double Pressure
videos.overview: A sudden schedule shake-up catches the MNCA girl's off guard. Clashing egos and crumbling teamwork push the boys to the edge against Madurai Hawks.

videos.title: What Makes a Team
videos.overview: MNCA's internal conflict costs them another match, revealing Rangan's fierce side. Matheyan's and Rangan's guidance encourages the team to confront their egos and insecurities.

videos.title: Us vs Them
videos.overview: Rangan motivates the teams. With the chase collapsing, Matheyan delivers a breathtaking win and takes MNCA into the quarterfinals. Amid celebrations, Jackie gets devastating news.

videos.title: The Quarter-Final Storm
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam's relationship reaches a painful breaking point. The girls fight through a tense quarterfinal. On the boys' side, Mani's early exit intensifies the pressure.

videos.title: When Life Demands More
videos.overview: Theo receives clearance to rejoin the girls' team as captain. Disaster strikes when Jackie learns Matheyan's mother is in critical condition, forcing Matheyan to rush home.

videos.title: Unsaid Goodbyes
videos.overview: Just before the finals, Matheyan faces the darkest moment of his life. Although Rangan stands by him through this tough time, panic spreads when Matheyan suddenly goes missing.

videos.title: A Legacy Reborn
videos.overview: Despite Matheyan's disappearance, Rangan pushes the team forward, reminding them what's at stake. Meanwhile, Matheyan fulfils his late mother's last wish on her birthday.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Constable Kanakam
_verifiedMetadata.description: Kanakam, a brave young woman, becomes the first lady constable from her village. When she's posted to a new village where women are mysteriously disappearing, including her friend Chandrika, she begins an investigation. Despite facing resistance and shocking truths, Kanakam fights for justice and truth with courage and determination.

videos.title: Jaathara
videos.overview: 1990s, Repalle — a quiet village in Srikakulam — is haunted by the mysterious disappearances of young girls near the eerie Adavigutta forest.To ease rising panic, village president Prakash Rao organizes a vibrant four-day jathara (festival), hoping music, dance, and crowds will drown out the fear. Among the attendees are Constable Kanakam, a soft-spoken but brave officer, and Chandrika, a passionate folk dancer.But as festivities unfold, strange incidents resurface. A curfew quietly spreads: no girls out after 8 PM, especially near Adavigutta. Then, without warning, Kanakam and Chandrika vanish from the festival grounds.

videos.title: Thappetagullu
videos.overview: As the jathara celebrations continue, a shocking truth surfaces — Chandrika is missing. Whispers of suspicion turn toward Kanakam when a witness claims the two left the festival together. A buried feud, a missing man, and a chilling discovery in the woods unravel a deadly twist.

videos.title: Adivigutta
videos.overview: As Chandrika’s father arrives in Repalle demanding answers, tensions rise. Meanwhile, Kanakam’s search for the truth angers her fellow officers, and she’s punished with night duty near the haunted woods.But the forest is watching… and something dark awaits.

videos.title: Thrisulam
videos.overview: In the depths of Adavi Gutta, Kanakam stumbles upon eerie crow nests and a chilling clue a lost gold watch point to a new suspect:  Interrogation reveals a boy with a strange mark, seen in the deeper forest. As Kanakam digs deeper, the forest’s secrets grow darker—and deadlier.

videos.title: Mandasa kova
videos.overview: A wedding in Paderu turns deadly when an insulted cook, takes revenge on the guest. Meanwhile, Kanakam’s search leads her all the way to Delhi, where an ex-military officer confirms her worst fear: the man with the strange mark! . Back in Repalle, drawn by eerie whispers in the night, Kanakam ventures into Adavi Gutta—where she finally comes face-to-face with the man she’s been hunting.

videos.title: Nakshatram
videos.overview: With the man in custody, Kanakam is closer than ever to the truth—but the real questions remain. Who is he really? What dark secrets lie within the mysterious dish? As time runs out and the village’s shadowy past begins to surface, Kanakam must uncover the truth buried in the forest before evil strikes again.

videos.title: Konda Thelu
videos.overview: Haunted by omens, a deadly sting, and a cryptic warning, Kanakam begins to realize the truth may be hiding closer than she ever suspected. With only three days to act, her search leads her to a familiar doorstep — where fear gives way to a far more dangerous discovery.

videos.title: Addam
videos.overview: Kanakam’s investigation deepens when a misplaced clue and a hidden financial trail lead her to Pitapuram, where shocking truths about identity and family begin to surface. As secrets unravel and reflections deceive, she realizes the person she’s searching for may not be who she believed — and the real truth has already vanished into the shadows.

videos.title: Selavu
videos.overview: Kanakam returns home to face an irreversible loss as buried guilt and unanswered questions resurface. As contradictions unravel and hidden truths emerge, her investigation takes a dangerous turn — leaving one chilling question behind: if the past has already claimed a life, who is next?

videos.title: Siksha
videos.overview: An arrest brings no relief as Kanakam uncovers a truth more devastating than the crime itself, forcing her to question justice, identity, and the weight of buried grief. When the past finally reveals its cruelty, Kanakam makes a haunting choice — choosing silence as the final punishment, knowing some truths are meant not to heal, but to haunt.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Musafir Cafe
_verifiedMetadata.description: Chander feels an undeniable connection with Sudha. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with Preeti, but memories of the past linger.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Pharma
_verifiedMetadata.description: A young medical representative struggles against the pharma game, masters it and eventually fights against it.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Heartiley Battery
_verifiedMetadata.description: Sofia, a brilliant but emotionally guarded scientist, believes love is nothing more than biology. After witnessing her parents' relationship fall apart, she invents a device called the Love Meter to prove that true love can be measured.

videos.title: Love vs Logic
videos.overview: Sofia is a brilliant scientist who doesn’t believe in the concept of love. She creates a device called the Love Meter to measure true love. Her path crosses with Sid, a charming comic writer.

videos.title: The Challenge Begins
videos.overview: When Sofia’s device causes his close ones to break up, Sid vows revenge. He decides to prove the invention wrong by making Sofia fall in love with him.

videos.title: The 12-Hour Rule
videos.overview: Sofia and Sid end up on a forced date, but the night takes an unexpected turn. When an emotional Sofia returns home, her device shocks her further by revealing that she is falling for Sid.

videos.title: Signals and Silence
videos.overview: Sid manages to win Sofia’s heart with persistence and small gestures. Sofia finds herself missing him on the day that Sid fails to show up.

videos.title: Zero Love
videos.overview: When Sofia accepts her feelings for Sid, the device shocks her with a reading of zero. A heartbroken Sid leaves, and Sofia questions her beliefs about science and love.

videos.title: Love Beyond Logic
videos.overview: Sofia learns a life lesson about true love that needs no proof or measurement. All she has to do now is choose Sid over her beliefs. Will she choose love or logic?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Arabia Kadali
_verifiedMetadata.description: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In the rival villages of Chepalawada and Matsyawada, fishermen journey to Sangrol for the fishing season. On their way to the fishing port in Gujarat, a violent scuffle breaks out among the men, causing some to be thrown off the train. Will they make it to the port on time and join this year’s fishing expedition?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Badiri and the fishermen begin their expedition with a bad omen, and they are given two rundown boats unfit for the deep sea. Ganga, a passionate teacher in the coastal village, is torn between her love for Badiri and her fears for her brother Chinna, entangled in illegal activities.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Badiri sails into a deadly storm, chasing his father’s lost legacy. Lightning cracks as waves crash, nearly swallowing his crew. Then, a Pakistani Navy speedboat emerges from the dark, silent, fast, and closing in. Heart pounding with grief and fear, Badiri must outrun the sea’s fury and this shadowy threat to save his men.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Captured at sea, Indian fishermen face an uncertain fate in Karachi. While being transported, their situation turns catastrophe as a shattering bomb blast erupts mid-transport. In court, Badiri fiercely defends his peers, embodying loyalty and hope. In India, back in the village, they find out about their loved ones trapped in jail and are shattered.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In Matsyawada, villagers panic over the arrest of the fishermen. Ganga gets a loan from Sekhar and heads to Vishakhapatnam to start the quest for the fishermen's release. Government officials, Susheel and Swaroop, push hard to bring the men back home. Will the fishermen ever return, or is a darker truth lurking just out of reach?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In the shadows of a Pakistani prison, Indian fisherman Badiri fights for survival against ruthless terrorists plotting against him, and a tormented guard harbours a deadly secret that could save or doom him. While back in Matsyawada, heartbroken Ganga clings to cryptic letters amid government silence and a sinister smuggling web threatening to unravel their world in an instant.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In a sweltering prison yard, a warden's rare mercy sparks a chain of buried secrets when a guard uncovers a withheld letter that could upend fragile bonds among inmates. The news of partial releases after two gruelling years stirs hope, regret, and unspoken fears among the confined.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: In the village gripped by despair, innocent Chinna falls into a treacherous money scheme to free his jailed father, while Ganga ignites a viral protest, amassing a growing coalition of supporters. Will their collective courage liberate the captives, or will malevolent forces prevail?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Pritam Pedro
_verifiedMetadata.description: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Inspection Bungalow
_verifiedMetadata.description: In the village of Aravangad, Sub-Inspector Vishnu is forced to shift his police station to a haunted Forest Inspection Bungalow with a dark past.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Kuttram Purindhavan
_verifiedMetadata.description: In a small-town, when a girl goes missing, Retiree Baskaran takes extreme measures to protect his grandson, Esther is consumed by guilt, and powerless constable Gautham races to find the truth. Secrets surface, leading to an uneasy alliance between Baskaran and Gautham, to a final showdown, justice is served, but guilt leaves some with closure and others haunted.

videos.title: In Search Of The Lost
videos.overview: On the night of village temple celebration, a man is found dead outside his home and his daughter, Mercy, vanishes without a trace. Her grieving mother, Esther, is desperate to find her child. Baskaran, a government pharmacist, is desperately waiting for his retirement money - the only hope to save his grandson Rahul, who needs urgent surgery. A reason draws Gautham, the powerless cop, close to the case.

videos.title: What Happened Last Night?
videos.overview: Mercy faces an unthinkable ordeal and is brought to Baskaran for urgent help. He tried his best, but his efforts fail. Trapped by his desperate situation, Baskaran hides the truth. When he reveals it to his wife, she is shaken and unwilling, but with no other choice, she follows his decision. Together, they bury the truth for their own gain - Cops are tracking the suspect behind Mercy's disappearance.

videos.title: Living With The Lie
videos.overview: Baskaran and his wife struggle to keep their secret buried, forced into lie after lie as every step risks exposure. Esther's search grows frantic, her dread of the worst pressing harder each day. Meanwhile, Gautham closes in, his suspicion fixed on Baskaran, and he is on the edge of finding the truth.

videos.title: Through The Darkness
videos.overview: Baskaran's desperation reaches its peak as his grandson's surgery becomes a matter of life and death. Driven by fear and love, he goes to unimaginable lengths, sinking deeper into darkness. Meanwhile, Gautham collects damning evidence, steadily piecing together Baskaran's hidden crimes.

videos.title: The Guilty Ones
videos.overview: Baskaran is consumed by guilt, haunted by the sins he committed against Esther and Mercy. Tormented, he even contemplates turning himself in. Esther struggles with her own guilt, blaming herself for her daughter's disappearance. When Baskaran meets Gautham, he finds a kindred spirit - Gautham's past guilt mirrors his own. Together, they reluctantly unite in a tense pursuit to uncover the real criminal.

videos.title: Breaking The Silence
videos.overview: The most unexpected secrets come to light, revealing hidden details of the night of the crime that no one knew. The true story of Mercy is finally uncovered, exposing shocking truths. Everything builds toward an imminent face-off between the real killer, Baskaran and Gautham.

videos.title: The Closure
videos.overview: The hunt for the killer begins amid the chaos of the temple festival. The final battle is set. Baskaran confronts the killer alone in a tense face-off, while Gautham races against time to catch him. The killer is caught, and both the killer and Baskaran are arrested. Esther is heartbroken when she learns the truth about Baskaran. In the end, the three are left to face the weight of their guilt in their own ways. The full truth comes to light.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Mayasabha
_verifiedMetadata.description: Mayasabha is a period political drama set in Mid 70s Andhra Pradesh. Krishnama Naidu, an idealistic student leader and a charismatic MS Rami Reddy wade into the world of Andhra politics. As they turn thick friends, they strive to use politics as a means to achieve public good. But caste fault lines erupt, loyalties are tested and their bond is pushed to the brink. Will their friendship sustain the brutal ascent of power where there is place for only one at the summit?

videos.title: The Story Of India Is The Story Of Caste
videos.overview: A determined KKN defies his family to pursue higher education, showcasing sharp leadership in a surprising turn. Meanwhile, MSR, a medical student from a powerful family, makes a bold move for love that challenges tradition. Witness their pivotal first steps toward uncertain futures.

videos.title: Natural Born Leaders
videos.overview: MSR's loyalty to his matinee idol sparks a confrontation, resulting in a possible rustication from college. Elsewhere, KKN bravely challenges a dominant political force in college elections. Will his passion overcome cunning sabotage and betrayal?

videos.title: A 'Hi' Amidst Chaos
videos.overview: MSR navigates family feuds and deadly attacks, seeking peace with his new bride. Meanwhile, KKN rescues the girl he loves from a life of misery, but fate has something else in store for him. Their separate struggles culminate in a pivotal bus journey where they meet for the first time.

videos.title: Rebels With A Cause
videos.overview: KKN becomes an enforcer for a controversial government policy, while MSR fiercely resists it. This leads to a fiery confrontation, but as they clash over ideals, a surprising connection forms. Witness the dramatic birth of an unlikely and powerful friendship.

videos.title: Ticket To Mayasabha
videos.overview: KKN orchestrates a grand political event, hoping for a big break. But ego and jealousy threaten KKN's dreams, testing his perseverance. Meanwhile, MSR is drawn into politics by a stinging insult, setting both friends on separate electoral paths.

videos.title: Train To Mayasabha
videos.overview: MSR has to navigate the complexities of caste politics in pursuit of victory. KKN faces a daunting election with no funds to run his campaign. Can idealism triumph over money? Witness the nail-biting vote count as two friends embark on their political destinies.

videos.title: Awakening The Sabha
videos.overview: With lofty ambitions, KKN and MSR enter the assembly, only to find themselves powerless amidst apathy and corruption. They devise a cunning plan to create chaos and rise through the ranks. As political musical chairs intensify, their strategic ascent to power sets the stage for a dramatic clash with a legendary figure.

videos.title: The Caste Fault Lines
videos.overview: MSR pushes for action against the armed rebels, sparking a heated ideological clash with KKN. Meanwhile, internal power struggles in the party culminate in a brutal humiliation for the chief minister, setting the stage for a new regional party and an iconic campaign.

videos.title: Surviving The Tsunami
videos.overview: KKN faces a shocking political challenge from his own father-in-law, which puts him in a tough spot with Iravati. When KKN and MSR experience different fortunes in the elections, their bond is tested as they face a heartbreaking choice that forever changes their friendship.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Alliance
_verifiedMetadata.description: A competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points-the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Kammattam
_verifiedMetadata.description: Inspector Antonio George smells foul play in the mysterious death of Samuel Umman. As his investigation leads him to Samuel's employee, Francis, Antonio realises that a much larger game is in play.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: Detective Antonio George investigates the staged road accident that killed planter Samuel Umman, uncovering a murder mystery.

videos.title: Pursuit
videos.overview: Realising that Shaji was not alone on the day of the incident, Antonio decides to first find the person who was with Shaji.

videos.title: Forgery
videos.overview: Antonio discovers that a loan has been taken out in Samuel's name. He meets with the bank employee, Sharath, to find out who took out the loan.

videos.title: Exposure
videos.overview: Antonio realises that both Shaji and Samuel's deaths were linked to the bank. While interrogating the bank employees, Antonio uncovers many irregularities in the files.

videos.title: Vengeance
videos.overview: Samuel's son, Ebin, identifies the person responsible for his father's death and decides to take revenge.

videos.title: Unraveled
videos.overview: The mystery behind the murders unravels before Antonio. He goes in search of Ebin and Francis, who used to work at Samuel's plantation. Can he arrest the culprit before more lives are lost?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Nadu Center
_verifiedMetadata.description: They fight, they fall, they rise... together!

videos.title: Watch and Learn
videos.overview: PK joins a new school, but trouble follows him. Parvathi, the vice principal, plans to fix the school's prestige by forming a basketball team, but PK has sworn off the game.

videos.title: You Should Play Again
videos.overview: Disappointed with PK's behaviour, VP demands to see him, but he skips school to avoid facing her. Worried, Abel tries desperately to reach him.

videos.title: School Full of Cuckoos
videos.overview: PK goes back to school in search of the person who put the joint in his bag. He is sent to the VP's room and gets rebuked for ruining the school's reputation.

videos.title: You Dunnit
videos.overview: Chandru suffers as his family is stuck in a complicated situation, and his sister is his only moral support. He vents his frustrations on PK, and PK does not back down.

videos.title: Final Warning!
videos.overview: PK and Chandru face VP's wrath, but things take an unexpected turn for them. PK recollects events and incidents from his previous school, and gains perspective towards this school.

videos.title: Coffee..?
videos.overview: Cultural fever begins at KB School. PK gets a bitter-sweet surprise on his birthday. While Guru and Kalidas decide to partake in fashion show, PK is in a dilemma about his past.

videos.title: Break-up and Basketball
videos.overview: PK meets Sanjana, and they share an unexpected evening together. Influenced by the experience, PK realises he needs closure, leading him to play once more for that elusive victory.

videos.title: If Only Words Meant Something
videos.overview: PK convinces the VP to let him assemble a team, but she refuses his request. Meanwhile, Guru and Kaali are in the process of recruiting girls for the fashion show.

videos.title: Wanna Play?
videos.overview: PK tries to introduce basketball, hoping to form a team to compete in a tournament, but encounters a lack of interest. Meanwhile, Guru and Kaali's friendship is put to the test.

videos.title: The Cultural Fest
videos.overview: During the cultural fest, PK sets out on a mission to find players for his basketball team. Elsewhere, Fara befriends a guy online and invites him to meet her at the event.

videos.title: Knock Out
videos.overview: As PK and Jade bond, he throws down a challenge to his rival basketball team. Later, the cultural fest spirals into chaos, dragging Abel into a nightmare.

videos.title: Written and Directed by Guru
videos.overview: Except for PK and Jayanth, the rest of the suspended students return to school. Meanwhile, inspired by the chaos that happened at culturals, Guru writes his own film.

videos.title: Never Quit Basketball
videos.overview: PK unites with his former coach and finds motivation. Friends gather for Jayanth as PK trains the team, while VP pushes the management to approve the basketball team.

videos.title: Not in Sync
videos.overview: Fara and Kaali go through a rough patch with their families, while Guru and Kaali get into a fight. Amid all this chaos, PK finds it challenging to manage without a coach.

videos.title: A Day's Time
videos.overview: Vettri steps in as the KB team's unofficial coach but continues losing as PK waits for his first win. PK must decide whether to compete in a tournament hosted by his former school.

videos.title: Let's Face It
videos.overview: A frustrated PK considers withdrawing from the tournament. Chandru worsens matters by fixing a match without the team's consent.

videos.title: One Win!
videos.overview: PK decides to join the SPI school tournament with his team, but just as things fall into place, everything begins to fall apart. Can PK still claim victory?

_verifiedMetadata.language: Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi

_verifiedMetadata.name: AIR
_verifiedMetadata.description: Three boys. One elite college. A system that demands perfection. Arjun, Imran, and Raju come from different worlds but share one secret: they don’t want to be here. As rebellion sparks friendship, their bond deepens amid pressure, heartbreak, and identity struggles. Guided by a radical teacher with a troubled past, they must decide who they truly are—beyond marks and expectations.

videos.title: Integration
videos.overview: A journey that will test friendship, ambition, and identity. Arjun follows love, Raju battles pressure, and Imran chases dreams against all odds—at All India Rankers Junior College, where the real test is life itself

videos.title: Resistance
videos.overview: At All India Rankers Junior College, Arjun, Imran, and Raju find themselves trapped in a system they never chose. Arjun is disheartened when his school crush doesn’t show up. Imran, hopeful at first, struggles with homesickness and isolation. Raju feels caged in hostel life under a strict teacher’s watch. Each boy is alone—until a shared act of rebellion sparks a bond that could change everything.

videos.title: Radioactive
videos.overview: Determined to escape, Arjun, Imran, and Raju try everything to get expelled—from wild stunts to pranking staff. When nothing works, they take one final shot: storming the principal’s office with cricket bats. What happens next could change everything.

videos.title: Fusion
videos.overview: Arjun backs out mid-rebellion, shocking Imran and Raju. As tensions rise, the truth comes out—and so does a deeper bond. With Jayshree and Lucky, a new gang forms. But just as things click, a new threat emerges.

videos.title: Irreversible
videos.overview: A shuffling exam threatens to split Arjun, Imran, and Raju, each desperate to hold on to what matters. Meanwhile, new teacher Surya’s unorthodox methods stir trouble and change. Choices made now could have lasting consequences.

videos.title: The Catalyst
videos.overview: Caught cheating on the shuffling exam, Arjun, Imran, and Raju face harsh punishment from Parthasarathy, the ruthless college owner. Surya’s unorthodox teaching clashes with management as his painful past unfolds—but even he can’t protect the boys from the fallout.

videos.title: Equilibrium
videos.overview: After their public fall, Arjun, Imran, and Raju are sent home but return with new resolve. Placed in the lowest section, they rebuild under Surya’s guidance and prepare to challenge the top students—on a journey of friendship, failure, and resilience.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Raakh
_verifiedMetadata.description: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Chronicles Of The 4.5 Gang
_verifiedMetadata.description: A group of five slum boys dream of making it big amidst the chaotic world of crime, comedy, and survival.

videos.title: Attack on the Cop
videos.overview: In 2004, a gold-smuggling heist leaves young Arikuttan scarred and entangled in violence. Fourteen years later, he arrives in Auran seeking a ghostwriter to reshape his crime-ridden past, as memories of his youth in Thiruvanjipuram - friendships, betrayals, and clashes with local goons - come flooding back.

videos.title: Gangster take over Ponakavu
videos.overview: As SI Suresh recovers, Arikuttan and his friends are drawn deeper into revenge, leading them to Bonakkad, a criminal hideout with ties to their past. When a violent act changes everything, the boys commit their first crime and go into hiding, setting in motion consequences that will haunt them all.

videos.title: Ponkashi Milk Mafia at large
videos.overview: After surviving a near-fatal shooting, Arikuttan finds himself cared for by his friends and SI Suresh. As Maniyan pursues music and love, Kanji enters PSC training, and Moonga lures the gang into a lucrative milk smuggling scam with Suresh at its core. Their newfound prosperity fuels ambition and reckless choices - from kidnapping a music director to brutal revenge on Senthil for misbehaving with women. But as the gang enjoys cars, cable TV, and influence, Inspector Stalin's pursuit puts a dent into their plan.

videos.title: Goons take over the state capital
videos.overview: While serving time in jail, Arikuttan reconnects with his estranged father, forging an uneasy bond. Meanwhile, Senthil's wealthy plantation family retaliates for his public humiliation by sending an army of workers led by Muthuvel to Thiruvanjipuram, unleashing a wave of violence against local gangs. As Maniyan's dreams are shattered in the clashes and the city descends into chaos, unlikely alliances form, but peace only returns once the Tamil gang withdraws - leaving behind broken clubs, ruined friendships, and broken Thadippalam on the brink of demolition.

videos.title: Cold-blooded Christmas
videos.overview: As SI Suresh plots to seize control of the city's flower trade from the powerful Pookada Vava, Arikuttan and his gang are drawn into a dangerous scheme of arson and revenge. Meanwhile, Maniyan's dreams of becoming a singer unravel in jealousy and violence, leaving Pranita devastated. In the present day, Arikuttan urges his ghostwriter to paint him as a victim, but the truth of Vava's death casts a darker shadow over his story.

videos.title: Gunfires at the Festival
videos.overview: After the murder of Pookada Vava, suspicion falls on Kanji, who is arrested and sentenced, while Arikuttan rises in power, winning tenders and fulfilling his childhood dream of leading a temple festival. Maniyan finds fame as a singer, but tragedy strikes when Ramani, seeking vengeance for her husband's death, unleashes a violent chain of retribution. As betrayal, love, and ambition collide, Arikuttan's world spirals into bloodshed and loss, leaving behind only fragments of memory - and a half-finished book that may be his last attempt at redemption.

event.name: The Game: You Never Play Alone

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Game: You Never Play Alone
_verifiedMetadata.description: A career-driven game developer fights back against misogynistic expectations after she becomes the target of brutal attacks online and in real life.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Devika & Danny
_verifiedMetadata.description: Devika, a compassionate and grounded music teacher living a seemingly ordinary life, is engaged to an insecured and possessive Jaggu. Meanwhile, she bumps into a stranger Danny and his arrival begins to shift Devika's world, leading her down an unforeseen path of self-discovery and unexpected connections.

videos.title: The Priest's Prediction
videos.overview: Docile and obedient Devika gets engaged to domineering Jaggi. Her world changes when a mysterious stranger, Danny, enters her life. Meanwhile, Durga and his gang look for Dannny

videos.title: The Family Secret
videos.overview: Devika and Danny grow close to eath other, and she opens up to him. Feeling guilty, Danny reveals an impossible truth about himself.

videos.title: Danny's Pursuit
videos.overview: Upset wih Danny, Devika refuses to help him. Sensing something strange in the house, Devika's grandfathwe conducts a ritual to drive away

videos.title: Devika Defies the Sacred Order
videos.overview: Danny recalls and how he was saved by Durga, a gang leader. Folllowing Durga's orders, Danny tries to forcefully empty  a building , only to learn it's an orphange

videos.title: Journey that Redefined Her Destiny
videos.overview: To hellp Danny, Devika concocts an excuse and seceretly leaves for Hyderabad with Danny, Pinky and Subbu. While Jaggi confronts confronts her family, a priest

videos.title: The Road to Danny's Redemption
videos.overview: Devika and Danny go to Durga's house to get Gayathri Amma's documents. Devika finally confronts Jaggi and her spiritual journey begins.

videos.title: The Frog Jumps Out of the Bowl
videos.overview: Devika and Danny go to Durga's house to get Gayathri Amma's documents. Devika finally confronts Jaggi and her spiritual journey begins.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Pyramid Scheme
_verifiedMetadata.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Mazha Thorum Munpe
_verifiedMetadata.description: Abandoned as a child, Aleena grows up longing for love. Will life ever lead her back to her lost parents and the happiness she dreams of?

videos.title: Aleena's World Falls Apart
videos.overview: Tensions rise during the 25th anniversary celebrations of Snehanikethan as caretaker Brijithamma suddenly collapses. Aleena is devastated upon hearing the doctor's grave diagnosis.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Police Police
_verifiedMetadata.description: A cop hires a criminal to become a cop illegally. How long will they manage to get away with it?

videos.title: The Clash of Paths
videos.overview: Sub-Inspector Raja lives a disciplined life while Murali spends his time gambling. What happens when the two encounter each other for the first time in a moment of conflict?

videos.title: A Chance at Redemption
videos.overview: Murali redeems himself by helping SI Raja identify the culprit in a chain-snatching case. How will Raja react when he narrates his life's dream to him?

videos.title: Vaavar's Rise
videos.overview: Because of SI Raja's aggressive actions, he is restrained from handling cases at the station. This leaves Vaavar to dominate every investigation.

videos.title: Raja's Offer
videos.overview: In a bid to reestablish himself at the station, Raja extends an offer to Murali. But will Murali accept it?

videos.title: The Uniform of Dreams
videos.overview: A fading wish, a fragile bond - the only world Murali knows is on the verge of disappearing.

videos.title: The Paths We Dare
videos.overview: When loyalties and risks collide, a single decision can change the course of two lives... or trap them both.

videos.title: Hidden Training
videos.overview: As secrets come to light, can Murali step onto a new path? Or will the memories of the past continue to follow him?

videos.title: First Day
videos.overview: Murali steps into his new role. Now, he and Raja must keep the secrets that brought them together.

videos.title: Shifting Moves
videos.overview: Murali and Lalithambika’s game takes a new turn. Now, can mysteries hold? Or will Raja and Vaavar’s secret dealings change everything?

videos.title: Echoes of the Hunt
videos.overview: A trap is laid in the park. Though the kidnappers were in sight, constable Murali’s error alters everything.

videos.title: Roasted by the Minister
videos.overview: Raja gets trapped under the weight of power and authority. Meanwhile, Murali stands confused and helpless.

videos.title: Unexpected Allies
videos.overview: Lalithambika and Murali, once enemies by necessity, are forced to become allies. What will happen next?

videos.title: Past Imperfect
videos.overview: Raja's painful past is revealed to Murali. Thanks to their friends, Lalithambika and Murali are forced to sit through a movie together.

videos.title: Operation Love Letter
videos.overview: Skeletal remains are found in a cemented drum, and Vaavar is tasked to solve it. Meanwhile, Jeeva and team chase a thief who left behind a love letter.

videos.title: Centre of Attention
videos.overview: Muniyandi asks his son about a kidnapped college boy. Arthana questions Vaavar about the status of the cemented skeleton case, but Murali already has answers.

videos.title: Kidnapping a Case
videos.overview: Murali volunteers to solve the case of the kidnapped college boy, but Vaavar has its file under lock and key. Meanwhile, Lalithambika comes across Raja's daughter on the road.

videos.title: An Unexpected Meeting
videos.overview: After years, Raja and Neelasundaravalli come face to face. As forgotten emotions from the past resurface, where will this unexpected encounter take their love journey?

videos.title: The Unfinished Chapter
videos.overview: As Vaavar’s hunt for truth begins, will the outcome be as he expects? Raja and Neelasundaravalli’s untold love story unfolds. In a tale of love, who made the mistakes?

videos.title: The Missed Details
videos.overview: After providing solid evidence, Vaavar closes the murder case. Murali, however, feels something is not right and secretly begins his own investigation. Will his efforts bear fruit?

videos.title: Trust Your Instincts!
videos.overview: Murali’s instinct insists that something is amiss, and he finds himself re-investigating a case already thought as solved. Will his gut be right this time?

videos.title: The Hidden Badge
videos.overview: Murali’s secret life as a cop begins to unravel when his past comes chasing. As chaos erupts, SI Raja steps in, and Lalithambika’s quiet presence weaves into the unfolding storm.

videos.title: First Pay
videos.overview: Murali begins to understand the pulse of police life through Raja’s guidance. His first salary becomes a moment of pride and warmth, bridging the distance between duty and home.

videos.title: The Power Play
videos.overview: Raja fumes when illegal money linked to a minister slip from the law’s grip. With Murali’s sharp idea, the chase shifts from the streets to strategy, where power and justice clash.

videos.title: The Fall of Power
videos.overview: Murali’s master plan unfolds with surgical precision, pulling a powerful minister into a web of his own making. As truth surfaces, a father’s silence burns louder than his power.

videos.title: A Quiet Shift
videos.overview: A regular day at the station brings small tensions and quiet victories. Unspoken changes linger in the air, setting up a new phase for everyone.

videos.title: Operation Ganga Cow
videos.overview: A routine complaint turns into a quirky field mission that puts the station’s teamwork and patience to the test. What starts as a light assignment leads to an unexpected trail.

videos.title: Echoes from Two Decades
videos.overview: A promising lead takes the team back 20 years into a forgotten killing. What starts as a routine enquiry ends with a chilling recollection of the past.

videos.title: Buried Truths
videos.overview: Clues from the past take Raja and Murali deeper into an unsolved murder. Each answer raises new questions about what really happened 20 years ago.

videos.title: Algorithm of Memories
videos.overview: As Raja follows an AI trace, a reunion with his childhood friend Shwetha reawakens the past. Neela’s impulsive choice adds a new twist to the team’s rhythm.

videos.title: Collision Point
videos.overview: An official lead and a personal choice collide on the same day. An attack at Lalithambika’s office pulls Raja into a rescue that blurs every line between case and care.

videos.title: Sugar and Surveillance
videos.overview: In Visakhapatnam, a modest sweet stall hides more than sugar. Murali and Lalithambika’s undercover move draw the suspect out, but every smile at the counter could be a test.

videos.title: Closing Circuit
videos.overview: Every clue points to one moment and it finally arrives. Raja connects the missing links and cracks both cases in a move that rewrites the investigation’s course.

videos.title: Party and the Paper
videos.overview: Raja, Murali and the rest of the team celebrate the completion of a difficult case. But the calm fractures when Swetha is attacked at the hospital and a vital file is stolen.

videos.title: Ashes of the Truth
videos.overview: A son’s breakdown changes everything for Muniyandi. Lalitha and Murali spend quality time together. But what happens when a stolen post-mortem report goes up in flames?

videos.title: Neon Clue
videos.overview: Murali’s search for a strange glow-mask opens a path no one expected. As the dots start to align, Muniyandi makes a silent decision that pushes the case into deeper waters.

videos.title: Warmth and Whispers
videos.overview: A tender meeting arranged by Murali brings an unexpected softness to Raja’s day. However, a young girl’s absence hints that the moment of joy might have come with a shadow.

videos.title: The White Clue
videos.overview: A sudden incident pushes Raja and Murali towards an unexpected trail. As a forgotten detail unfolds, tensions erupt when Neela storms in. A white clue changes course of the case.

videos.title: The Mask Trail
videos.overview: The team chases the origins of a mysterious mask, only to find the trail growing thinner. In the station, uneasy silences and hidden fears begin to surface.

videos.title: Written in Clues
videos.overview: The team examines one letter that could unlock everything. Each stroke, each mark, draws the net tighter. Soon, the case feels uncomfortably near.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Just as the investigation tightens, a brutal incident rattles everyone. Fear and anger rise on both sides of the law. The station enters an unfamiliar territory.

videos.title: Trouble Visits More Than Once
videos.overview: Aachi and Lalithambika get hospitalised. While Vaavar's temper and Muniyandi's suspension unsettle the team, one truth becomes clear: nothing stays buried for long.

videos.title: The Weight of the Truth
videos.overview: Troubled by Vaavar's warning, Murali goes into a state of panic. A simple missing bike complaint opens a trail that refuses to stay simple.

videos.title: A Trail and a Shadow
videos.overview: Raja follows a quiet danger, one that began with Lalitha. Somewhere outside the station, a pair of old eyes starts watching the officers more closely.

videos.title: Warmth and Clashing Realities
videos.overview: Lalitha settles into a new space, unaware of the emotions it awakens. Raja starts investigating all the bike gangs. Meanwhile, Vinoth visits Murali's station.

videos.title: Emotional Turmoil
videos.overview: The case stirs up old memories as Murali and Raja battle their inner conflicts. Neela, in pain, tries to call Raja, but cannot reach him.

videos.title: The Missing Rudraksha!
videos.overview: Vinoth’s missing Rudraksha has Murali worried as his past returns to haunt him. Raja wonders about Murali’s strange behaviour. Meanwhile, a desperate Neela takes a drastic step.

videos.title: Inner Struggle
videos.overview: Murali worries about his secret being revealed. Meanwhile, Raja is angry with Murali's strange behaviour. Will Vishwa’s word of advice guide him through his stress?

videos.title: The Drug Route
videos.overview: Lalitha tries to comfort a dejected Murali. When Raja senses his conflict, Murali confesses to him. With the air cleared between them, Raja takes a firm decision.

videos.title: Confession and Confusion
videos.overview: Murali gets clarity on Vinoth's role in his past through his confession. Meanwhile, confusion arises at the station as the cops struggle to crack an existing case.

videos.title: Award Gone Wrong
videos.overview: It was supposed to be a happy family moment, a milestone in Neela's professional career, but again Mission MAD fails. Meanwhile, Murali springs many surprises on Lalitha.

videos.title: Wheel of Life
videos.overview: Finally, Murali brings his magic moving house to Lalitha. A major incident from Murali's past is unravelled because of Bheemji.

videos.title: The End or the New Beginning!
videos.overview: Murali's struggle with the past and Raja's search for Lalitha's attacker ends. But the answer isn't something they're going to like as a much bigger challenge begins.

videos.title: A Bond Breaks! A Bond Forms!
videos.overview: After the unexpected turn of events, Murali ends his friendship with Vinoth. For Lalitha, a new chapter is set to begin as she gets closer to Murali and bonds with his grandmother.

videos.title: Matchmaking!
videos.overview: The case of a missing bride takes Raja to his better half. Lalitha's father registers her name at the matrimony office, but Swetha is a step ahead as she plays the matchmaker.

videos.title: Mission MAD Ends in Vain
videos.overview: Neela finds out who is behind Mission MAD and changes her divorce lawyer. Vaavar sets out to bring justice to Mohammad Ali while Raja continues his search for the missing bride.

videos.title: Two Different Paths
videos.overview: Murali and Lalitha enjoy the first essence of their love. Raja is shocked to get a divorce notice from Neela. Meanwhile, the case believed to be solved takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: The Root of All Evil
videos.overview: Lalitha and Murali confess to Raja about the reason behind Neela's recent outburst. A dejected Raja informs them what conspired on that day to lead to his and Neela's split.

videos.title: Raja Finds the Bride
videos.overview: Raja works his way to find the missing bride who was earlier considered as a fraudster. Meanwhile, Aira learns about the past he shares with Raja.

videos.title: No Giving Up!
videos.overview: Lalitha encourages Raja not to give up and to fight his case against Neela. While Swency is firm that Jeeva learns to ride a bicycle, the Mohammad Ali case takes a positive turn.

videos.title: Parents and Problems
videos.overview: During the divorce hearing, Raja and Neela dispute over Sathya’s custody. Lalitha’s father, on the other hand, comes between his daughter and her love unintentionally.

videos.title: The Price Of Truth
videos.overview: Murali is shocked to learn about Lalitha’s father. Worried that Murali's truth may land them in trouble, Raja gives him an ultimatum. Ayiravathan warns Raja of an upcoming rivalry.

videos.title: Duty Or Desire?
videos.overview: Shattered, Murali avoids Lalitha, who worries about his behaviour. Ayiravathan prepares kids and youth to fight for their caste while his men wage an indirect war against the cops.

videos.title: In The Dark
videos.overview: Unable to bear his silence, an anxious Lalitha confronts Murali. Meanwhile, despite several issues, Raja and Murali see some light in their quest to solve Mohammad Ali's case.

videos.title: Round 1 Goes to Ayiravathan
