_verifiedMetadata.name: Anantham
_verifiedMetadata.description: Anantham has sheltered and nurtured families since 1964. When Ananth, the son of the house owner returns to Anantham, he learns about the many untold past stories of the house.

videos.title: Chapter 1 - Maragatham
videos.overview: Ananth, a successful writer, unwillingly revisits his family home. Meanwhile, an estranged father dives into the past to learn about the journey of Venkatesan and his wife Maragatham in their home called 'Anantham.'

videos.title: Chapter 2 - Seetha
videos.overview: Ananth learns the story of a married couple who lived in the house in 1971—Sundar and his visually impaired wife, Seetha. He witnesses Seetha's plight during the days she spent within the walls of Anantham.

videos.title: Chapter 3 - Rekha
videos.overview: Set in 1975, witness the struggling lives of Sandeep, an IIT graduate, Rekha, his happy-go-lucky wife, and their two children.

videos.title: Chapter 4 - Ananth
videos.overview: Ananth recalls the first time he fell in love in 1985 and how it changed his life forever.

videos.title: Chapter 5 - Krishnan Menon
videos.overview: Three beautiful women living in 'Anantham' experience laughter and love after Krishnan Menon, a new paying guest, moves into their home.

videos.title: Chapter 6 - Lalitha
videos.overview: Tenants Lalitha and Balu return to stay at Anantham. But, will they have a peaceful stay at Anantham despite the horrible sins committed during their previous stay?

videos.title: Chapter 7 - Parvathy
videos.overview: Ananth meets a young psychotherapist, Parvathy, who tells him about her painful journey and how she broke barriers and embraced her true potential while living at Anantham.

videos.title: Chapter 8 - Venkatesan
videos.overview: Venkatesan returns home to spend his remaining days at Anantham. As he nears his end, will he reconcile with his son and embrace peace?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Dhahanam
_verifiedMetadata.description: The assassination of Sri Ramulu, a communist labourer, causes a stir. Sri Ramulu's oldest son, Hari, is a Naxalite rebel operating from the forest using guerrilla warfare against the landlords, and the news of his father's death infuriates him. He takes it upon himself to find the person responsible for his father's murder, which sparks a conflict between the village's most powerful goons.

videos.title: Back Stab
videos.overview: Anjana Sinha arrives at Obul Reddy's murder location. While looking into the details of the case, she comes across a murder that was a fabric for all the murders happening in the region, that is the murder of Sri Ramulayya. Soon, Anjana uncovers a deeper mystery behind all these murders. When Sri Ramulayya gets murdered, Hari, Ramulayya's son, vows to avenge his father's death.

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: Hari and his men gather and start hunting down all the people who helped Siddappa in killing Sri Ramulayya. Ravi persuades Hari to give up his revenge. Seeing that Ravi's brother Hari is down the wrong path, Sunitha's father denies her marriage to Ravi. Siddappa hides in the lodge, feeling guilty about killing Sri Ramulayya. However, Siddappa makes a mistake when he calls his wife which helps Hari's men to get Siddappa's location.

videos.title: The Plot
videos.overview: The motive and plan behind the murder of Sri Ramulayya are revealed. Chenna Reddy gets jealous of his friend Narayana Reddy and Sri Ramulayya's friendship and poisons Narayana Reddy's mind against Sri Ramulayya. It is revealed that Siddappa is only a cover for the evil deeds done by Narayana and Chenna Reddy.

videos.title: Warning
videos.overview: Chenna Reddy's son, Obul Reddy, rapes a teacher and kills her husband. To make an example, Hari hangs Siddappa's dead body in a tank and places a letter of warning for the perpetrators of his father's murder. This leads to an all-out war between both families. Narayana and Chenna reddy plan to kill Hari with the help of the police. When Subba Reddy is killed, the blame for the murder is put on Hari. The police start looking for Hari and his men.

videos.title: Game
videos.overview: Obul realizes that he was caught in Hari's trap. Obul gets injured and Chenna Reddy yells at him for not listening. Obul Reddy presents an offer to Kabir to capture Hari alive in exchange for anything he wants. Ravi meets with Hari and Sunitha before he leaves for Bangalore. Hari finds out that Chenna Reddy and Kabir are looking for him and plan to capture him.

videos.title: Attack
videos.overview: Pavani serves food to the Naxals, then Kanchi questions Pavani about her feelings for Hari. Pavani tells Kanchi about how her family was killed and she ran to the forest to save herself where she met Hari. He helped her kill her family's murderers. When the police start shooting, Kanchi dies on the spot, and Pavani hides. The police manage to capture Hari and Pavani finds out a shocking truth.

videos.title: Vow
videos.overview: Kabir informs Obul Reddy about Hari's capture. Obul hurries to the spot and kills Hari. Pavani and Naxals kill Sai, who was the police's informer. Chaman reveals to the Naxals that Kabir is behind Hari's murder. The Naxals decide to eliminate Kabir and filtrate his house to kill him. With Kabir's death, Narayana Reddy and Chenna Reddy feel the heat and decide to stop the Naxals. Ravi is back and vows to take revenge for his father and brother's murder.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Ba***ds of Bollywood
_verifiedMetadata.description: An entertaining ride through the adventures of an ambitious outsider navigating the glitzy yet tricky world of Bollywood, with self-aware humor, cameos, and larger-than-life characters for a tongue-in-cheek take on Indian cinema.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Irai
_verifiedMetadata.description: To solve a kidnapping case of a high-profile politician and to investigate the mysterious disappearances of men from the city's affluent families, ACP Robert Vasudevan is appointed. Will he succeed in finding the culprit?

videos.title: The Ripple Effect
videos.overview: At the break of dawn, Kodaikanal suddenly becomes a hotspot for a high-profile influential politician missing case. Veteran police officer, ACP Robert Vasudevan is called in to investigate.

videos.title: Skeletons In The Closet
videos.overview: Traveling back to late 80's the story unearths Sivakumar's dark past like a can of worms. In the present, Anita, the officer-in-charge of the case, begins to have second thoughts about Robert's eccentric ways of dealing the case.

videos.title: The Past
videos.overview: Sivakumar dwells in torture in a dark and damp cellar. Robert takes a little detour to revisit a place that holds traumatic memories from the past. In Devi’s timeline, she takes an unexpected decision that will forever change Swarna's life.

videos.title: The Suspect
videos.overview: An international school in town, keeps catches Robert's attention in his investigation. Heera from the NGO becomes a primary suspect.

videos.title: Lost & Found
videos.overview: A janitor from the school falls into the radar of Robert's suspects. Meanwhile, Sivakumar tries to execute his escape plan. In a mix-up of things, Robert ends up arriving alone to what could very well be the hideout of the kidnapper.

videos.title: Truth Will Set You Free
videos.overview: Robert has a face-off with Sumithran. In a strange turn of events the other abductor surrenders to the police. As the case is being closed and normalcy returns, Robert is being lured to a door from the past.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Gaalivaana
_verifiedMetadata.description: After newlyweds Ajay and Geetha are brutally murdered, their families come together in grief. But the situation takes a new twist when the suspected killer arrives at their doorstep.

videos.title: The Storm is Coming
videos.overview: Childhood sweethearts Ajay Varma and Geetha are brutally murdered on their return from the honeymoon. Soon, their devastated families discover the identity of the badly injured stranger who turns up on their doorstep.

videos.title: One Of Us Knows it All
videos.overview: Nandini, a police officer from Vizag is appointed to investigate the young couple’s murder. The two families have a new problem to deal with, as they realise they are not above crime.

videos.title: The Buried Truth
videos.overview: While both the families struggle to hide the crime, someone among them is hiding the truth from everyone. Saraswathi stumbles upon something that can either solve it all, or create a bigger dilemma for her.

videos.title: The Knife Knows the Killer
videos.overview: Savitri blackmails Komarraju to not reveal Srikanth’s visit to the cattle barn the night Srinu died. Nandini is terrified to see the news of the young guy’s death because of the drugs she supplied. Meanwhile, Ravindra Varma commits suicide, and Marthand gets arrested.

videos.title: Is it Right to Be Wrong?
videos.overview: David Raju warns Nandini to help him escape the city. Srikanth leaks a shocking information to the police. Nandini and the police team find the clue they’ve been searching for.

videos.title: A Truth Greater Than Confession
videos.overview: The two families are taken into custody. Finally, Marthand confesses to murder. Sravani's world shatters when Shakantulamma reveals the truth to her.

videos.title: An Innocent Mind Knows No Boundaries
videos.overview: Shakuntala reveals how overlooking something in the past has now caught up to destroy two families. Saraswathi unleashes a mother’s wrath. Tulasi crumbles while Komarraju realises everything that he has been holding on to is false.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Do You Wanna Partner
_verifiedMetadata.description: Best friends Shikha and Anahita turn entrepreneurs with an exciting craft beer brand, Jugaaro, to stand out in the crowded NCR beer market. However, they face gender discrimination every step of the way. To fight for an equal place in this male dominated sector, they decide to invent a fictitious male partner to help smooth their way. Invariably, things don’t go exactly as planned. What follows are their collective adventures & misadventures in trying to build a successful start-up amidst the current boom, as the bunch of misfits band together and become a family.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Vilangu
_verifiedMetadata.description: Paridhi, a cop undergoing a stressful personal situation, must solve a mysterious murder case that has put the police department on its toes.

videos.title: The Last Piece of the Puzzle

_verifiedMetadata.name: Parampara
_verifiedMetadata.description: When powerful, wily Naidu's ruthlessness becomes too much, his nephew, Gopi, steps up to avenge the injustice met to his father.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Andhera
_verifiedMetadata.description: In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Akash Vaani
_verifiedMetadata.description: A recently divorced couple has to pretend to be happily married during a college reunion with their close friends.

videos.title: Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: Seeking inspiration for her novel, an aspiring writer Teena traces back to the celebrated love story of her college classmates Akash and Vaani. This leads to the re-union of their college batch after a decade.​

videos.title: Where Are You Now?
videos.overview: Sharath and Teena try to look for leads to connect with Akash and Vaani. The batch arrives at the re-union. Akash and Vaani face an unexpected surprise.​

videos.title: Something Fishy
videos.overview: Akash and Vaani try to lie low during the re-union dinner but a nosy Sharath won't leave them alone. In the past, Akash expresses his love through a grand gesture. ​

videos.title: Storm In A Teacup
videos.overview: In the past, Akash and Vaani get married and face issues as a newly married couple. The friends come to terms with a shocking revelation at the re-union.​

videos.title: Bite The Bullet
videos.overview: Problems between Akash and Vaani peak. In the past the college gang deals with the loss of a loved one. A drunk conversation lands Dileep in an awkward situation with Akash.​

videos.title: The Courage of Our Hearts
videos.overview: Akash and Vaani come together to help Anu re-unite with her husband. The friends look for an opportunity to make things happen. Akash opens up for the first time.​

videos.title: Through Thick And Thin
videos.overview: Vaani re-lives the promises she and Akash made with each other. Akash goes missing leading to a frantic search by the friends.​

_verifiedMetadata.name: Oka Chinna Family Story
_verifiedMetadata.description: Mahesh and his mother embark on an adventurous journey filled with hilarious situations as they try to make quick money to repay a huge loan.

videos.title: EP1
videos.overview: Mahesh is an unemployed youth who, along with his mother, must earn 25 lakh rupees to repay a loan taken by his dead father. As they struggle to make money, Mahesh realises the unsaid truth behind his dad's invaluable sacrifice.

videos.title: The First EMI
videos.overview: As the loan recovery agents swarm their house, Mahesh and his mother, Rukmini, are forced to work to repay the loan. Mahesh takes up a job but parallelly devises a plan with his mother to make easy money.

videos.title: Of the money, by the money, for the money
videos.overview: While Mahesh and Rukmini struggle to arrange for the money, Mahesh manages to break the ice with Keerthi. But with time running out and no concrete plan in place, what will Mahesh do?

videos.title: Ousting Days
videos.overview: As Mahesh fails to make money and win Keerthi's love, his resentment toward his belated father increases. He grows apart from his mother. But he gets an unexpected proposition that could malign his father's name.

videos.title: Truth or Dare
videos.overview: With a potential deal in front of him that could solve his money problem but spoil his father's good image, Mahesh must now decide on the next course of action. Will Mahesh solve his family's problems forever?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Sena - Guardians of the Nation
_verifiedMetadata.description: A dedicated Indian Army Captain and his father are captured by militants in Kashmir, forcing them to reconcile their past differences while planning a daring escape that could save their lives and thwart a terrorist plot.

videos.title: Ambush
videos.overview: Captain Kartik Sharma is ambushed and kidnapped along with his father, by terrorists seeking revenge for Abu Bakar's arrest; The army begins a search operation.

videos.title: Manhunt
videos.overview: While Kartik is held captive, the Army track a suspect vehicle, as terrorists take Kartik's father, leaving Kartik begging them to stop.

videos.title: Camouflage
videos.overview: Kartik, held captive, pretends to join terrorists to plan his escape. The Army tracks his secret signals.

videos.title: The Run
videos.overview: Kartik escapes with his injured father, fleeing through the jungle while terrorists chase them. The Army tracks them for rescue.

videos.title: Pyare Papa
videos.overview: Kartik, rescued but broken, decides to leave the Army. Months later, a letter from his proud father gives him strength to return. He joins a mission to track the terrorists, leading them to Masood's hideout in POK.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Putham Pudhu Kaalai Vidiyaadhaa
_verifiedMetadata.description: This is a Tamil anthology series comprising five episodes. All five tales hark back to themes of love, hope and togetherness in trying times

_verifiedMetadata.name: Kudi Yedamaithe
_verifiedMetadata.description: A Food Delivery Guy, who finds a bloody corpse of a young woman in the middle of a night & A Female Police Inspector investigating a missing child's case collide into each other as they meet with a fatal accident, which sends both of them into a Never ending time loop until they figure out an Unimaginable way out of it.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Hunt: The Rajiv Gandhi Assassination Case
_verifiedMetadata.description: Follows the events leading up to the tragic 1991 assassination of former prime minister Rajiv Gandhi and the intense manhunt that unfolded after , unraveling a complex web of espionage, intelligence failures, shifting allegiances, and the profound human cost involved in the pursuit of justice.

videos.title: Where Do We Begin?
videos.overview: The Indian High Commission in Colombo receives a mysterious phone call, followed by the meticulous assembly of a suicide bomb. As the news of the tragic bombing at Sriperumbudur shakes the nation, Prime Minister Chandrashekhar appoints D.R. Kaarthikeyan to lead a multi-agency Special Investigation Team. Parallelly, forensic expert Prof. Chandrashekar uncovers vital clues, while a leaked press photo accelerates the case but compromises the investigation, leading to a chilling revelation.

videos.title: If You Prick Us, You Will Bleed Too
videos.overview: As the Special Investigation Team uncovers propaganda operations and hidden printing presses, they confirm Haribabu was a key operative. Meanwhile, surveillance intensifies on some suspects, who narrowly escape arrest. The team captures Koneshwaran, a low-level operative part of a nine-member team smuggled in from Jaffna. With mounting evidence and shocking confessions, the investigation uncovers how dangerously close a second assassination attempt came.

videos.title: In Moments Of Pain, You Seek Revenge
videos.overview: Sivarasan, a close aide of LTTE chief Prabhakaran, narrowly escapes the coast guard, confirming he is still in India. As the Special Investigation Team scrambles to find him, they face a flood of misleading tips. Surveillance intensifies, and Ravi Shankar is finally caught and interrogated, revealing key links to the assassination plot. Meanwhile, Sivarasan plots a daring second attack. With his team spreading out in disguise and scouting the location, the threat escalates.

videos.title: The Noose Tightens
videos.overview: As the investigation intensifies, interrogations reveal how Nalini and Murugan became central to the conspiracy, and the SIT orchestrates a nationwide manhunt for them. Meanwhile, Sivarasan, defying LTTE orders, attempts a failed bomb attack on the SIT headquarters. The SIT gains vital intel from Murugan, including safe house locations and operational details. As the net tightens, the investigators move closer to dismantling the LTTE network on Indian soil.

videos.title: He Must Go!
videos.overview: The SIT learns how Dhanu, Shubha, and Haribabu conducted dry runs to prove they could breach high-level security-setting the stage for Rajiv Gandhi's murder. Meanwhile, the SIT arrests key LTTE sympathizers who expose the elaborate smuggling and safehouse networks along the Tamil Nadu coast. However, when one of them, who is the key to finding the mastermind, escapes custody, it reignites a desperate chase.

videos.title: No One Is A True Friend
videos.overview: The SIT intensifies its hunt for Sivarasan, believing he may have fled Tamil Nadu. However, a lucky arrest in Coimbatore reveals that Sivarasan was smuggled into Bangalore in an oil tanker. As surveillance sweeps the city, a near-raid on one safe house in Indiranagar misses Sivarasan by mere metres, and a tragic misstep by local police in Biroota and Muthati results in the deaths of 17 LTTE operatives, prompting political backlash and urgent pressure on the SIT to capture Sivarasan alive.

videos.title: The Trail Ends?
videos.overview: The net tightens around Sivarasan as a local tip leads the police and SIT to his last known hideout in Konanakunte, Bangalore. Despite internal conflicts, media frenzy, and repeated delays, the NSG prepares for a final assault. Tension mounts as Sivarasan, hiding with Shubha, Nero, and others, grows paranoid and desperate. The SIT finally receives clearance to act, but will it be too late?

videos.overview: Inspector Kunal has collected all the pieces of the puzzle – the evidence, the witness accounts, the hidden secrets, and the tangled relationships. He finally sees the full picture.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Naam
_verifiedMetadata.description: 6 mismatched individuals gel in a unique way to produce compelling music like never before. However, misunderstandings break the band. At present, an unwelcome entry of an intruder has given them the opportunity to reminisce their past.

videos.title: One Last Time
videos.overview: A whole year had passed. The band One Music are optimistic about their futures after coming out from a traumatic incident that had threatened their lives. With their eyes on the prize, they make plans for a successful re-launch when a man with a familiar name returns.

videos.title: Welcome to Rudhiranda
videos.overview: Jyothibala receives a distress call from a broken voice In the midst of a murder investigation. Nagamalani's death forces Shiva to find refuge on an uncharted island whilst an ex-cop gets reinstated on a cold case.

videos.title: The Purpose
videos.overview: Private security is hired after a masked gang attempts an assault on Aaryan whilst a sinister presence looms near. In a shack on the outskirts of Rudhiranda hides a secret. A beautiful secret.

videos.title: Breakthrough
videos.overview: All actions have consequences, a fisherman and a courtesan aid in an escape plan. A vital clue sends the police on a wild chase.

videos.title: Haunting Truth
videos.overview: A diary reveals the pain of love whilst two police officers settle their differences. Dhilip and Jyothibala are presented a ticket to paradise.

videos.title: Revelation
videos.overview: Shiva receives a daily token chip that sends him to work in a lab. A revelation in the truth sends the band into a spiral.

videos.title: Frequencies
videos.overview: Hidden wires and radio waves, Shiva puts together a communications box whilst Vettaiyan suspects an insider in the Taskforce.

videos.title: One More Perspective
videos.overview: Shiva escapes the island of no return to settle an old score. Aaryan's suspicion comes true when he comes face to face with his old enemy.

videos.title: Choose One
videos.overview: Ranna leaves Jyothibala helpless when he is left to choose between Dhilip and a reunion with Malar. In a rundown lair, Aaryan discovers the motive of his true nemesis.

videos.title: 2 Sides to Every Story
videos.overview: Ranna puts the search for Azhagi on hold when a big investor arrives on the island. In an undisclosed safe house, Sethu reveals to Vettaiyan there's more to Rudhiranda than just Shiva.

videos.title: One Love One Life - The Finale
videos.overview: He the protector. He the destroyer. Shiva frees the slaves while Aaryan ends his bane.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Locked
_verifiedMetadata.description: The story of Dr Anand Chakravarthy ( Satyadev ), a neurosurgeon, and what happens when he is trapped inside his own house.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Gamerlog
_verifiedMetadata.description: A teen gaming prodigy joins an underdog Mumbai esports team challenging the champion Wolfclan. As they pursue glory, Raghu seeks Joanna's love while hiding secrets from his past.

videos.title: Bhaag Ragla Bhaag
videos.overview: Raghu, small town boy from Surat recieves an offer to join a professional esports team in Mumbai and compete in the most prestigious Tournament of Champions. Raghu runs away from home to pursue his dream.

videos.title: Pudina Wali Chai
videos.overview: The rival team and Indian's number 1 e-sports team, the Wolf Clan are introduced as the big bad's. They prank and are often the thorn in the side of Team Gamerlog.

videos.title: Give Em Hell Boys
videos.overview: Team Gamerlog realizes that Joanna is in major debt and they have to do something to help her pay of her loans or they risk losing the team forever.

videos.title: Cheers To life
videos.overview: Team Gamerlog find an alternate source of income to help fund their team. Jaggi bites his ego and contacts his father.

videos.title: Minor Nahin, Major Problem
videos.overview: The truth about Raghu being a minor and having run away from home is revealed. Joanna is taken to jail for 'kidnapping' him. The dream of the TOC seems to be slipping away.

videos.title: It's War
videos.overview: The finale that everyone has been waiting for is here. After a lot of ups and downs, team Gamerlog manages to reach the finals and eventually face off against arch enemy the Wolf Clan.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Mugilan
_verifiedMetadata.description: Socio-political events that led to the rise of one of the most dreaded gangsters of Kanchipuram in the 1970s called Mugilan.

videos.title: The First Strike
videos.overview: A hasty decision by Mugilan proves fatal, as a series of chaotic events leave him in despair. He gets reminiscent of his initial days of working as a henchman along with Saravanan.

videos.title: Deceit
videos.overview: While trying to set things right, Mugilan finds himself in a situation where his most trusted aides have let him down. Mugilan retaliates to Rajendran's action to pressurise him.

videos.title: Lost In love
videos.overview: Maghi’s affection towards Mugilan grows stronger with each passing day. But, their relationship changes when someone else makes a foray into Mugilan’s life unexpectedly.

videos.title: The Rise Of The Underdog
videos.overview: After Reddy makes an unexpected move, it puts Mudhalaiyar in a spot. While Saravanan tries to make the best of this situation, Mugilan has his own plans.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: In the race to become the prime confidant, Saravanan and Mugilan play games. But the tables are turned due to a sudden change, giving one of them an edge to become the successor.

videos.title: Red Eagles
videos.overview: Trying to pick up the pieces, Maghi tries to reach out to Mugilan in distress. Unfortunately, things go haywire on Mugilan’s front leaving him vulnerable.

videos.title: Allegiance And Betrayal
videos.overview: Going back and forth in the occurrence of events, the life of the undisputed gangster starts to crumble, drawing a thin line between allegiance and betrayal.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: With his family's safety and his image at stake, Mugilan must now take a tough decision that can make his plans topsy-turvy.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Amrutham Dhvitheeyam
_verifiedMetadata.description: Amrutham Dhvitheeyam is a 2020 ZEE5 Telugu Original comedy series starring Harsha Vardhan, L B Sriram, Vasu, and Sivannarayana. In this sequel of Amrutham, the all-time popular Telugu sitcom, Amrutham and Anji continue to come up with creative ideas for their restaurant and fail with hilarious consequences.

videos.title: The Beginning of Amrutha Vilas
videos.overview: Amrutha Rao and Anji decide to start Amrutha Vilas again after losing all their money in a recent disaster. When they meet Sarvam and prepare to begin their new journey, Appaji re-enters their life, offering finance for their new venture. However, the duo rejects it and tries their luck at a venture capital firm.

videos.title: When Failure Becomes Your Friend
videos.overview: After being rejected by the venture capitalist, Anji and Amrutha seek an alternate approach. When all attempts seem destined for failure, they find a ray of hope in the form of an angel investor. Will their dream of starting Amrutha Vilas come true?

videos.title: The Angel in Disguise
videos.overview: After Anji and Amrutha recover from discovering the identity of their angel investor, they begin the preps for the launch of their new hotel, Amrutha Vilas. Sarvam vows never to be the cause for them losing any money. Will Sarvam keep up his word?

videos.title: Lockdown Special Part I
videos.overview: After Appaji decides to get his share of money even during the lockdown, he informs Amrutham, Anji, and Sarvam, to transfer Rs. 1000 to his account. The trio decides to teach him a lesson and play a prank on him.

videos.title: Lockdown Special Part II
videos.overview: After Appaji expresses his desire to eat Pesarattu, Sarvam convinces him to follow his recipe and make it at home. However, Appaji's efforts of eating his favourite dish go in vain after he finds himself in an unexpected situation, thanks to the lockdown!

videos.title: Mosquito bite
videos.overview: The dengue outbreak in the city makes Amrutha Rao take extreme precautionary measures. Meanwhile, Anji comes up with a new scheme to attract customers by promising the highest level of safety measures.

videos.title: Kitty Party
videos.overview: After hearing about Santha's kitty party and the savings involved, Sanjeevini floats the idea of conducting similar kitty parties at Amrutha Vilas. On the other hand, Anji plans an elaborate scheme involving the same kitty parties which can free them from Appaji’s partnership forever. Will Anji's plan work?

videos.title: The Booksellers!
videos.overview: After Sarvam attends a book launch, Anji plans to conduct a book launch event at Amrutha Vilas with the help of Rubber Balaji. When the publisher offers them a share in the sale of the books instead of their payment, Amrutha Rao gets tempted and agrees. However, their attempts to recoup their investment only get worse with unimaginable twists and turns!

videos.title: Sick Sock-Mind Block
videos.overview: Sanju’s new smartphone leads to trouble for Amruthavilas. When she starts to upload videos to the popular Sick Sock app, her soaring popularity makes her an addict. Anji’s idea threatens her new-found celebrity status and Sanju responds in the most unexpected manner.

videos.title: Crazy Chef's Tasty Menu
videos.overview: Anji wakes up with the idea of celebrating "World Opposite Day" at Amruthavilas. On the same day, a famous food blogger visits their restaurant to review their food. Will they succeed in pleasing her, or will the opposite happen as is usually their fate?

videos.title: Final Destination
videos.overview: Appaji forces Amrutha and Anji to accept the offer of celebrating the birthday of an old man. Will this lead them to profits or unexpected consequences?

videos.title: Krishnashtami
videos.overview: Anji hosts Krishnashtami at AV4D where Amrutha undertakes safety protocols fearing legal troubles. This leads to bigger problems than he can envision.

videos.title: Door Delivery
videos.overview: Anji starts a new door delivery service to earn huge profits. Appaji overpowers them by trying to snatch the high profits from them. What new problem can this lead to?

videos.title: 21 Varieties of Leaves
videos.overview: Anji performs a traditional pooja on the occasion of Vinayaka Chaturthi but ends up inviting the wrath of God. Will they be able to overcome this?

videos.title: The Colourful Dream
videos.overview: Sanju and Sarvam receive a scam message promising money. Appaji garners followers who also launch a fan club for him. Could these events be linked?

videos.title: Rummy and Fireworks
videos.overview: Appaji forces AV4D to follow a smokeless Diwali. Anji comes up with ideas where the kids and adults get to enjoy. Will this lead to consequences?

videos.title: Monstrous Stew 1
videos.overview: Amrutha plans on hosting a Halloween party at AV4D. Even after been stopped by Anji, Amrutha goes ahead with his plan. Will this land them in trouble?

videos.title: Monstrous Stew 2
videos.overview: Kids at the Halloween celebrations in AV4D plan revenge on Appaji who had stolen their chocolates. How are the others trapped in this play?

videos.title: Happy New Year
videos.overview: Anji plans a universal party to celebrate New Year's as per different time zones. Appaji sells fake passes to make a quick buck but lands in trouble.

videos.title: Festival Rooster
videos.overview: Parandamayya’s main intent is to keep his prized rooster away from Amrutha and hence he decides to celebrate the festival at AV4D at any cost.

videos.title: A Happy, Flying Birthday Cake
videos.overview: Anji and Amrutha need to fulfill a special clause to celebrate the birthday of a 4-year old girl. Will the party be a success or will they face hurdles?

videos.title: Gravity of Fish Gravy
videos.overview: Anji decides to host a special cooking event for his customers. A food inspector adds spice to the gravy. Will this spicy gravy cause tears to Amrutha?

videos.title: Two Cooks Spoil the Broth
videos.overview: Cooking videos are shot to help increase Anji’s fame but frustrated with the expenses, Appaji launches a new cost-cutting exercise. Will it be a futile attempt?

videos.title: Uma Devi's Wedding Festivities
videos.overview: Sarvam gets shocked when someone from his past shows up at AV4D. A misunderstanding makes Appaji swear that he will get Uma married to anyone but Sarvam.

videos.title: Amrutha Vilas, a reality show set?
videos.overview: Anji and Amrutha Rao, along with Rubber Balaji, sign a deal to rent out Amrutha Vilas as a location for two popular reality shows. Appaji agrees too. But when he realises that Sarvam and Uma Devi have entered the house, he tries to force himself into the house as a contestant with unexpected results.

videos.title: Appaji in the house!
videos.overview: Appaji’s surprise entry extends the duration of the contest by a week. He campaigns for Uma Devi’s exit from the house. Meanwhile, Uma Devi and Sarvam too try to get him evicted. With more surprise entries and exits and crazy tasks, this season finale is a truly shocking one.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Traitors
_verifiedMetadata.description: A group of contestants arrive with hopes of winning a large cash prize of ₹1 crore that is built up through missions. The players are referred to as the "Innocents", but among them are the "Traitors" — a group of contestants secretly selected by the host. If the Innocents eliminate all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund. However, if any Traitors manage to make it to the end, eliminating the Innocents, they win the entire prize money.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Time Enna Boss!?
_verifiedMetadata.description: Bala - an average IT guy, is forced to host 4 random time travellers who land up in his new house until they find their way back. But will they ever leave?

videos.title: Flush In
videos.overview: After seeing his family off, Bala peacefully settles down in his new apartment, only to find random time travellers from different periods popping out of his bathroom, one by one. Will he be able to stop this madness before anyone else finds out?

videos.title: Jobs
videos.overview: Until they find a way to get back to their original time periods, the time travellers in Bala’s place decide to find jobs in today’s world. Can they safely land in sustainable jobs, despite their quirks and limitations?

videos.title: Midnight Masala
videos.overview: Rubbishing a delicacy that Killi prepares at home, the housemates decide to go out for dinner. Unfortunately, the city shuts down due to the sudden death of a politician. As they hunt for food around the city through the night, back home Killi is looking for someone to test his delicacy on. Who ends up getting what they wanted?

videos.title: Adhaan Plan!
videos.overview: Bala’s family arm-twists him into meeting a girl for the prospects of marriage. In view of his American Dream, Bala decides to kill every possibility of getting married. Bharathi and the housemates, arrive at a ‘brilliant’ plan to help Bala create a bad impression on the girl. But the gods have their own plans!

videos.title: Crush Next Door
videos.overview: Hannah loses heart to Kabir- a stranger, the moment she meets him at the apartment elevator. When Kabir later visits Bala’s apartment asking for a favor, Hannah goes out of the way to hold him back and make an impression. As she starts going overboard, her conscience pops out to question her. How much of her nature would she compromise to impress Kabir?

videos.title: Shrooms
videos.overview: Killi by mistake consumes magic mushrooms (hallucinogen) stored secretly at his restaurant by his assistant. When he reaches home he starts hallucinating that the house is a battlefield; that he is a warrior of the Cholan army, and that the housemates are from the enemy camp. As he locks the door, the housemates have no choice but to play along until they find a way to get out.

videos.title: Run Buggy Run!
videos.overview: During a heated argument in their office, Bala challenges his macho colleague Britto, that Buggy would beat him at the upcoming office marathon. With no rhyme or reason, Buggy suddenly gains a crazy fan following, and the housemates put immense pressure on him to train for the marathon. Could any of this affect the ever so emotionless Buggy?

videos.title: Bottle Neck
videos.overview: When Bala’s work-from-home session is marred by Hannah’s music audition video shoot, he reacts in a fit of rage and accidentally spoils her voice forever. With the main music event scheduled for the very next day, Hannah is unable to come to terms with her pathetic new voice. Will Bala be able to make up for his mistake in time and salvage the mess for Hannah?

videos.title: Horoscope
videos.overview: Bharathi reads out the horoscope of all the housemates for the day, and it says that Bala would ‘meet the woman of his life’. Buggy being a rationalist, challenges to prove the horoscope wrong. Luckily for Bala, the office party is on that very evening and he might find ‘the woman’ there. Now, to what lengths would Buggy go to beat the stars?

videos.title: Flush Out
videos.overview: Bharathi finally manages to create a time machine for the housemates to get back to their original time periods. She starts off by testing it on herself. Does it work? Do the other time travellers in the house risk it too? How happy would Bala feel to see his friends off forever?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Lafangey - Sapne, Dosti, Duniya
_verifiedMetadata.description: Lafangey is a heartwarming story about three childhood friends—Chaitanya, Rohan, and Kamlesh—who live in a small colony in Noida. Now grown up, they each face the struggles of adult life while trying to hold on to their dreams. The show beautifully captures their friendship, problems, and how they try to find their place in the world. Chaitanya is clever and sharp, but he often finds himself in moral confusion. He has completed his B.Tech and wants to make his parents proud. However, when life doesn't go as planned, he gets attracted to the idea of making fast money through illegal sports betting. His decisions bring problems at home and make him question what real success and respect mean.

videos.title: Unwanted
videos.overview: Episode 1 introduces the chaotic world of Chaitanya, Rohan and Kamlesh. Chatty quits his thankless job and decides to wait for his result. Rohan struggles to find a job, a job he so desperately needs to move in with his girlfriend, Ishita. In a rather hilarious altercation with Chatty, Kammo is made to face some harsh truths and is left wondering if he can make it as an actor.

videos.title: Roti Kapda Makaan
videos.overview: Episode 2 sees Kammo, Chatty, and Ronny vow to change their lives. Chatty deliberates on an unethical way to make quick money for his family, and Kammo auditions for a web series, seeking 'inspiration' from the talented Subodh. Ronny, desperate, becomes a salesman, clashing with his brother Satish. The episode closes with the trio feeling a hint of success.

videos.title: Aarzoo
videos.overview: In Episode 3, Chatty starts paying off a big loan with money from cricket betting. Kammo faces shame when his betrayal is exposed on set, leading to an argument with his father. Rohan, now living with Ishita, finds their dream life crumbling, prompting a realization that he needs to improve himself.

videos.title: Tyaag
videos.overview: In Episode 4, Chatty is lured into betting for fast cash despite risks. Rohan and Ishita's problems worsen, leaving them distant. Kammo reconciles with his father but faces a tough choice when he bags an ad film in Mumbai. During Diwali, when it's time for friends and families to gather, all three feel more alone than ever, facing tough decisions.

videos.title: When It Rains, It Pours
videos.overview: In Episode 5, Kammo faces harsh realities in Mumbai and debates returning home for his sick father. Chatty, deep in betting, earns big but remains estranged from his family. Rohan attempts to revive his fading relationship with Ishita, but a harsh talk changes everything. Ultimately, Chatty faces the consequences, Kammo is torn between dreams and duty, and Rohan faces hard truths about himself.

videos.title: Ghar
videos.overview: In Episode 6, Rohan strives to regain his job and become more independent, while Kammo rethinks his priorities after receiving unexpected advice. Chatty faces a deep crisis, prompting friends and family to unite for his rescue. The season concludes with the trio reflecting on the lessons learned.

In a city that only rewards the polished, Abhijeet realises the real race has just begun.

videos.title: Dating Radius: 2 KM
videos.overview: Haunted by an old heartbreak, Abhijeet tries to build the perfect life - dream house, dream date, dream image - even hosting a house party to impress. But when a small lie spirals out of control, he's forced to face a harder truth: some lies don't stay small for long.

videos.title: Bosses From Hell
videos.overview: Old wounds push Abhijeet and Garima to question the small lies we tell to survive. As friendships crack and hidden games come to light, they must decide: in chasing success, what part of themselves are they willing to lose?

videos.title: Pehli Kamai Pehla Kand
videos.overview: Abhijeet's first paycheck brings celebration, freedom, and a taste of the life he always dreamed of. But as the high wears off, he and his friends are reminded - some moments lift you higher than ever before, only to change everything the next second.

videos.title: D Se Dosti, D Se Dhokha
videos.overview: Abhijeet's need to prove himself pushes him to make a selfish move - and it costs him more than he imagined. As friendships shatter and regrets build, he's left facing a brutal truth: in chasing success, sometimes you end up standing alone.

videos.title: Alladin Ka Credit Card
videos.overview: Ostracised after his selfish move, Abhijeet decides he doesn't need anyone. Chasing validation, he buys his way into a new life with Manisha. But as the nights get louder and the bills heavier, Abhijeet begins to learn - you can fake everything, except feeling less alone.

videos.title: Internet Wala Love
videos.overview: Abhijeet's dream life starts to crack. As fake friendships slip away and mounting credit card debt closes in, a cruel betrayal forces him to face the truth: you can outrun people, but not the loneliness - or the lies you built around it.

videos.title: Account Balance: Zero
videos.overview: Crushed by debt, broken friendships, and the threat of losing his home, Abhijeet faces the life he built - and the terrifying question of what's left when it all falls apart.

videos.title: You're Fired
videos.overview: Abhijeet rebuilds his life from scratch - friendships, trust, and a shot at something real. But when layoffs hit Fusion Funds, he's left fighting for the one thing he can't afford to lose again: a future he finally started believing in.

videos.title: Dil Dosti Data
videos.overview: As the final layoffs approach, Abhijeet, Garima, Shruti, and Saurav fight to prove they belong. But when everything hangs on one list, survival isn't just about being good - it's about holding on when it feels easiest to let go.

videos.title: Life Upgraded
videos.overview: Abhijeet faces heartbreak - until loyalty, luck, and a little rebellion give him a second chance. As old dreams collapse and new bonds form, a wild night of celebration leaves everyone asking: after everything they've fought for, what does winning even look like now?

videos.title: Kiss Wala Love
videos.overview: When a scandal threatens Fusion Funds, Abhijeet and Garima find unexpected comfort in each other. But love isn't always enough - and when Abhijeet is forced to choose between what he feels and what he knows, the cost is a goodbye neither of them wanted.

videos.title: Ek Raat Ki Girlfriend
videos.overview: A job offer, a risky choice, and a desperate request bring Abhijeet and Garima back into each other's orbit. What starts as a lie to save face slowly turns into something neither expected - because sometimes, pretending is how you stumble into something real.

videos.title: Bali Ka Bakra
videos.overview: Garima and Abhijeet finally find each other - just as a new storm brews at Fusion Funds. As dark secrets rise and old alliances crack, Abhijeet doesn't know he's being set up for a fall. Sometimes, just when you think you've made it, the real fight begins.

videos.title: Executive Floor Pe Aapka Swagat Hai
videos.overview: Just when life starts to fall into place, Abhijeet's oldest rival strikes. As betrayal hits closer to home than he ever imagined, Abhijeet must decide: fight for what's his, or lose the dream he thought he'd already won.

videos.title: Tera Yaar Hoon Mai
videos.overview: As Abhijeet fights for his family and Shruti breaks free to choose her own future, Saurav uncovers a secret that could shatter everything. Old battles end, but new wars begin - and this time, surviving might not be enough.

videos.title: Kuch Dost Saanp Bhi Hote Hain
videos.overview: When Abhijeet and the team uncover a devastating secret, they risk everything to expose the truth - but not everyone stands by their side. As betrayal hits closer than they ever imagined, they're left facing a harsher reality: some dreams don't survive the people chasing them.

videos.title: Pyar Paisa Profit
videos.overview: After exposing HeartLocal, Abhijeet and the team finally taste victory. But just as the future looks bright, an old enemy returns with a bigger game. With new battles ahead, the question isn't whether they've won - it's whether they're ready for what's coming next.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Karthika Deepam
_verifiedMetadata.description: The show revolves around Karthika, an orphan adopted by Kannan, a farmer, who struggles with various stereotypes and the challenges she faces while falling in love.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Black, White & Gray - Love Kills
_verifiedMetadata.description: Truth is never black or white. A high-profile case of serial killings takes an unexpected turn when forbidden love and deception come into play. In a world where love can kill, uncovering the truth is more dangerous than ever.

event.name: Kull: The Legacy of the Raisingghs

_verifiedMetadata.name: Kull: The Legacy of the Raisingghs
_verifiedMetadata.description: A dysfunctional royal family implodes with the death of their diabolical patriarch. Now, the three surviving Raisingghs battle it out for power and kingship.

videos.title: A Royal Murder
videos.overview: Raja Raisinggh's grand 60th birthday brings the entire royal family of Bilkaner together. But a shocking murder rocks the palace, and cracks in the regal facade begin to show.

videos.title: Rajwaadi Reet Pe Sarkari Chaku
videos.overview: The palace is sealed, and the police begin their hunt. A bloodied knife, a torn saree… and all eyes turn to Raisinggh's children - Indrani and Abhimanyu. Who is hiding the truth?

videos.title: Blood Ties, Broken Lies
videos.overview: A CIB officer is assigned to investigate, but the royals continue to play by their rules. The officer finds many clues pointing to Indrani Raisinggh. Could she really be behind it?

videos.title: Inheritance of Violence
videos.overview: Secrets from the past surface. As the real motive is revealed, the Raisinggh siblings must choose between justice and power. Loyalties are tested.

videos.title: A New Death, A New Secret
videos.overview: The family tries to move on as they celebrate leasing the palace. But tragedy strikes again - another murder, another cover-up. Can they ever escape this cursed legacy?

videos.title: Return of the Curse
videos.overview: Five years later, the siblings meet for Abhimanyu's wedding. With Indrani's political career crumbling and Kavya's marriage at risk, secrets begin to unravel. A new heir emerges.

videos.title: Haramzada Shahzada
videos.overview: Brij's revenge begins, affecting Abhimanyu's wedding, Indrani's image, and Kavya's loved one. The family has never been more fractured... or more dangerous.

videos.title: Kaun Jamoora, Kaun Madari
videos.overview: The walls are closing in. With pressure mounting from every side, the Raisingghs are forced to fight for survival. To reclaim power, a sacrifice must be made. But who will it be?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Khauf
_verifiedMetadata.description: Madhu moves into a hostel in Delhi to start afresh, but her room hides a sinister presence that begins to get stronger each day, alarming the other women on her floor. They know what the room hides and desperately want her gone before it is too late for them all.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Kill Dill - The Heartbreak Club
_verifiedMetadata.description: Kisha's search for her missing sister leads her to The Heartbreak Club, a shadowy campus organization. With help from charming captain Tavish, she delves deeper into a web of dangerous secrets.

videos.title: Dii, I'm Coming!
videos.overview: When Kisha arrives at Fair High International in search of her missing sister, a cryptic trail leads her to The Heartbreak Club—a secretive, mysterious college society. She tries to get their attention , only to realise some doors, once opened, don’t close without a cost.

videos.title: Dead End
videos.overview: As Kisha digs deeper into her sister’s disappearance, Tavish offers a glimpse into campus life—and something darker beneath it. The Heartbreak Club makes its presence known, and the people she trusts may not be what they seem. Then, just when she thinks she’s found a lead… everything spirals.

videos.title: She's Alive!
videos.overview: Reeling from a brutal encounter, Kisha is told by the heartbreak club, that they aren't responsible for Anara's disappearance. She questions everything—including her reason for staying. But just as she’s ready to walk away, a shocking clue pulls her back in. With new alliances and a dangerous plan in motion, she edges closer to the truth… or deeper into the trap.

videos.title: Black Handshake
videos.overview: As the walls close in, Kisha finds herself being watched, cornered, and tested. Every move is a risk, every choice a trap. To stay ahead of The Heartbreak Club, she’ll have to do the unthinkable—and the cost may be someone she cares about- Tavish.

videos.title: BFF Or Bae?
videos.overview: Torn between her growing feelings for Tavish and the mission that could lead her to Anara, Kisha makes a choice that could cost her everything. As Ahaan lets her in, Tavish pulls away—caught between trust and betrayal. And somewhere far from Fair High, a chilling truth is revealed.

videos.title: The Heartbreak
videos.overview: Kisha sets her plan in motion, but the night takes a turn no one saw coming. As secrets surface and lines are crossed, hearts break in ways that can't be undone. By morning, everything has changed—and Kisha is left more alone than ever.

videos.title: Who's The Bishop?
videos.overview: Cornered by failure and betrayal, Kisha is running out of time—and allies. As new clues surface and old connections rekindle, she makes a bold move to expose the truth. But some games don’t end with checkmate… they end with sacrifice.

videos.title: Save The Queen
videos.overview: Clues lead Kisha closer to the truth—but just as one piece falls into place, another slips away. A stolen symbol, a familiar hoodie, and a face she never expected bring the past crashing back. By the end of the night, she’s left with one chilling realization: the person who hurt her was someone she trusted.

videos.title: Click Click Click!
videos.overview: Desperate for answers, Kisha strikes a risky deal to uncover the identity of THC’s leader. When she sneaks into the secret meeting, one small sound from the shadows changes everything. The truth isn’t just close—it’s personal.

videos.title: Check Mate
videos.overview: Kisha finally learns the truth and finds her sister—but not everything is as it seems. As old secrets come out and new ones take their place, Kisha is forced to face an impossible choice. To save one person she loves… she might have to lose another.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Guri Dhairya Ki Love Story
_verifiedMetadata.description: Guri and Dhairya were always there for each other—friends who had each other’s backs through thick and thin. But somewhere along the way, friendship turned into something deeper and love found them in the most unexpected way.

videos.title: Rajendra Nagar Ke Rishte
videos.overview: An unexpected reunion in an auto-rickshaw brings Guri and Dhairya back together. After leaving UPSC, Guri is now managing his father's cattle feed business while aspiring to start his own venture. Meanwhile, Dhairya is deeply invested in her NGO work. Their paths cross unexpectedly, rekindling an old friendship and setting the stage for a beautiful new chapter.

videos.title: Ex-Best Friend Ki Ex
videos.overview: Dhairya's surprise visit to Guri's factory creates an awkward situation, but their story takes a new turn at her NGO. Meanwhile, in the present, Guri's younger brother Manu and his wife Anju visit Delhi. They see how different Guri and Dhairya's life is from their own in Karnal. Will this visit bring the brothers closer?

videos.title: Pyaar Dosti Hai
videos.overview: Guri meets Dhairya's family for the first time, but things don't go as planned. Dhairya's father disapproves of her work at the NGO, and Guri is caught in the middle of an old family trauma. In the present, Guri clashes with Bhogal Uncle over his lunch van, but with Dhairya's help, he learns how to make things right again.

videos.title: Bro Code Ka Kya?
videos.overview: Guri and Dhairya's Delhi trip becomes a turning point. While she walks confidently into her UPSC interview, Guri stumbles through an investor meeting. Insecurity hits and emotions surface leading to an unexpected confession about Abhilash.

videos.title: Phir Chali Kahani
videos.overview: Dhairya clears IRS, but her heart lies elsewhere, and Guri finally finds the courage to confess his feelings in the most unexpected way. And somewhere in between all this madness love happens, the finale brings closure... and a new beginning!

_verifiedMetadata.name: Kanneda
_verifiedMetadata.description: Against the backdrop of 1990s Toronto, a Punjabi singer's journey from street performer to rising star leads him into dangerous territory.

videos.title: Assin Munde Aan Punjab De!
videos.overview: Nimma, a Punjabi immigrant, dreams of making it big in Canada. But when racism shatters his hopes, he’s pushed to the wall. Can he fight back and reclaim his future?

videos.title: Welcome to Kanneda!
videos.overview: Nimma joins Sarab’s gang and rises fast. Rawat plants a mole to take down the cartel, but his plan unravels with a devastating blow

videos.title: Ready for the Big Game?
videos.overview: Rawat struggles after a failed sting. The Chinese gang wages war against Sarab. Nimma proves his loyalty again but at a steep cost.

videos.title: Dekh Dahad Tu Shera Di!
videos.overview: With Sarab underground, Nimma becomes Rawat’s prime target. Risking it all, Nimma dares to go rogue with the cartel, sparking chaos.

videos.title: Desiya da Daur!
videos.overview: Nimma flies high, taking control of the business in Sarab's absence. A bitter fallout between them leads to Rawat arresting Sarab.

videos.title: Darr se Daroge Toh Roz Roz Maroge!
videos.overview: Nimma is attacked by assassins. In jail, Rawat plays mind games with Sarab, coaxing him to reveal the bigwigs of the game.

videos.title: I am Still Around, B**ch!
videos.overview: Nimma wakes from a coma only to confront chaos, addiction and betrayal. A murder and an accidental death set him on a path of no return.

videos.title: Kanneda se Canada ki Doori!
videos.overview: Sarab escapes from jail. Tension peaks as Nimma and Sarab come face to face, each hungry for vengeance.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Khakee: The Bengal Chapter
_verifiedMetadata.description: When upright cop Arjun Maitra takes on Kolkata's feared don Bagha and his henchmen, he must battle a broken system and navigate bloody gang wars.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Loot Kaand
_verifiedMetadata.description: Two desperate siblings in rural India plan a simple bank heist, but their scheme unravels when it connects to a decades-old weapons scandal, forcing them to face dangerous criminals and hidden truths.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Don't Fly Too Much
_verifiedMetadata.description: A high-flying comedy where Goldie, a privileged heir in disguise as Gopal, navigates crazy crew antics, wild passengers, and in-flight chaos to prove his worth!

videos.title: Goldie’s Flight to Chaos Begins
videos.overview: Goldie’s birthday bash turns tragic when his tycoon dad dies mid-flight. Now heir to Air-Aasman, he must juggle a double life as a steward with chaos, love, and turbulence.

videos.title: Mystery in the Air, Panic on Board
videos.overview: A mysterious note threatens to reveal Gopal’s secret! As he investigates mid-air, he suspects his quirky crew, but a mid-flight chaos could be the thing that blows his cover.

videos.title: Sabotage in the Skies
videos.overview: An Air-Aasman inspection triggers Shilpa's sinister plot, forcing Gopal to sabotage the crew's evaluation. Torn between guilt and ambition, can he follow through?

videos.title: Shilpa’s Mind Games
videos.overview: Chaos erupts as Shilpa's mind games lead the crew toward failure! Anees loses a baby mid-flight, Liza’s ex crashes in, and mayhem takes over the plane.

videos.title: Lights Camera Sabotage Shilpa
videos.overview: A guilty Gopal teams up with the crew for a comedic covert operation to take down Shilpa. With fake roles, secret schemes and increasing tension, will they succeed?

videos.title: Zhople in the Air
videos.overview: A sleepwalking billionaire boards and the crew must prevent him from waking up or risk Air Aasman shutting down! One wrong move and it’s game over. No pressure.

videos.title: Gopal Will Handle It
videos.overview: New boss Gopal wants respect. Touchy and Anees just want their families to behave. Guess who wins? Chaos checks in before take-off.

videos.title: The Flight Club
videos.overview: With family antics in full swing and a charming new passenger catching Kajal’s eye, the cabin crew faces their toughest shift yet.

videos.title: Sometimes It's Goldie, Sometimes It's Gopal
videos.overview: Just as Goldie faces the axe, a twist makes him a star. Chaos hits when Shilpa enters his cabin, forcing him to juggle Goldie and Gopal to keep his lies alive.

videos.title: Kajal's Love, Gopal's Conflict
videos.overview: Love's in the air literally! Kajal's romance with Vikram leaves Gopal and Anees panicking. With spying, suspicion and stuck landing gear, the flight turns hilariously bumpy.

videos.title: Problem in Landing, Love in Chaos
videos.overview: A landing gear failure throws the crew into chaos as Gopal leads a daring fix while tension builds and Kajal and Vikram grow closer by the minute.

videos.title: Gopal’s Love, Goldie’s Fear
videos.overview: Goldie and Ferrero dodge Shilpa as she pushes for a comeback from suspension, nearly exposing Goldie's secret. Later, Goldie tails Kajal’s date to uncover Vikram’s secret.

videos.title: Is There Anyone on This Flight?
videos.overview: Eerie mishaps start when Jagteshwar Baba boards, blackouts, ghostly whispers. Coincidence or curse? Gopal and the crew must face their scariest flight yet.

videos.title: Ghostbusters: Air-Aasman
videos.overview: Fear spreads in flight as scary instances shake everyone. With strange sounds and Baba’s warnings looming, the Air-Aasman crew must confront a mystery too eerie to ignore

videos.title: Love, Dinner and Betrayal
videos.overview: Kajal’s dreamy dinner with Vikram turns into chaos as Gopal Anees and Ferrero go full spy mode to expose Vikram's hidden agenda as love lies and loan papers collide

videos.title: Support Dog and Sinking Hearts
videos.overview: Kajal’s heartbreak hits the skies as the crew scrambles to cheer her up just as a pampered dog and his eccentric owner spark mid-flight madness

videos.title: Love Soars in the Skies
videos.overview: A vlogger’s mid-air proposal turns chaotic as love clashes with subscribers. Gopal gets Dadzu's advice while the crew faces romance rejection and reel madness.

videos.title: Reel vs Real Romance
videos.overview: As Nayan sulks after rejection, the crew shares heartbreak stories with mixed results. When the captains play love gurus, the turbulence turns into full comedy.

videos.title: Thookpatti Gang's Attack: Part 1
videos.overview: A mysterious mess spreads panic at the airport. The crew suspects the return of the infamous Thookpatti Gang, and chaos is imminent.

videos.title: Thookpatti Gang's Attack: Part 2
videos.overview: The Thookpatti Gang strikes mid-air. With jobs and dignity at stake, the crew launches a high-flying hunt to stop the chaos.

videos.title: Can You Guess Kajal’s Plan?
videos.overview: All Kajal wants is to meet Rockstar Dildeep Singh. A delayed flight and airport chaos threaten her plan. Will destiny help her live her ultimate fangirl moment?

videos.title: Tear It Like It’s Hot
videos.overview: A mid-air fashion disaster with Instafamous Aisha Nihalani’s torn skirt throws the crew into chaos, turning panic into hilarious slapstick moments.

videos.title: The Story of Gopal's House
videos.overview: The crew demands a party at Gopal’s. Pressured, Gopal and Ferrero fake a middle-class life with scripted stories and fake parents to keep their secret intact.

videos.title: Is This a Party or a Riot?
videos.overview: As Gopal’s fake family tale teeters, surprise guests arrive, lies unravel, and chaos erupts. Will he manage the mess or watch his charade crumble completely?

videos.title: The Wedding Party on Board: Part 1
videos.overview: Duggal and Chaddha blackmail Goldie into hosting a sky-high wedding. But with the wedding party onboard and secrets bubbling, one thing's clear—this flight’s headed for chaos.

videos.title: The Wedding Party on Board: Part 2
videos.overview: As the in-flight wedding party turns chaotic, Gopal scrambles to survive Duggal's demands, a missing heirloom, and the looming threat of losing his job.

videos.title: The Relationship Is New, the Sky Is the Same: Part 1
videos.overview: As Ammi and Lovely Chachi clash, Gopal tries to impress Kajal. To win her heart and Flight Attendant of the Year, he’ll need some Rajni-style swagger.

videos.title: The Relationship Is New, the Sky Is the Same: Part 2
videos.overview: Gopal tries to impress Kajal with flair as Ammi and Lovely’s clash turns chaotic. Shilpa’s secret bets raise the stakes. It’s Rajni’s lesson against pure madness.

videos.title: Crisis in the Air for Gopal
videos.overview: With the award at stake, an onboard crisis becomes a true test for Gopal. Things spiral when Goldie's ex-girlfriend unexpectedly shows up during the flight.

videos.title: All Eyes on Gopal and Goldie
videos.overview: Gopal faces sabotage and emotional chaos. As tensions rise mid-air, will Goldie soar or stumble under pressure?

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Waking of a Nation
_verifiedMetadata.description: ‘The Waking of a Nation' explores the events surrounding the Jallianwala Bagh massacre through the eyes of Kantilal, a fictitious member of the Hunter Commission. When General Dyer orders his troops to open fire at a gathering in Jallianwala Bagh, Kantilal takes it upon himself, with his life under threat, to uncover the dark conspiracy that led to the massacre.

videos.title: Kaala Qanoon: A Dastardly Act
videos.overview: In April 1919, as protests against the Rowlatt Act sweep through Amritsar, Punjab’s British administration decides to exploit the people’s anger to its advantage. Childhood friends Kantilal, Hari, and Allahbaksh meet after years. In December 1919, Kantilal Sahni decides to lay the truth bare at the Hunter Commission despite a threat to his life.

videos.title: Danga: Anatomy of a Riot
videos.overview: Following the arrest of popular leaders Dr. Satyapal and Dr. Kitchlew, and a British firing on Indian protestors, Amritsar spirals out of control. Riots engulf the city and tear into the friendship between Kantilal and Allahbaksh, while innocent British civilians are placed at the mercy of the mob.

videos.title: Marham: A Healing
videos.overview: In April 1919, British officer Major Macdonald’s sensitive handling of the situation restores peace in Amritsar. His approach annoys Punjab’s administrators, who want to use force against the native population. In December 1919, Kantilal receives an unwelcome visitor with a subtle agenda, and he is made an offer that he might find hard to refuse.

videos.title: Qahar: The Massacre
videos.overview: Even as General Reginald Dyer threatens Amritsar with a promise of violence, a devious plan is hatched to draw the unsuspecting public to Jallianwala Bagh. The general leads his troops into the Bagh to unleash terror on the city’s innocent. As casualties mount, Kantilal and Allahbaksh set aside their differences to mourn the loss of a friend.

videos.title: Saazish: The Conspiracy
videos.overview: In April 1919, Amritsar reels under the effect of General Dyer’s brutal repression of civilian rights. In December 1919, a murder and a shocking revelation stir Kantilal’s conscience. At the inquiry, Kantilal finds holes in General Dyer’s testimony and proves that the general lied before the Commission.

videos.title: Shaatir Khiladi: The Ringmaster
videos.overview: As Kantilal draws a noose around General Dyer, the actual perpetrators of the massacre risk being exposed. But in a masterstroke, the tables are turned on Kantilal as a damning secret surfaces. Shamed and shunned by his own people, Kantilal resolves to fight back and unmask the mastermind.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Dupahiya
_verifiedMetadata.description: Dhadakpur, the Belgium of Bihar, is on the cusp of celebrating 25 years of being crime free. But chaos strikes when a never-seen-before motorbike, that was purchased as a wedding gift gets stolen 7 days before the ceremony! The journey taken by the bride's family and ex-lover to find the Dupahiya forms the heart of this comedy, which explores the hopes and aspirations of simple people.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Dabba Cartel
_verifiedMetadata.description: In VivaLife Society, men and women lead parallel lives - one caught in a pharma investigation, the other in drug peddling through a dabba delivery business.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Crime Beat
_verifiedMetadata.description: Small-town crime journalist Abhishek finds his life and career affected by a fugitive gangster. As he gets trapped in a web of lies and motives, what price will he pay- to become a renowned reporter?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Oops Ab Kya
_verifiedMetadata.description: An accident during a medical check-up changes Roohi's life completely, she must face whatever fate has in store for her.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Pyar Ka Professor
_verifiedMetadata.description: A seduction coach with a body count of 99 women decides to pursue the beautiful wife of a menacing politician for his 100th; only to realize that his 5 step 'Pyar Ka Professor' plan leads him to discover the one thing he's always run away from, love.

videos.title: Peacocking
videos.overview: Vaibhav has a few rules which the men have to follow in order to win a woman over. He meets a woman named Mallika who he is instantly attracted to and he tries his ways to woo her.

videos.title: Disqualification
videos.overview: Vaibhav remembers that he had slept with Anamika a few years ago and she is also in the same team as him.

videos.title: Qualification
videos.overview: Anamika gets to know about Vaibhav's classes on "Womanipulation" through her brother who is Vaibhav's student. She wants to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Escalation (Physical)
videos.overview: Things get complicated as Vaibhav agrees to help Pankaj impress Mallika. Vaibhav uses Pankaj to get some alone time with Mallika.

videos.title: Escalation (Emotional)
videos.overview: Mallika finally gets satisfied in her dream but by Vaibhav and not Pankaj. She wakes up disturbed and meets Ridhi to discuss.

videos.title: F - Close
videos.overview: Malika is about to meet Vaibhav. Alone. In a hotel room. Pankaj finds out.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Pyaar Testing
_verifiedMetadata.description: Dhruv and Amrita, potential marriage partners, decided to live together before the wedding to test their compatibility. As they spend time together, the question arises that whether they develop romantic feelings between them.

videos.title: Rishta Confirmed Ya Rejected?
videos.overview: Dhruv and Amrita meet as they help their closest friends elope. Soon, they meet again as prospective partners in an arranged marriage. While Dhruv agrees to the match, Amrita has an unusual condition.

videos.title: Shaadi Pending, Live-In Trending
videos.overview: Amrita almost calls off the alliance with Dhruv when she finds he is a hardcore non-vegetarian. Dhruv decides to give up meat for the live-in period, and all’s well.  But is it?

videos.title: Bach Gaye, Par Phas Gaye
videos.overview: Amrita and Dhruv manage to convince their parents of their innocence. The two return home and find a shocking secret about Dadi. The couple finally finds a moment of bonding.

videos.title: Pyaar Ka Double Shot
videos.overview: Dhruv’s day has a rough start, and Amrita lends a helping hand. Later, Dhruv spends his time with Amrita’s family, and everything goes well until Dadi’s secret comes out.

videos.title: Dil Ya Deal?
videos.overview: On a particularly difficult day, Dhruv makes a poor decision and ends up violating an important rule from the contract. Will he ever confess this to Amrita?

videos.title: Kya Pyaar Abhi Baaki Hai?
videos.overview: A fight between Amrita and Dhruv leads to them ending the contract. While they try going back to their normal lives, Amrita agrees to another marriage proposal. Is this the end for Amrita and Dhruv?

videos.title: T&C Removed, Pyaar Approved
videos.overview: Amrita and Dhruv finally realise that love means never having to impose terms and conditions on one’s partner. The families also admit that the trial period isn’t all that bad.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Bada Naam Karenge
_verifiedMetadata.description: Rishabh and Surbhi, two young individuals, find themselves at the crossroads of an arranged marriage. The story unfolds in two timelines: one in Mumbai, in the past, and another in Madhya Pradesh, where their families meet. In Mumbai, they find themselves alone in his room due to the lockdown, creating a pivotal moment in their relationship. In the present, Rishabh is hesitant to reveal his past with Surbhi to their families, his being a much more traditional one, fearing disapproval.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Medical Dreams
_verifiedMetadata.description: Three NEET aspirants from diverse backgrounds pursue medical dreams at Allen, guided by Biology teacher Subrat Sinha. Their journey shows resilience and growth while preparing for India's challenging medical entrance exam.

videos.title: 53% Pe Medical Ki Tayyari
videos.overview: Shree steps into Kota with a dream bigger than her reality and meets Dhwani and Samarth on the same road to NEET. But is courage enough when the odds are 53%?

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Secret Of The Shiledars
_verifiedMetadata.description: A secret society unravels a hidden treasure belonging to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, with Rajeev leading the quest to protect it from falling into wrong hands, ultimately becoming the chief of the Shiledars.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Roshans
_verifiedMetadata.description: This documentary series chronicles the trials and triumphs of Bollywood's iconic Roshan family — musician Roshan Lal Nagrath, Rajesh, Rakesh and Hrithik.

videos.title: Even If We Are Not There…
Little we have, a bit more is needed
Didn’t know where I was going

_verifiedMetadata.name: Ek Farzi Love Story
_verifiedMetadata.description: Two contrasting worlds collide when an aspiring content creator Kritika and social media-averse CA, Manav find themselves stuck together thanks to an unexpected encounter. A viral video of their unique banter becomes the foundation of an unconventional partnership, where they have nothing in common, common except the fact that they agree to disagree on everything. As they become unlikely best friends offline, they pretend to be a fake couple online for the sake of their followers, who perceive them as a couple and as their fandom explodes they become an internet sensation.

videos.title: Kiss Me Manav!
videos.overview: Kritika, an aspiring content creator, and Manav, a CA with creative side hustles, meet at a creator event in Chandigarh. A chance encounter leads to a viral video, thrusting them into the spotlight. As their unexpected fame grows, they must navigate their contrasting personalities and values, questioning their choices. Can they find common ground, or will their story fizzle out before it begins?

videos.title: Anti-Friends
videos.overview: Kritika ropes Manav into a chaotic collaboration, sparking a unique 'anti-friendship.' Just as she starts finding her groove, a brand backlash threatens everything. Can Kritika salvage her dream, or will it all come crashing down?

videos.title: Experiment Fail Ho Gaya
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav navigate the chaos of a viral meme, testing their unconventional bond. As Kritika battles self-doubt and Manav wrestles with his own past, unexpected truths surface. Just as Kritika starts to reclaim her voice, a startling discovery threatens to change everything. What happens next?

videos.title: Just Friends
videos.overview: Manav helps Kritika re-start her social media account, forming an unexpected friendship. But just as Kritika begins to reclaim her voice, a shocking twist changes everything. What's next?

videos.title: Best Friends
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav's friendship is tested as they navigate a personal crisis and a high-stakes brand collab. A misunderstanding spirals into chaos, leaving their bond hanging by a thread. Can they weather the storm together?

videos.title: Nayi Aashiqui
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav's lives spiral after their followers start to think they are a romantic couple online. While Kritika struggles with public perception, Manav's growing bond with Samara complicates matters further.

videos.title: Reel Love Story
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav battle the decision of faking a romantic relationship online as they offline love lives get involved in the situation. Will they choose offline love or online fame? what will the loose if they choose the other?

videos.title: Collab Hi Collabs
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav juggle rising fame, personal dilemmas, and a tempting Maldives opportunity. While Manav debates his future in content creation, Kritika's world shatters with an unexpected setback. Can they handle the fallout, or will it change everything?

videos.title: Red Flags
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav's bond grows, but secrets about Samara and Deven create new problems. With tough choices ahead, everything could change.

videos.title: Asli Love Story?
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav deal with big career choices and changing relationships. After a fight with Deven, Kritika starts questioning her feelings for Manav. Is this the start of something new, or is it too late?

videos.title: Pyar Ki Maa Ki
videos.overview: Kritika faces a professional and personal storm as her social media account’s suspension threatens her content career, while her complicated dynamics with Manav and Akshat unravel. With secrets exposed and decisions looming, will they salvage their identities or let their crafted lives crumble?

videos.title: Best Birthday Gift
videos.overview: Kritika battles to revive her content, while Manav faces burnout and hidden feelings. His surprise return sparks their leap into full-time creation - but will it lead to triumph or chaos?

videos.title: More Than Best Friends?
videos.overview: Manav steps into the spotlight with his face reveal, sparking a whirlwind of online fame and brand opportunities, while his bond with Kritika deepens in unexpected ways. But as the line between real and fake love blurs, Manav faces a startling realization - does he truly love Kritika, or is it all just part of the act?

videos.title: Ek Tarfa Pyaar
videos.overview: A high-pressure ad shoot tests Manav and Kritika’s partnership. As lines blur, one question remains - can their partnership survive the cracks forming beneath?

videos.title: Baat Bigadh Gayi
videos.overview: Their careers hit rock bottom after a betting app scandal, pushing Kritika and Manav’s friendship to the edge. As tensions rise, will they fix what’s broken or lose everything for good?

videos.title: Tanha Safar
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav’s world turns upside down when rumors of their fake relationship ignite a social media frenzy. As their reputation crumbles, can they regain control, or will the backlash destroy everything they’ve built?

videos.title: Partnership Over
videos.overview: After a brutal fight, Manav decides to walk away for good. Left with no choice, they agree on one last campaign - will this mend their bond or break it forever?

videos.title: Jaane Nahi Dungi Tujhe
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav share a kiss during a staged shoot, but the moment stirs something real in her. Will she face her feelings or keep them buried?

videos.title: She Loves Him Too!
videos.overview: Manav and Kritika finally confess their love for each other, but Manav’s doubts about her sincerity lead to a heartbreaking fallout. As he walks away, Kritika is left devastated - can their relationship withstand this moment of truth?

videos.title: Ek Asli Love Story
videos.overview: Kritika takes the blame as their fake relationship is exposed, and Manav, despite his resentment, fights to protect her career. But with everything laid bare, is this the end of their story or the start of something real?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Black Warrant
_verifiedMetadata.description: A newly appointed jailer at Tihar Prison confronts widespread corruption and injustice within its walls, forcing him to choose between maintaining the status quo or fighting for reform.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Agra Affair
_verifiedMetadata.description: Akash struggles to save his family's crumbling hotel while pursuing his dream restaurant. He falls for tour guide Tanvi, but their romance faces hurdles. Akash's path intertwines with Megha's, leading to a poignant story of love, ambition.

videos.title: Mujhse Partnership Karoge
videos.overview: With the unusual tactics of running Hotel Aalishan exposed to his father, Aakash seeks to repair the damage. In this quest, he crosses paths with Tanvi, a tourist guide, leading to an unprecedented collaboration.

videos.title: Tum Mile Dil Khile
videos.overview: As Aakash's and Tanvi's partnership flourishes, overcoming several challenges, Aakash realizes his feelings for Tanvi. However, his family protests against the partnership, recalling a past bitter experience that led to his father's heart attack, and expressing concerns about his involvement with a girl.

videos.title: Tum Se Tu Tak
