videos.overview: Mannat and Dhairya suspect that Arzoo planned against Dua to remove them from Vikrant's life. Elsewhere, Yashika and her fake parents act innocent and create drama to trap Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat's Plan Unfolds
videos.overview: Mannat tells Yashika about her agreement for Vikrant's wedding catering. Additionally, Dhairya and Mannat plot to install a camera in Arzoo's room and stage a drama.

videos.title: Vikrant's Attachment to Neetu
videos.overview: Dua shares her concern for Neetu and appreciates Vikrant. At the hospital, Vikrant becomes emotional and reminisces about his memories with Neetu after seeing her.

videos.title: Vikrant Stands by Mannat
videos.overview: Everyone applauds Mannat's singing at Yashika's henna ceremony. Vikrant feels guilty about his actions and stands up for her when Yashika's mother tries to humiliate her.

videos.title: Dua's Sneaky Move
videos.overview: Dua cleverly unlocks Arzoo's room and manages to place a hidden camera. Elsewhere, Neetu grows emotional seeing Vikrant comfort Dua and decides to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Dhairya, Mannat Spy on Arzoo
videos.overview: Dhairya and Mannat monitor Arzoo's activities after placing a hidden camera in her room. Then, Neetu tells Ronny that Vikrant and Dua visited her while she was unconscious.

videos.title: Arzoo Confronts Dhairya
videos.overview: Mannat recalls her wedding memories while choosing a dress with Yashika. Arzoo sparks tension by questioning Dhairya for entering her room without consent.

videos.title: Dua Comes to Mannat-Dhairya’s Rescue
videos.overview: Dua’s timely arrival saves Mannat and Dhairya from big trouble. Further, Vikrant feels a special connection with Dua, while Aishwarya raises suspicions about Mannat.

videos.title: Mannat's Truth Unravels
videos.overview: Neetu goes missing as she tries to reveal the truth to Vikrant. Mannat's secret slips out, leading to shocking revelations and her decision to expose Arzoo with proof.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Will Aarambhi Save Mannat?
videos.overview: Mannat fails to expose Arzoo's truth and plots to deceive Vishakha, while an angry Vishwas throws Aarambhi out of his life. Soon, Aarambhi spots a car rushing toward Mannat!

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Uplift Each Other
videos.overview: Mannat and Aarambhi share their struggles and pain, draw strength from each other, and resolve to fight together for their children's safety and a secure future.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat and Aarambhi Unite
videos.overview: Vishwas throws Aarambhi out, but she fights back legally. As Mannat spirals in fear, she turns to Aarambhi for help to expose Arzoo's dark secrets.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Dua's Drama Deceives Vikrant
videos.overview: Aarambhi gains courage from Dhairya's words and decides to fight for Vihaan. Dua and Dhairya stage a drama to stay in the competition, and Vikrant agrees.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Yashika Invites Tandons
videos.overview: Dhairya discloses to Mannat that he plotted Vishakha's allergy as a ploy to stay at Vikrant's place. Yashika invites the Tandons to her wedding with Vikrant.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Steal Spotlight
videos.overview: The Tandons arrive at Vikrant and Yashika's Sangeet. Mannat and Aarambhi dance together joyfully, and later Mannat makes Vishwas realise Aarambhi's importance.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Aarambhi Outsmarts Avantika
videos.overview: Dhairya, Aarambhi, and Mannat plot to get Arzoo admitted to the hospital, while Aarambhi smartly pushes Avantika to handle the party responsibilities to impress the Saluja family.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat and Aarambhi's Master Plan
videos.overview: Mannat and Aarambhi attempt to alter Arzoo's lab reports to reveal her true identity as Aishwarya. They plan to make Arzoo's health condition seem serious without harming her.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat's Faith in Aarambhi
videos.overview: Aarambhi decides to attend her doctor's license renewal interview despite the risks. Mannat encourages her and diverts Yashika's attention when she tries to spy on them.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Aarambhi's Gratitude to Mannat
videos.overview: Aarambhi feels thankful to Mannat for sending Vishwas out of the interview cabin. When Dimple blames Aarambhi for party issues, Mannat tries to expose Avantika.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Raj Uncovers Manmeet's Truth
videos.overview: Aarambhi is praised, but Arzoo suspects Mannat's manipulation. Raj is shocked by Manmeet's kidney donation, while Avantika fumes and hosts a grand cocktail party.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat's Plan Targets Arzoo
videos.overview: As the cocktail party begins and couples dance, Mannat and Dhairya move forward with their plan against Arzoo. Meanwhile, Avantika slyly cuts Aarambhi's dress on the dance floor.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Arzoo's Collapse Sparks Chaos
videos.overview: Mannat and Aarambhi's plan succeeds when Arzoo suddenly collapses, causing panic. Accusations rise as tensions explode among everyone.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Yashika, Vikrant's Wedding Drama
videos.overview: As Vikrant and Yashika clash over cancelling the wedding, past love between Vikrant and Mannat resurfaces. Meanwhile, Aarambhi alters Arzoo's medical reports, leaving her in shock.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Outplay Arzoo
videos.overview: Raj promises Manmeet to keep her kidney donation a secret from Aarambhi. Arzoo unknowingly walks into Mannat and Aarambhi's trap after Malla is found to be an incompatible donor.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Vikrant's Heart Gets Divided Again
videos.overview: Vikrant's emotions spiral as Dua's arrival sparks joy, leaving Mannat hurt and furious. As truths unravel, Aarambhi's secrets fuel intense drama.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat Trapped in Arzoo's Plot
videos.overview: As Mannat faints, Malla and Vishakha lock her in a trunk as per Arzoo's plan, leaving Dhairya and Aarambhi worried. Soon, Yashika and Vikrant begin their wedding rituals.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat Fights Fate Amid Chaos
videos.overview: As Harry prepares for Arzoo's surgery, Mannat's shocking discovery puts her in danger. Amid chaos, Vikrant's wedding rituals continue, but Aarambhi's arrival changes everything.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Dhairya Fumes at Vishakha
videos.overview: Aarambhi informs Vikrant that Mannat has been kidnapped and blames Arzoo and Malla. Dhairya lashes out at Vishakha, demanding that she reveal Mannat's whereabouts.

videos.title: Race Against Time to Find Mannat
videos.overview: Arzoo feels happy to learn that Mannat is a suitable liver donor. Aarambhi, Dhairya, and Vikrant struggle to trace her location, while Dua records proof against Vishakha.

videos.title: Mannat Fights Back
videos.overview: As Mannat's escape turns into a deadly chase, Dhairya risks everything to protect her while enemies close in from all sides. Yashika kidnaps Dua while Mannat takes a bold stand.

videos.title: Vishakha Blackmails Mannat
videos.overview: As Ronny and Bunty search for Dua, Vishakha and Yashika abduct Dua to threaten Mannat. Vikrant fights fiercely with the goons to protect Mannat.

videos.title: Vikrant and Mannat Strike Back
videos.overview: Vikrant breaks down and angrily confronts Vishakha for joining hands with Arzoo. Soon after, Mannat blackmails Arzoo by pointing a gun at Malla, demanding Dua's release.

videos.title: Bunty Helps Dua
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant capture Malla to trace Dua, only to find Dhairya injured and unconscious. Bunty distracts Vishakha and rescues Dua, while Vikrant pays ransom to Arzoo.

videos.title: Vikrant Seeks Forgiveness
videos.overview: Racked with guilt, Vikrant pleads for Mannat's forgiveness. Yashika cleverly steers Ronny away to keep her secret support for Mannat hidden.

videos.title: Dua's Life in Danger
videos.overview: Vikrant confides in Mannat about his unexplained bond with Dua. Tensions rise as Arzoo seizes Dua and pushes her off a cliff before fleeing, leaving everyone devastated.

videos.title: Arzoo Faces Mannat's Wrath
videos.overview: Vikrant and Dhairya team up to save Mannat and Dua from a cliff. Later, Mannat stops Arzoo's car and confronts her to avenge Shruti's death.

videos.title: Vishakha Drops the Bombshell
videos.overview: Malla and Yashika fear Vikrant and Mannat's wrath after Arzoo's death. Meanwhile, Vishakha exposes Yashika's role in Dua's kidnapping, leaving Vikrant and Mannat shocked.

videos.title: Mannat's Reunion Plan
videos.overview: Vikrant recalls his actions against Neetu and Ronny and regrets about it. Mannat decides to reunite Vikrant with them after seeing his regret.

videos.title: Vikrant Seeks Forgiveness
videos.overview: Vikrant apologises to Ronny, expressing regret for his actions. Mannat confides in Dhairya that she will hide the truth that Vikrant is Dua's father.

videos.title: Ronny's Advice to Mannat
videos.overview: Neetu promises Ronny to keep Dua's identity secret from Vikrant. Ronny advises Mannat on life and relationships, urging her to remove herself from Vikrant's life for peace.

videos.title: Dhairya's Ultimatum to Vikrant
videos.overview: Dhairya warns Vikrant not to interfere between him and Mannat. Malla tells Yashika to leave, declaring that Vikrant's heart still belongs to Mannat.

videos.title: Vikrant, Neetu's Emotional Reunion
videos.overview: Neetu and Ronny are overwhelmed with memories as they enter the Saluja mansion. Vikrant, filled with regret, apologises to Neetu, leading to a heartfelt reunion.

videos.title: Yashika's Deadly Move
videos.overview: At Baisakhi, Yashika secretly sets hay ablaze and pushes Mannat into the fire. Vikrant risks his life, leaping into the flames to save her.

videos.title: Neetu's Secret Plan
videos.overview: Mannat tends to Vikrant's wounds. Neetu vows to expose Dua's truth before Vikrant, prompting Dhairya to grow suspicious of her plan for Dua's DNA test.

videos.title: Dhairya Fears Losing Dua
videos.overview: Tension rises as Neetu suddenly collapses, while Yashika suspects that Neetu is hiding a secret. Dhairya fears losing Dua if Vikrant learns that she is his daughter.

videos.title: Vikrant Discovers Dua's Truth
videos.overview: Vikrant is stunned to learn that Dua is his daughter, while Mannat uncovers Neetu's plot to ensure Vikrant learns it. Dua requests Vikrant to accompany her home.

videos.title: Neetu Vows to Reunite the Family
videos.overview: Neetu vows to reunite Mannat, Vikrant, and Dua. Moments later, Mannat warns Vikrant that he has no right over Dua, as he abandoned her and their family in the past.

videos.title: Dua's Emotional Confession
videos.overview: Neetu strongly urges Vikrant to fight for his rights over Dua as his daughter. Later, an emotional Dua tearfully opens up to Vikrant about her deep bond with Dhairya.

videos.title: Vikrant's Plea to Dhairya
videos.overview: Vikrant pleads with Dhairya for a chance to watch Dua grow from afar. Mannat kindly asks Vikrant to stay away and let them live independently.

videos.title: A Shock for Dhairya
videos.overview: Ronny guides Mannat as she faces a dilemma over choosing Vikrant or Dhairya as Dua's father. Mannat shocks Dhairya by revealing that Vikrant has filed for Dua's custody.

videos.title: Dhairya Doubts Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat is shaken to learn that Vikrant has filed for Dua's custody, sparking tension at home. While Neetu defends Vikrant, Dhairya grows furious and doubts Mannat's intentions.

videos.title: Yashika's Secret Plot
videos.overview: Vikrant opens up to Yashika about the custody case, but her hidden agenda begins to influence him. As Mannat lashes out and vows to keep Dua, tensions escalate within the family.

videos.title: Mannat Fights to Save the Dhaba
videos.overview: Mannat Khanna joins Mannat Juneja to save the dhaba from demolition. Meanwhile, Kabir helps a child in trouble as the Junejas celebrate Seema's anniversary.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Khoj - Parchaiyo Ke Uss Paar
_verifiedMetadata.description: Ved searches for his missing wife Meera, experiencing bizarre events and clues that blur reality. As a skeptical cop questions him, Ved doubts his sanity, wondering who Meera truly is and what sinister secrets lie beneath.

videos.title: Woh Kaun Thi
videos.overview: Ved’s life unravels on his birthday when his wife, Meera, goes missing. While searching for her, he deals with a dismissive police officer and a shocking revelation about his wife’s identity.

videos.title: Kaun Hai Meera
videos.overview: Ved denies Meera’s claims of being his wife, even when she provides intimate details about the two. Meera’s intentions get questioned when she’s caught adding a mysterious powder to Ved’s coffee.

videos.title: Aar Ya Paar
videos.overview: Ved discovers a shocking mark on Meera. He brings Tia to identify her and, after a face-off with Mrs. Fernandes, ultimately accepts Meera—meanwhile, Ved interrupts Amol at his door.

videos.title: Chupa Pehlu
videos.overview: Ved suspects Meera and decides to investigate. He arranges a DNA test and enlists Devraj to monitor her actions. Soon, he discovers secret codes and learns about mysterious meetings at a cafe.

videos.title: Nehle Pe Dehla
videos.overview: Devraj steals Meera’s purse and gives it to Ved, who discovers troubling information about himself. Meera takes him to a doctor, who suggests tests to uncover the truth behind his memory loss.

videos.title: Aakhri Raasta
videos.overview: Ved experiences disturbing flashes after the MRI. His medical reports reveal serious mental health issues. Meera sends a divorce lawyer. Meanwhile, Ved realises Tia is missing from the hostel.

videos.title: Kahaani Uss Raat Ki
videos.overview: An angry Ved attacks Meera after he learns that she is the one who took Tia away. However, he gets arrested by Amol. What are the charges against Ved?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Moonwalk
_verifiedMetadata.description: Moonwalk follows two thieves, Tarik Pandey and Maddy Kapoor, as they go head-to-head to steal the heart of a local heartthrob, Chandini Lakhani. Their rivalry and competition lead to dangerous yet hilarious consequences and something far more valuable...and out of this world- a piece of rock from the Moon that lands on Earth!

_verifiedMetadata.description: The story of the legendary poet in Emperor Krishnadevaraya's court who uses his timely wit and intelligence to solve even the trickiest problems and becomes very popular in the King's court.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Karate Girls
_verifiedMetadata.description: Fireworks fly when Komal (a tough, underprivileged, problem teenager) is made to join Karate coaching to deal with her anger issues. There, she meets Abha (the Principled Coach’s non-serious, social media-savvy daughter), who has her own reasons to strive to become the best student and impress her father.

videos.title: Matter Ho Gaya
videos.overview: A spat with local boys prompts the police to visit Komal’s house. Noticing her anger issues and responding to her mother’s desperate pleas, the policewoman decides to give Komal another chance. Meanwhile, Abha struggles to juggle college, building a social media profile, and attending her father’s karate classes.

videos.title: Sensai Please!
videos.overview: Komal and Abha realize that karate could be the answer to all their problems, so they decide to set their differences aside and convince Sensei Ajay to let them participate in the upcoming NKFT.

videos.title: Dil Dosti Viral
videos.overview: As the rigorous training for NKFT continues, a friendship begins to bloom between Abha and Komal, with Vicky’s support. Meanwhile, Ajay struggles to balance the pressure from a loan shark with preparing for NKFT.

videos.title: Kauva Ya Mor?
videos.overview: Komal joins Firebolt Dojo and discovers that JD’s karate methods are brutal and ruthless, while Abha finally opens up to Ajay about her true career aspirations.

videos.title: Haath Mat Laga
videos.overview: After months of rigorous training, obstacles, and setbacks, Navodaya Dojo finally arrives at NKFT to compete against Firebolt Dojo and other contenders.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Namriti
_verifiedMetadata.description: Namriti has been mysteriously found dead and ruin starts occurring in Sarpgrah. Namriti's soul unravels the mystery of her death and the cause of Sarpgrah's chaos.

videos.title: Namriti's Death
videos.overview: The residents of Sarpgrah receiving the news that Namriti's dead body has been found by the water fall. Nobody knows how the death had happened, Astrologers calculates that Namriti's soul will come back with the intent of ending the lives of her killer.

videos.title: The New Beginning
videos.overview: Namriti is an average young 19 year old student freshly out of her local government college where she meets an stranger who seems to take a liking to Namriti's enticing beauty.

videos.title: Kaal Naag
videos.overview: In the vast ruins of Vishgrah, a new form takes the form of an poisonous and powerful icon- Kaal Naag. To retaliate for the ruins of his Serpent Realm (Vishgrah), is bent down on ruining and causing chaos in Sarpgrah once again. Gurus and Astrologers in Sarpgrah go on a deep meditation period to figure out the solution to face the upcoming danger.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Mohrey

videos.title: Dushman Ka Dushman Dost Hota Hai!

_verifiedMetadata.name: Heartbeats: Pyaar aur Armaan
_verifiedMetadata.description: Heartbeats is a hospital drama that follows Akshat as he pursues his dream of becoming a neurosurgeon while navigating a budding romance with Sanjh, a "nepo kid" from a family of doctors.

videos.title: Pehla Case, Pehla Pyaar, Pehla Siyappa
videos.overview: In lockup, Akshat recalls his internship days with fellow interns Rishi, Pulkit, Ruchi, and his rival-turned-interest, Sanjh. When they're assigned to assist a stubborn politician, a mishap lands them in near-legal trouble. Akshat, however, uncovers the true cause of the issue. Will his insight save them from facing the consequences?

videos.title: Dengue and Heartache
videos.overview: Akshat reflects on his rocky history with women and his growing interest in Sanjh, who remains distant. Sanjh feels pressured by her family's strict oversight, leading to a tense exchange when Akshat playfully teases her about her background. Amid a dengue outbreak at the hospital, Akshat connects with a patient's son, seeing a glimpse of himself in the young boy.

videos.title: Doctorgiri vs Herogiri
videos.overview: Akshat fakes an emergency to bypass insurance delays, convincing a hesitant Sanjh to help after she's touched by the family's bond. The interns pitch in their stipends, but Dr. Sandip warns them against playing heroes, emphasizing professional boundaries. Later, Pulkit surprises Ruchi with a hospital date, while Rishi and Dr. Chetna grow closer.

videos.title: The Toughest Call
videos.overview: Dr. Chetna regrets her moment with Rishi, frustrated by his ongoing flirting. Akshat and Sanjh must inform parents of a child's low survival chances, sparking a clash over honesty vs. hope. In surgery, Ruchi and Pulkit struggle due to Pulkit's lack of focus, raising tensions. Sanjh ultimately offers the parents false hope, complicating things. Stay tuned!

videos.title: You Look Handsome
videos.overview: Dr. Ananda reprimands Sanjh and Akshat for lacking essential doctor skills. Meanwhile, Ruchi and Pulkit manage pediatrics, discovering young Agasthya faked his pain. Later, Sanjh and Akshat advise a critical child's family on end-of-life decisions but urge them to remain hopeful. At Dr. Sandip's party, his tense past with Chetna surfaces, as Sanjh and Akshat grow closer.

videos.title: The Accidental Date
videos.overview: At the club, Sanjh and Akshat bond over drinks, with Akshat confessing he misses his mom and Sanjh surprising him with her charm. Meanwhile, Ruchi and Pulkit clash over an inappropriate patient, and Rishi and Chetna's romance faces tension. At the hospital, Mr. Chaddha opens up about his personal life, complicating their workday.

videos.title: Moral Compass
videos.overview: Mr. Chaddha has gonorrhea and insists the doctors keep it secret from his wife, Komal, frustrating Sanjh. Dr. Sandip warns her about confidentiality. Komal gets aggressive with her husband, and Rishi steps in to comfort her, discovering her injury is from Mr. Chaddha. Sanjh confesses her feelings for Akshat, while Rishi reveals the truth to Komal.

videos.title: Supply Room
videos.overview: Sanjh offers to help Akshat after his long shift, but when he invites her for coffee, she thinks he likes her. Ruchi tells her she’s being illogical. Akshat later agrees to provide a fake medical certificate for Anirban, motivated by Rishi. Sanjh learns about this, gets furious, and confronts him, risking their relationship.

videos.title: Confusion & Chaos
videos.overview: A senior doctor catches Akshat in the supply room, but he and Sanjh manage to cover up the fake medical certificates. Grateful for her help, Akshat hugs Sanjh, strengthening their bond. Meanwhile, Chetna and Rishi's relationship remains physical, leaving Rishi disappointed. Dr. Sandip finds the fake certificates and threatens Akshat.

videos.title: Struggle Ki Aaadat
videos.overview: Akshat is anxious as he faces Dr. Sandip, trying to avoid punishment for his fake medical certificates. To his relief, Sandip agrees not to punish him if Akshat praises him in front of Sanjh. However, Sanjh grows frustrated with Akshat's constant talk about Sandip. In a confrontation, she reveals she doesn't want to date Sandip but actually wants to go on a date with Akshat.

videos.title: Chalaang
videos.overview: Akshat reveals to Sanjh that Dr. Sandip asked him for a favor, so she arranges a meeting with her mom. As Akshat thinks about asking Sanjh out, he seeks advice from Rishi and Pulkit. Dr. Sandip impresses Sanjh's mom in the meeting but faces criticism over hospital fees. Chetna’s therapist hints she may have feelings for Rishi, which she denies.

videos.title: Meri Selection Ho Gai
videos.overview: Sanjh pauses, turns to Akshat, and finally says yes to his date proposal, leaving him thrilled. The next day, Mr. Bakshi arrives, and Rishi warns everyone to hide as he's a frequent visitor with no real issues. Sanjh reassures him and prescribes placebos. Meanwhile, Rishi flirts with Chetna and asks her out, while Dr. Sandip and Chetna discuss their past.

videos.title: Triple Date
videos.overview: Mr. Bakshi starts having seizures, and Dr. Sandip rushes to help, questioning Sanjh about the placebo she prescribed. Panicking, Sanjh runs away and hides in the washroom, crying. Sandip consoles her, easing her anxiety and reassuring her that she'll be a great doctor. Meanwhile, Akshat's remarks upset Sanjh, and Ruchi and Pulkit's date turns serious.

videos.title: Anxiety
videos.overview: Sanjh walks away, but Akshat follows her. Later, at the hostel, Rishi reveals he's seeing Dr. Chetna, but his friends don't believe him. Sanjh and Akshat meet over tea, and she opens up about her anxiety struggles. They're then assigned to the cancer ward, where they meet Shivansh, a boy who wants to celebrate Diwali. Akshat promises to help him burst crackers despite the risks.

videos.title: Time Kam Hai, Worth It Bana
videos.overview: Akshat and Sanjh are fighting over his promise to a cancer patient, which Sanjh believes is dangerous. Despite their argument, the interns praise Akshat for bringing smoke-free crackers, impressing Sanjh, but she remains upset. Dr. Sandip punishes them with 16-hour shifts. Rishi discusses Sanjh's anxiety with Akshat, who mistakenly reveals he told Rishi, causing more tension between him and Sanjh.

videos.title: The Sabotage
videos.overview: Dr. Ananda warns interns this is their last chance for an LOR and scholarship. Akshat and Sanjh become highly competitive. Rishi and Akshat prank Sanjh, tricking her into congratulating Dr. Ananda for a fake pregnancy. In revenge, Sanjh gives Akshat a sedative, making him miss his project deadline. Biji submits it for him but then collapses.

videos.title: Life or Death
videos.overview: Biji ignored her symptoms, hoping she'd recover on her own. When her condition worsened, Akshat felt guilty. The interns worked tirelessly to find a heart donor, but hope faded when a match fell through. Biji's son, angry, slapped Akshat. Later, he apologized. Everyone gathered by Biji's side; she awoke briefly, shared one last story, then passed away peacefully.

videos.title: Press Pause
videos.overview: Ananda gives a moving speech on Biji's passing, acknowledging her impact on everyone. Sanjh, emotional, admits she feels like a 'nepo kid' and Akshat comforts her. Later, she bonds with Dr. Sandip, who confides in her. When a critical patient's emergency contact is found to be Dr. Sandip, they find him unconscious. Pulkit and Ruchi perform a procedure, and Sandip later walks in.

videos.title: The Breaking Point
videos.overview: Dr. Sandip admits to being on sedatives and alcohol, feeling trapped in a rat race, and resigns, seeking a break. Ananda accepts his decision, bidding him farewell. Pulkit sees Sanjh’s name on the LOR list, sparking Akshat’s anger. He accuses Sanjh of nepotism, leading to a heated exchange. However, Ananda names Akshat as the best intern, with a surprising twist yet to come!

videos.title: The Day Akshat's Dream Shattered
videos.overview: New season begins at Veridian Super Speciality Hospital, Bhopal. Akshat remains a workaholic doctor who's forgotten life beyond the hospital, while Rishi tries to bring him back to the real world. Saanjh's return forces him to confront their past, Aditya's presence fuels tension. With interns Nayantara, Pooja & Kaushik joining, money and medicine soon collide behind the polished facade.

videos.title: She Trusted His Gut, Not The Reports
videos.overview: Akshat struggles between his feelings for Saanjh and Aditya's growing presence in her life. A tough case forces the young doctors to unite, reminding Akshat why he chose medicine. Rishi and Nayantara's bond deepens beyond attraction, while Pooja gets drawn to Samar. Meanwhile, Akshat begins to see the gap between the ideal hospital he envisioned and the reality of Veridian.

videos.title: He Was In Love With Her First
videos.overview: Akshat grows closer to Saanjh but realises Aditya isn't leaving, turning rivalry personal. Rishi & Nayantara's flirtation deepens, while Pooja and Samar slowly connect despite complications. At Veridian, Akshat notices expensive treatments pushed over cheaper options. Khurana justifies it as world-class care, leaving Akshat impressed yet increasingly uncomfortable and conflicted

videos.title: Is This Even A Date?
videos.overview: A patient under Jeevan Suraksha gets a huge hospital bill, shocking Akshat since treatment was supposed to be covered under the scheme. He confronts Khurana, who quietly cancels it but warns Akshat to focus on treating, not billing. Akshat lets it go for now. Meanwhile, Aditya finally asks Saanjh out, further complicating things between her and Akshat.

videos.title: Two Dates, One Broken Heart
videos.overview: Akshat struggles to understand what Saanjh wants while Aditya becomes more protective of her. Rishi and Nayantara find their casual relationship harder to keep casual. Pooja sees a softer side of Samar, although he keeps his personal life separate from work. At Veridian, doctors are increasingly encouraged to consider revenue alongside patient treatment.

videos.title: This Isn't My Home Anymore
videos.overview: Akshat and Saanjh work on the same case and their old chemistry returns. Aditya becomes insecure as he sees them grow closer. Rishi and Nayantara try to define their relationship but avoid calling it one. Pooja touches a nerve when she asks Samar about his personal life. Akshat also sees another troubling link between medical treatment and money at Veridian.

videos.title: Told To Stay Away From Her
videos.overview: Rishi and Nayantara insist their relationship is only physical, but their chemistry keeps bringing them back together. Akshat becomes more proactive in pursuing Saanjh, while Aditya feels threatened and makes a mistake trying to compete. Pooja tries to make peace with Samar. Akshat also begins seriously questioning Khurana when an expensive treatment is presented as the only option.

videos.title: She Asked Him, Not Aditya
videos.overview: Akshat helps Saanjh find a new house, bringing them closer. Aditya asks Saanjh to move in with him, but she says she has already asked Akshat for help. Rishi and Nayantara decide to stop sleeping together but cannot stay apart. Samar's personal problems affect Pooja. Veridian launches its cosmetology wing with Khurana and the MLA, while a Jeevan Suraksha patient is denied the scheme benefit.

videos.title: A Car He Could Never Give Her
videos.overview: Akshat and Saanjh begin to feel like a real couple, but Aditya refuses to step away. Saanjh questions whether the relationship her mother wants for her is what she truly wants. Rishi and Nayantara struggle to define a normal relationship. Pooja and Samar grow closer despite his fears. Akshat connects the Jeevan Suraksha cases and suspects that the problem is not isolated.

videos.title: The Party That Ended In Blood
videos.overview: The tension between Akshat, Saanjh and Aditya begins affecting their work. Saanjh is torn between her feelings for Akshat and her family's expectations, while Aditya becomes more desperate to keep her. Rishi and Nayantara remain complicated, and Pooja and Samar struggle with their age and hierarchy difference. Akshat still trusts Khurana, but doubts about Veridian are becoming harder to ignore.

videos.title: I Love You, Please Wake Up
videos.overview: After an emotional confrontation, Saanjh drives away and suffers a serious accident. Akshat finds her and stays with her as her condition deteriorates. As her vitals crash, he finally admits that he loves her. Saanjh responds by squeezing his hand and slowly regaining consciousness.

videos.title: Suspended For Trying To Help Her
videos.overview: Saanjh survives but is not cleared to return to work. She begins psychiatric counselling and confronts the emotions she has kept controlled. Akshat and Aditya keep their distance, while Rishi and Nayantara try to remain professional after ending their casual relationship. Saanjh admits she was running from her feelings, which helps her receive medical clearance and return to the hospital.

videos.title: She Finally Admits Why She Crashed
videos.overview: Saanjh returns to work but remains emotionally unsettled. Akshat wants to celebrate her return, but she struggles with the aftermath. Aditya continues presenting himself as the safer choice. Rishi and Nayantara realise their feelings are becoming serious, while Samar and Pooja grow closer despite his fears. Akshat's doubts about Veridian's financial practices continue to grow.

videos.title: Their Sabzi Mandi Almost - Kiss
videos.overview: Akshat and Saanjh finally talk, but they want different things from their relationship. Saanjh wants control over her own life, while Akshat wants clarity. Dr Arora tries to control Saanjh's choices again, but Saanjh draws a line with her mother. At the hospital, Akshat begins looking more closely at the money behind Veridian Cares.

videos.title: Their First Kiss, At The Charity Ball
videos.overview: The emotional distance between Akshat and Saanjh grows, and Akshat suspects she may know more about Khurana's activities than she admits. Aditya uses the uncertainty to get closer to her. Rishi and Nayantara struggle to behave like a normal couple. Samar remains afraid of being judged for his feelings for Pooja. Veridian's charity initiatives look increasingly suspicious to Akshat.

videos.title: The Trap Is Being Set
videos.overview: The Veridian Cares charity ball presents Veridian as a hospital for people who cannot afford treatment. Akshat believes the money will help patients like the driver's daughter. Behind the celebration, the funds are redirected to cover hospital losses. Akshat begins to understand that the charity is not what it appears to be, while doubts about Saanjh's loyalties affect their relationship.

videos.title: An Offer He Couldn't Refuse
videos.overview: Akshat discovers that Veridian Cares funds have been used elsewhere and new patients are no longer accepted under the scheme. The driver's daughter is among those denied treatment. Furious, Akshat realises the charity ball solved nothing. Aditya offers to help find another doctor for the girl, briefly bringing the rivals together, but Akshat knows the problem is bigger than one patient.

videos.title: Locked Down And Framed
videos.overview: An outbreak creates chaos at Veridian and pushes the doctors to their limits. Akshat investigates the Veridian Cares money while the medical team works long hours. Rishi and Nayantara try to discuss their relationship honestly. Samar realises fear of judgement is costing him his relationship with Pooja. The crisis pushes all three love stories toward a breaking point.

videos.title: Her Family's Hospital Is For Sale
videos.overview: The outbreak forces Veridian into lockdown. Akshat continues tracing the scheme money. The driver's daughter's condition worsens and the hospital refuses to spend more on treatment. Akshat sees the scale of what Khurana and the MLA have been doing. Saanjh begins investigating after realising Akshat may be right, while Aditya must confront the truth he knew more about than he admitted.

videos.title: One Gunshot Changes Everything
videos.overview: Akshat is ready to leave Veridian, Bhopal and possibly medicine. Before he can resign, the driver returns with a gun and takes everyone hostage, demanding treatment for his daughter. Saanjh finds proof of Khurana's financial fraud and gives it to Akshat despite the risk. She ends her relationship with Akshat, while Aditya admits the truth. Rishi supports Nayantara and Samar chooses Pooja.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Paithani
_verifiedMetadata.description: Godavari, an artisan, is globally famous for her handmade Paithani sarees. When she decides to retire, her daughter sets out to get her the gift of a lifetime - the last Paithani she wove.

videos.title: Phir Se Hui Subah Hai
videos.overview: Godavari, a skilled weaver, crafts magnificent Paithani sarees despite her deteriorating eyesight. Her daughter, Kaveri, is a school teacher who dreams of gifting her mother the last saree she weaves.

videos.title: Dhagon Ke Bol
videos.overview: Kaveri takes a loan for the Paithani and places an advance order. However, when the order is misplaced, Kaveri’s grandmother steps in to recover the lost money with a selfless act.

videos.title: Main Paithan Se Hoon
videos.overview: Kaveri’s efforts to recover the Paithani order lead her to the vendor who misplaced the order. She decides to go to Mumbai to sort out the issue. Although hesitant, Godavari gives her blessings.

videos.title: Sherni Hai Wo Sherni
videos.overview: Kaveri’s journey in Mumbai is full of setbacks when she loses her phone. However, her determination helps her find the phone back and get close to finding the other person who made the order.

videos.title: Sapne Aur Hunar
videos.overview: Kaveri tries to get in touch with Vinay Bhanushali, the other person who has ordered her mother’s Paithani. Back home, Godavari worries about her daughter’s well-being.

videos.title: Hum Dharohar Manne Wale Log Hai
videos.overview: Kaveri tries to convince Vinay to return the payment for the Paithani she wanted. Meanwhile, Godavari faces a dilemma when she receives an order for a modern design for the saree.

videos.title: Viraasat
videos.overview: Kaveri faces a dilemma when her brother gets into an accident, and she struggles to gather funds for his treatment. Meanwhile, Godavari decides to personally deliver the saree she has woven for Vinay.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Freedom at Midnight
_verifiedMetadata.description: Freedom at Midnight is the electrifying story of India's struggle for independence. Based on the bestselling book of the same name, it recounts the partition of India and Pakistan, and the religious and socio-political dynamics of the era.

videos.title: Direct Action
videos.overview: At the cusp of Independence, leaders from the Congress and the Muslim League meet with Viceroy Wavell in Simla to discuss the Cabinet Mission Plan of 1946. Will the two opposing parties agree on a common future?

videos.title: Sole Spokesman
videos.overview: The aftermath of Direct Action Day places the Muslim league on the inside of the Interim Government formed by the Congress. The coalition causes disharmony at the parliament, jeopardising the governance. In London, Prime Minister Attlee looks for a new viceroy.

videos.title: Satyagraha
videos.overview: As India welcomes a new viceroy, who is going be her last, Gandhi heads to Noakhali on a peace mission. The Mountbattens must juggle interests of the Congress, Muslim League and the Princely States while being objective.

videos.title: Punjab
videos.overview: In the wake of the resignation of the CM of Punjab, the province becomes a political battleground. With communal tensions rising across the country, the Congress is compelled to seriously consider partition.

videos.title: The Last Straw
videos.overview: Mahatma Gandhi meets the Mountbattens and suggests that Jinnah be given Prime Ministership to keep the nation undivided. Will his core allies - Patel and Nehru - agree?

videos.title: Poorna Swaraj
videos.overview: While drafting the Transfer of Power plan for Independent India, V.P. Menon struggles to accommodate the Congress’s need for Poorna Swaraj and the British demand for Dominion Status.

videos.title: Eclipse
videos.overview: Viceroy Mountbatten invites key political leaders of India to come together to present the Transfer of Power plan. However, Mahatma Gandhi abstains from attending the meeting.

videos.title: Borders Of Blood
videos.overview: As independence nears, Sir Cyril Radcliffe is handed the monumental task of drawing the borders to partition a land he knows nothing about. Congress and Muslim League leaders feverishly speculate over which town will fall on which side of the border, as communal tensions continue to flare across the country.

videos.title: Tryst With Destiny
videos.overview: India and Pakistan prepare for their respective days of independence, but the celebrations are fraught with tension and violence. India steps into a new era at the midnight hour, but partition and the division of the army loom large.

videos.title: Exodus
videos.overview: The Boundary Award is announced, igniting outrage on both sides. Gripped by fear, a mass exodus of minorities across the border begins as Nehru and Patel grapple with the consequences of partition. Punjab descends into chaos and horror while Gandhi tries to save Bengal from the same fate. And one refugee vows revenge against the Mahatma.

videos.title: Basket Of Apples
videos.overview: Sardar Patel, V.P. Menon, and Lord Mountbatten strategically approach the various princely states to solidify their accession into India. But the Nawabs and Maharajas of some states refuse to accede without a fight.

videos.title: Kashmir
videos.overview: A tribal invasion into Kashmir instigates the first war between India and Pakistan. Amid the tension in the war-room, Nehru and Patel form opposing views on how to find an end to the war.

videos.title: The Last Fast
videos.overview: Gandhi announces a fast unto death to help restore some semblance of peace between the two communities, and nations. Nehru and Patel have a falling out over the state of the country. Madanlal Pahwa and his allies make their way to Delhi to carry out their sinister plan.

videos.title: Hey Ram!
videos.overview: Gandhi deals with the growing rift between Nehru and Patel. An unknown gunman makes his way to the daily prayer meet held at Birla House. The nation is forced to confront its grief.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Magic of Shiri
_verifiedMetadata.description: In 1996 Delhi, globalization shuts down Shiri's family business and due to insurmountable pressure, her husband leaves home. Left alone and penniless with her kids, she flouts all social norms to become a stage performing magician. In an era when everyone believed that women can’t stand on their own, she did.

videos.title: I Am So Magical
videos.overview: It's the delightful time of 90s Delhi. Meet the cheerful and charming Shiri Shroff, whose world revolves around her husband Naveen and 2 kids. When Naveen's business goes bust, she is shell shocked when he takes a life altering decision that threatens to destroy her blissful family.

videos.title: Idiota Kusok
videos.overview:
Shiri decides to pursue her childhood dream of becoming a stage-performing magician. She joins a magic troupe as a simple assistant, where she meets yesteryears' great magician Jadugar Saleem. While a cruel twist of fate has made Saleem lose his love for life, will Shiri be able to

rekindle his passion and make him teach her the tropes?

videos.title: DSP
videos.overview:
While Saleem begins to find a way to showcase the new budding performer, the owner of the magic group, Viktor tells Shiri a devastating truth - women can't be magicians. While she tries to grapple with the world turning against her, she is devastated by a stunning decision made by

her own daughter.

videos.title: Sapna Hai Ya Maksad?
videos.overview: Shiri runs pillar to post to bring her daughter Mini back home, who believes Shiri is responsible for her father leaving. Shiri is helped by a strange man Akash who sees her financial struggles and offers her a job. Shiri's father-in-law Jigar tries to bring Naveen back to re-unite the family.

videos.title: Saajan
videos.overview: Running a scam to raise money, Saleem sets up funds and a show for Shiri. But Shiri's new job has begun to offer her comfort and she is in two minds about pursuing her dream. While she contemplates her next step, a startling revelation about the ever so helpful Akash stuns her.

videos.title: Asli Jadugar
videos.overview: Shiri stumbles upon a trick which she believes can put her on the map - the dreaded 'Canon Ball Act' which nobody had successfully performed in the last two decades. She sets on the journey to find the great magician who last did it, but soon hits a roadblock as she learns only an 'Asli - Jadugar' (extra ordinary mastermind) can track him down.

videos.title: Toofan
videos.overview: While the meeting with an ace magician Toofan makes her doubt her whole decision to pursue this path, her past comes back to haunt her. With everyone telling her to give up on her dream, will she succumb to the pressure or rise to the occasion?

videos.title: Dastan-E-Kabul
videos.overview: At the Grand Magic Marathon, Shiri's first real performance comes under threat as her nemesis Viktor is determined to make her fail by any means possible. While in her personal life, lines have been drawn for a legal battle with Naveen.

videos.title: Husnapari
videos.overview: Tired of being at the receiving end of everyone's betrayal and threats, Shiri decides to take back the reins of her life. Her tit-for-tat actions put her at loggerheads with her closest associate Saleem.

videos.title: Mera Show Ab Shuru Hua Hai
videos.overview: With the whole world pining for her failure, Shiri takes up the mammoth risk of doing the unthinkable - attempt the life threatening 'Canon Ball Act'. With everything on the line, will she succeed?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Gaming Insaan
_verifiedMetadata.description: Gaming Insaan follows YouTuber Nischay Malhan, aka Triggered Insaan, as he leaves his comfort zone to chase an impossible dream: becoming a pro-gamer in just three months. Battling fierce rivals, self-doubt, and overwhelming pressure, Nischay must prove he's more than an entertainer. As tensions rise, will he conquer the esports world or crack under the weight of expectations?

videos.title: Spawn Point
videos.overview: Nischay Malhan, aka Triggered Insaan, frustrated by critics who dismiss him as not being a true gamer, seeks help from Tanmay 'Scout OP' Singh. After a brutal firsthand taste of the pro gaming world, Nischay embarks on a daring 3-month journey to prove himself. With intense challenges ahead and critics waiting for him to fail, will he rise to the occasion, or will the pressure be too much?

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: Nischay Malhan steps into the intense world of Orangutan Esports bootcamp, where seasoned pros grind relentlessly and the pressure to succeed is suffocating. Torn between his YouTube career and the demands of going pro, Nischay faces crushing self-doubt. As tensions rise and a pivotal match looms, can he survive or will the weight of it all break him?

videos.title: Pressure Cooker
videos.overview: Nischay’s journey at the bootcamp takes a dark turn as the relentless grind begins to break him. With a mysterious pro joining the team and tensions boiling between teammates, Nischay finds himself at a breaking point. As pressure mounts for a high-stakes match, can Nischay hold it together or is this the start of his unraveling?

videos.title: Two IGLs
videos.overview: The fragile alliance within Gaming Guerillas is starting to crumble as tensions between Marzil and Psy threaten to tear the team apart. Nischay, already struggling with exhaustion and a seething self doubt, finds himself caught in the middle of a growing power struggle between the two in-game leaders.

videos.title: The Glue Player
videos.overview: As the pressure mounts, Gaming Guerillas faces a crisis like never before. After a crushing loss and a heated fight Nischay Malhan, overwhelmed by the weight of expectations and the guilt of being blamed for the team's failure, has vanished. His absence leaves the bootcamp in chaos, with Marzil and Psy's unresolved rivalry threatening to tear the team apart.

videos.title: Match Found
videos.overview: The journey that began with high hopes and overwhelming challenges now reaches its climactic conclusion. The UnderGods 2024, the final LAN tournament. Months of hard work, relentless practice, and personal growth have led to this moment. For Nischay Malhan and his team, it's the ultimate test of everything they've learned, but the pressure is immense, and the stakes couldn't be higher.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Fisaddi
_verifiedMetadata.description: A final-year student Goldie gains local fame in Prayagraj despite failing exams. When his brilliant younger brother Vimal joins the same college, Goldie has to choose: match Vimal's success or accept the role as family's underachiever.

videos.title: Freedom Fighter
videos.overview: Goldie, a struggling college student and an imposing elder brother, pushes his reluctant younger brother Vimal into university life. As Vimal faces unexpected challenges and temptations, Goldie tries to hide his own failures.

videos.title: Shakespeare Sankat Mein
videos.overview: Vimal balances his attraction to Geetanjali with Goldie's strict control. A plan to gain freedom backfires, leading to chaos and an impulsive confession to Geetanjali. As their relationship seems to spark, Goldie unexpectedly appears.

videos.title: Narr V/S Maada
videos.overview: Vimal's birthday celebration sparks tension with Goldie, who feels increasingly sidelined. As Vimal grows closer to Geetanjali, Goldie attempts to assert his own masculinity, with comical and disastrous results.

videos.title: Sangam Pe Sangram
videos.overview: As Goldie and Vimal's rivalry intensifies, their parents' unexpected visit forces a temporary truce. Family tensions surface during a trip to Sangam, revealing deeper issues. With exams looming, the brothers face their own challenges.

videos.title: Goldie Flake
videos.overview: Vimal's comedy roast backfires, landing him in trouble with university authorities. Goldie, despite their rivalry, reluctantly seeks favours to save his brother from suspension.

videos.title: PCO Dada Amar Rahein
videos.overview: PCO Dada's sudden death shakes Goldie to his core. As he struggles with grief and academic pressure, Goldie makes a desperate attempt to cheat on his exams. Meanwhile, Vimal tries to reconnect with his brother.

videos.title: Kaun Hai Fisaddi?
videos.overview: Goldie's risky gamble during exams leads to unexpected consequences. As Vimal rises to the top, dark secrets threaten to tear the brothers apart. A confrontation with Deepti's husband forces Goldie to redefine his values.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Reeta Sanyal
_verifiedMetadata.description: Reeta Sanyal lands the case of a lifetime when a guilty killer narrates a ‘perfect murder’ story. In the trial for truth, she must brave against the big guns.

videos.title: Main Kaatil Hoon!
videos.overview: Advocate Reeta Sanyal is eyeing a career-defining case. An opportunity arises in the form of a high-profile murder case, but her client demands execution instead of freedom!

videos.title: Chhoti Bachhi
videos.overview: A deadly attack on Keshav leaves Reeta scrambling to find the truth behind the murder of Parav Rane. At the hospital, a sinister killer lurks to make her next move.

videos.title: The Perfect Murder
videos.overview: Chasing down a new lead, Reeta and her assistant-cum-friend Ishaan crack the code behind Keshav's so-called 'perfect murder'. But will the truth be as flawless as the crime?

videos.title: Ek Filmy Twist
videos.overview: With Inspector Jai by their side, Reeta and Ishaan search for the murder weapon that will crack this case wide open. On the first day of trial, a major setback ruins it all!

videos.title: Lady Undercover
videos.overview: Reeta goes undercover at Club Platina to dig up dirt on Parav Rane but ends up with more questions than answers. Chaos ensues when her cover gets blown!

videos.title: The Lost File
videos.overview: To solidify her defence, Reeta revisits the crime scene and uncovers explosive leads. A new intel on her father's death may open the Pandora's box!

videos.title: Ms. Killer
videos.overview: Footages from Parav’s cellar bring disturbing scenes and an unexpected eyewitness to light. A viral meme helps Reeta close in on the prime suspect.

videos.title: Yamraj Thakral
videos.overview: After Jai files crucial evidence against Rane, Reeta reevaluates her trial strategy. But with Thakral being one step ahead, her plan may hit another hiccup.

videos.title: A Bait
videos.overview: A witness’ testimony on the stand shifts the direction of the court proceedings. Jai and his team lay a trap for the elusive lady assassin. Will she get caught?

videos.title: The Defence Rests
videos.overview: The truth about Ishaan’s real identity comes to light. Ahead of the final verdict, Reeta struggles with her defence. But a new testimony shakes up the courtroom!

videos.title: Blood Is the Only True Ink
videos.overview: Reeta tries to piece together the truth behind her father’s death. An attack on the mysterious girl brings a bigger conspiracy to light but the only clue is a British-era coin.

videos.title: The Girl with a Superpower
videos.overview: With her razor-sharp ideas, Reeta signs the mysterious girl as her client. Eyeing for new leads on Joseph Jahazi, a trap is laid for Khushboo. But the plan backfires!

videos.title: High Alert
videos.overview: After a close call at the restaurant, Reeta uncovers the truth of a smuggling racket involving her father. New findings at a murder scene hint at a possible terror threat.

videos.title: Guilty Mind
videos.overview: Facing off Thakral in court, Reeta follows an unorthodox approach to prove her point. Taking the mystery girl to a hypnotist opens doors to a new maze.

videos.title: Who Killed My Father?
videos.overview: Reeta and Jai spring back to action, nabbing the infamous Acid Anna. As missing pieces of Subhash’s murder come together, Reeta braces for a fightback!

videos.title: Blood Sisters
videos.overview: Reeta unravels the past and present of the secret society ‘Blood Sisters’. As she tries to connect the dots, a nationwide threat comes to the picture.

videos.title: Honey Trap
videos.overview: A new avatar helps Reeta uncover the modus operandi of the Blood Sisters. Racing against time, Reeta takes a dangerous chance but the plan hits a snag!

videos.title: The Real Bookkeeper
videos.overview: Decoding a 200-year-old riddle, Reeta and Ishaan try to defuse a volatile situation. The real bookkeeper steps out of the shadows. And this is just the beginning!

videos.title: Who’s a Friend, Who’s a Foe?
videos.overview: In the game of power grab, the Blood Sisters plan to uproot the government. Reeta joins forces with Thakral to salvage the situation while a new enemy comes into the picture.

videos.title: The Score Is Settled!
videos.overview: Revelations, regrets, and secrets surface! In a bid to neutralise the national threat, Reeta pulls out all the stops in one final showdown. But she’s yet to face one hard truth.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Raat Jawaan Hai
_verifiedMetadata.description: Shows the unpredictable lives of three besties- Radhika, Avinash and Suman, as they embark on the wildest adventure of all: raising kids.

videos.title: Film Dekhne Chalein?
videos.overview: Three parents, who are childhood friends, want to watch a film together on a weekday, a simple wish from life.What follows is two days of a roller-coaster ride full of constipated children, grandparents not willing to babysit, expensive phones being flung in the air and toddlers' emotional blackmail when a parent is leaving. Will they make it to the film?

videos.title: Baap ki Baapta
videos.overview: Radhika is triggered by a random person calling her a housewife and starts looking for a job, while Avinash faces intense challenges at home as takes up a ‘work project’. Meanwhile, Suman for the first time in life, spends some quality time with her ‘un-involved’ father.

videos.title: Finding Sunita
videos.overview: The three friends go on a day-trip to pick up a nanny for Kadambari, as an endless misadventure is masterminded by an unexpected nemesis.

videos.title: Abadaba Issues
videos.overview: Suman and Avinash are invited to a dreamy birthday party which is the first project for Radhika’s event company.

videos.title: Jaale Toh Nahin Lag Gaye?
videos.overview: The friends deal with the lack of intimacy in their relationships after having kids and realise the immense difficulty of bringing up these issues in a marriage.

videos.title: Mercury Retrograde
videos.overview: Radhika gets envious of the bond Kadambari has with her school teacher. Meanwhile, Avinash deals with social anxiety as he faces his family and extended family who challenge his masculinity over his decision to be a stay at home parent, and Suman starts feeling like a guest in her own house after her in-laws come to visit.

videos.title: Worst Birthday Ever
videos.overview: Radhika is on her worst behaviour on her 33rd birthday. It’s a house party where for the first time, all three families are present together. Suman grapples with confronting Sattu about the in-laws moving in, while Avinash deals with the decision of taking up a full-time job. However, no one can focus on their own drama because Radhika locks herself in the bathroom.

videos.title: Sabudana Khichdi
videos.overview: Radhika chooses to terminate her pregnancy and is dealing with immense physical and mental pain for which Rishi cannot be present. Avinash and Suman hold her through this life altering experience.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Zindaginama
_verifiedMetadata.description: An Anthology series that highlights the stigmas around mental health and mental illness in India. According to the latest World Health Organization report on depression, almost 7.5% of Indians suffer from major or minor mental disorders that require expert intervention. The brainchild of Dr. Neerja Birla, Zindaginama strives towards creating an environment where mental health dialogue is encouraged. It's okay not to be okay. Six different stories from six creators with a common theme - to encourage us to be sensitive to our environment and peers and to show openness to acknowledging mental health struggles in our lives.

videos.title: One Plus One
videos.overview: Set in two timelines, 'One Plus One' follows the story of twin sisters Maya and Mira through key moments in their life. The bond between them strains and frays under the weight of Mira’s eating disorder, and one fateful night when it all comes to a breaking point. Will the sisters find a way through together?

videos.title: Swagatam
videos.overview: The episode explores the lives of a young married couple living in a small-town in Maharashtra. The husband, diagnosed with schizophrenia, is keen to attend his friend's wedding. Swagatam portrays what it’s like for an individual to actually live with schizophrenia, without primarily focusing on traditional media stereotypes of violent episodes.

videos.title: Bhanwar
videos.overview: Vaidehi, a mother of three in rural Bihar, and Namrata, a newlywed in the bustling city of Kolkata, confront identical fears and deep-rooted anxieties. Grappling with the heavy weight of societal stigmas and personal traumas, each must find a way to heal before their lives spiral out of control beyond repair.

videos.title: Caged
videos.overview: Set in the coastal village of Bhaatgaon, Raju, a high school student with undiagnosed psychological issues, embarks on a transformative journey as he embraces his true identity and experiences the challenges and triumphs of his transition. As the people around him fail to understand him, Raju finally gets support when Keith, a land owner who lives in the city, arrives in Bhaatgaon.

videos.title: Purple Duniya
videos.overview: 30-year-old Raag battles keeping up with professional and personal commitments as his life is controlled by a fictitious Purple World. To his family and friends in Delhi, Raag is a victim of bad timing - a broken relationship and failing career prospects, but will they find out the real reason behind his behaviour?

videos.title: The Daily Puppet Show
videos.overview: Twenty-six-year-old Lila has lived with her Obsessive Compulsive Disorder diagnosis for most of her life and finally feels she’s in a place where she’s able to live with it. That is, until young filmmaker, Sahil Gupta, appears in her life, asking questions, challenging her status quo and making her world open up in new and scary ways.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Honeymoon Photographer
_verifiedMetadata.description: Newlyweds Adhir and Zoya Irani's Maldives trip turns tragic when Adhir's body is found buried on a beach. Suspicion falls on their friends, family, and Zoya herself as the investigation unfolds.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Ishq in the Air
_verifiedMetadata.description: A chance encounter collides the fates of Naman and Kavya on a flight propelling them on an unforeseen journey of love. But as time unfolds, will they surpass the turbulent complexities of their contrasting worlds and backgrounds to embrace the love that’s in the air?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Call Me Bae
_verifiedMetadata.description: Downsized from heiress to hustler, 'Bae' discovers her most valuable assets aren't her diamonds, but her street-smart style. Broke, but refusing to be broken, she navigates the newsrooms of Mumbai and her better self while breakin...

videos.title: Bae Tries to be a Journalist

_verifiedMetadata.name: Cadets
_verifiedMetadata.description: Set in 1998 before the historic Kargil war, four boys set foot in the prestigious Armed Forces Academy. Cadets is a coming-of-age story about a world where boys become men of honour.

videos.title: A Cadet must always be loyal

_verifiedMetadata.name: Murshid
_verifiedMetadata.description: Ex-don Murshid is forced out of exile when his former accomplice turned rival, Farid, traps his son in a gang war. Can Murshid reclaim his rule over the city as he saves his son?

videos.title: Murshid Pathan
videos.overview: Druglord Farid’s men send Salim and Junaid to collect a smuggling delivery from Talibanis. When the deal goes wrong, Farid meets Junaid and realizes he is the son of the dreaded gangster Murshid Pathan.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: Murshid meets Junaid, who tells him that he got framed. Murshid promises Farid that he will bear the price for the deal that went wrong. He meets his adopted son, Kumar Pratap and asks for help.

videos.title: The Clock is in Motion
videos.overview: Kumar confronts Murshid about his father's death. Murshid contacts his old accomplices and enquires about finding dirt on Farid’s gang members. Can the two help Junaid before it’s too late?

videos.title: Back in the Game
videos.overview: Farid goes back on his words and puts Junaid’s life in danger. Jayendra Rao makes a deal with Farid to win the elections. Salim’s death marks the beginning of a war between Murshid and Farid.

videos.title: Farid's Vendetta
videos.overview: Jayendra loses his cool as the media is focused on the war between Murshid and Farid instead of the elections. Meanwhile, Murshid joins hands with Namdev Kulkarni, the leader of the Naya Daur party.

videos.title: The Heart of a Lion
videos.overview: Murshid’s next target is Ajay Verma, the Intelligence Officer helping Farid. On the other hand, Farid's plan to get Murshid assassinated fails. Jayendra Rao meets Murshid to make a deal with him.

videos.title: The Endgame
videos.overview: With the election dates drawing close, the stakes are higher than ever. The assassination of Jayendra Rao’s father, Baburao, changes the game. Farid and Murshid face each other, one last time.

_verifiedMetadata.name: IC 814: The Kandahar Hijack
_verifiedMetadata.description: Indian Airlines flight hijacked en route Kathmandu-Delhi on Dec 24, 1999, diverting to Kandahar under Taliban control.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Angry Young Men
_verifiedMetadata.description: Angry Young Men is the story of Salim-Javed, legendary screenwriters of 1970s Hindi cinema. Together, they created the archetype of the Angry Young Man - a brooding anti-hero who captured the imagination of an entire nation with his rage, defiance, and quest for social justice. Like the character they created, Salim Khan and Javed Akhtar, two outsiders to the Hindi film industry, defied all odds, questioning the position of writers and demanding recognition as much as the reigning stars of that time. Their break-up made headlines for many years and Indian cinema never saw a cultural collaboration as powerful again. This is a personal and candid account of their lives, their writing and their legacy.

videos.title: Main Phenke Hue Paise Nahin Uthata

_verifiedMetadata.name: Shekhar Home
_verifiedMetadata.description: Set against the backdrop of a sleepy town called Lonpur in Bengal in the early 1990s. Shekhar meets Jayvrat Sahni, who becomes his housemate due to a twist of fate. The duo end up solving mysteries across East India.

videos.name: It's Elementary
videos.overview: Shekhar & ex-army doctor Jayavrat Saini team up to solve a series of murders in Lonpur marked by a "horse shoe" symbol. As Jayavrat evolves from roommate to partner, a shadowy figure known as "M" ominously watches Shekhar from the shadows.
videos.description: Shekhar & ex-army doctor Jayavrat Saini team up to solve a series of murders in Lonpur marked by a "horse shoe" symbol. As Jayavrat evolves from roommate to partner, a shadowy figure known as "M" ominously watches Shekhar from the shadows.

videos.name: Dasbabu Ki Dulhan
videos.overview: Shekhar dives into a village scam where a jungle adventure leads to a bank heist. With a bride-to-be's father missing, he uncovers a tangled plot revealing a cunning robber with a grudge, while the looming threat of "M" draws ever closer.
videos.description: Shekhar dives into a village scam where a jungle adventure leads to a bank heist. With a bride-to-be's father missing, he uncovers a tangled plot revealing a cunning robber with a grudge, while the looming threat of "M" draws ever closer.

videos.name: Phir Milenge
videos.overview: Shekhar & Jayavrat are in Bihar for a blackmail scandal involving a famous politician. Shekhar is fascinated by the enigmatic Iraboty, while Mrinmoy discovers a classified file on "M," adding a new layer of intrigue to their investigation.
videos.description: Shekhar & Jayavrat are in Bihar for a blackmail scandal involving a famous politician. Shekhar is fascinated by the enigmatic Iraboty, while Mrinmoy discovers a classified file on "M," adding a new layer of intrigue to their investigation.

videos.name: Bhaskarvilla
videos.overview: Iraboty's arrival in Lonpur sparks intrigue as she convinces Shekhar to investigate the 150-year-old Skhondokhata legend in Purulia, linked to recent deaths in the Bhaskar family. Shekhar suspects a deeper conspiracy.
videos.description: Iraboty's arrival in Lonpur sparks intrigue as she convinces Shekhar to investigate the 150-year-old Skhondokhata legend in Purulia, linked to recent deaths in the Bhaskar family. Shekhar suspects a deeper conspiracy.

videos.name: "M" For Mastermind
videos.overview: Mrs. H & Pintoo are held hostage at Khasha Blanca forcing Shekhar to confront his past where he had uncovered a deadly gas weapon linked to M, a criminal mastermind. Now they must find the vial or his friends lose their lives.
videos.description: Mrs. H & Pintoo are held hostage at Khasha Blanca forcing Shekhar to confront his past where he had uncovered a deadly gas weapon linked to M, a criminal mastermind. Now they must find the vial or his friends lose their lives.

videos.name: Kahan Chippe Ho Tagore?
videos.overview: Racing against time, Shekhar and Jayavrat hunt for clues across Calcutta left by the scientist Gupta, aiming to find a vial with the secret gas formula. As they near the final code, Shekhar faces M in a deadly struggle.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Aapka Apna Zakir
_verifiedMetadata.description: Zakir Khan, along with his four panelists - Shweta Tiwari, Rithvik Dhanjani, Gopal Datt and Paresh Ganatra, host quirky news debates, candid conversations with celebrities and influencers, and special guests who present their unique talents.

videos.title: Karan Johar Ke Saath Guftagoo
videos.overview: With heartwarming conversations and a slice of comedy, Zakir Khan and his four panellists, Shweta Tiwari, Rithvikk Dhanjani, Paresh Ganatra and Gopal Datt, welcome the renowned director and producer, Karan Johar, followed by the diligent and inspiring Ankit Baiyanpuria, to the first episode of 'Aapka Apna Zakir'.

videos.title: Zakir With The Cast Of Stree 2
videos.overview: Zakir and the esteemed panellists have a joyful discussion with the cast of Stree 2, Shraddha Kapoor and Rajkummar Rao. Enjoy an evening filled with comedy, dance, and entertainment, along with a captivating poetry session by well-known poet Azhar Iqbal.

videos.title: Hasseen Dillruba Ke Saath Guftagoo
videos.overview: Zakir and the panellists interact with the cast of the Hindi movie 'Phir Aayi Hasseen Dillruba', Taapsee Pannu, Vikrant Massey and Sunny Kaushal.

videos.title: Fun, Laughter And Frolic With The Cast Of Vedaa
videos.overview: The hilarious panellists Shweta Tiwari, Rithvikk Dhanjani, Paresh Ganatra, and Gopal Datt, engage in a lively conversation with the cast of Vedaa, John Abraham, Sharvari and Abhishek Banerjee along with director, Nikhil Advani. Himanshi Babra joins the celebration with her heartwarming poetry.

videos.title: Star Studded Laughter With The Cast Of Gyaarah Gyaarah
videos.overview: The laughter levels soar as the cast of 'Gyaarah Gyaarah', Raghav Juyal, Kritika Kamra, and Dhairya Karwa, make a special appearance on the show.

videos.title: Singers Aur Zakir Ka Purana Rishta
videos.overview: Zakir and the panellists welcome the talented singers Neeti Mohan, Jubin Nautiyal and Shekhar R to the show for a fun-filled musical evening.

videos.title: Zakir And The Judges Of India's Best Dancer
videos.overview: Zakir and the panelists welcome the judges of season four of India's Best Dancer, Karisma Kapoor, Geeta Kapur and Terence Lewis, to enjoy an evening of laughter and heartening conversations.

videos.title: Getting Candid With Raveena
videos.overview: Zakir and the panellists celebrate Raveena Tandon's journey in the film industry. A viral guest - Deepak Utwal, surprises Raveena with his impersonation of one of her favourite co-stars.

videos.title: Zakir And The Cast Of IC814
videos.overview: Zakir and the panelists welcome the renowned artists, Dia Mirza, Vijay Varma, Patralekhaa and Anubhav Sinhaa, for a night full of laughter and entertainment.

videos.title: Zakir With Sonu Sood
videos.overview: The talented heartthrob of Bollywood who has touched millions of hearts through his philanthropy, Sonu Sood gets candid in an interview with Zakir.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Gyaarah Gyaarah
_verifiedMetadata.description: Investigative drama following events in 1990, 2001, 2016. Intertwining storylines blending mysticism, science and mystery across the decades.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Life Hill Gayi
_verifiedMetadata.description: ﻿Siblings turn rivals when they are put on an inheritance race by reviving a down-in-the-dumps hotel in the hills. Who will emerge victorious?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Dus June Kii Raat
_verifiedMetadata.description: A farcical tale of Panauti, a hapless man with notorious bad luck, and his quest to reopen his father's theatre. Packed with hilarious misadventures and colorful characters, his journey with cousin Battu for love and luck is a hilarious.

videos.title: Lo Bhai, Lag Gayi Panauti
videos.overview: Panauti and Battu hope to revive Menka theatre. Panauti's bad luck brings trouble; Battu rescues him. The theatre's secrets attract Sahab Singh and Rumpa. A mysterious girl, Puppy, enters Panauti's life. When he's finally about to meet her, Panauti finds Puppy dead at the theatre.

videos.title: Panauti Ho Na Ho
videos.overview: Panauti is feeling distraught about the dead body. Inspector Devraj and his constables find a body at Menka Theatre. Devraj, who holds a grudge against Panauti, catches him trying to escape. Devraj plots Panauti's encounter. A mystery girl enters the police station.

videos.title: Tera Battu Sambhal Lega
videos.overview: Puppy files a report for her missing friend, not knowing that its linked to Menka theatre's murder. Battu reassures Rekha about Panauti's release. Battu tries to free Panauti from Devraj's claws. Panauti receives a call from Puppy.

videos.title: Battu Ke Panauti Ki Puppy
videos.overview: Puppy tells Panauti that she suspects Tarun killed Neha. Puppy learns Sahab Singh has claimed Neha's body. Aneesha warns Vaani about drugs. Puppy confronts Tarun, informs Panauti and Battu. They investigate and find Tarun meeting Sassy Kajal.

videos.title: Neha ki Maut ka Raaz, Ek Chaalbaaz
videos.overview: Devraj finds new evidence against Panauti. Rumpa orders a search for the map. Battu provides proof from Kashi's vlog clearing Panauti. Battu and Puppy steal a phone, realizing its Neha's. Battu finds a key detail in Neha's case.

videos.title: Kaatil ki Khoj hui Fail, Panauti Pohoncha Jail!
videos.overview: Panauti lands up in jail. Meanwhile, Bijon tells Rumpa about Gogoi's kidnapping. Panauti seeks evidence against Tarun with Battu and Puppy's help, while Panauti deals with jail life.

videos.title: Assman se Gira, Khajoor mein atka Panauti
videos.overview: In prison, Battu vows to free Panauti. Battu and Satya plot Panauti's escape from the jail kitchen. Satya aids Panauti for someone else's benefit. Devraj faces trouble as Panauti escapes, only for Panauti to fall in trouble again.

videos.title: Theatre ka Raaz…Raaz hi rehne do
videos.overview: Panauti escapes Rumpa's captivity and locks her out. Battu tries to prove Panauti's innocence, but Devraj creates a fuss. Menka suggests Panauti to sell the theatre for answers he wants.

videos.title: Nakshe ki Talash mein Bhagam Bhaag
videos.overview: Panauti decides to open the theatre alone despite Battu and Puppy's refusal. Rumpa and Bijon find Gogoi. Dinkar denies Panauti funds, but has his own share of secrets. As the theatre prepares to reopen, and Panauti tries to propose Puppy, a new threat appears.

videos.title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhi Panauti
videos.overview: Rumpa traps Panauti, Battu, and Puppy at the theatre for the treasure map. Panauti falsely claims knowledge under threat. Battu questions Rumpa about Sassy Kajal. Chaos ensues when Saheb Singh reaches there. Panauti and Battu investigate Rahul's house for clues.

videos.title: Pehla Kaam Duja, Phir Hogi Pooja
videos.overview: Panauti tells the SP about Rahul's killer. At the haveli, Battu stops Rekha's suicide attempt. Panauti focuses on the theatre mystery. Dinkar pushes Sahib Singh to sell, but he plans to reopen it. Panauti invites Puppy to the theatre's inauguration, where they find a clue linking to Neha's death.

videos.title: Panauti Zaroor Lagegi Dobara
videos.overview: Panauti and Puppy discover Neha's killer. Battu forces Panauti a choice between him and Puppy. Menka reveals a secret to Panauti about his father's death. Panauti seeks Devraj's aid in his father's case, discovering missing case files and chaos ensues, yet again. Just when Panauti thought his jinx is over, a new blunder is awaits.

videos.title: Khel Gayi Puppy Pishachini

videos.title: Double Role Ka Jhol
videos.overview: Panouti's loyalties waver as Sahab Singh's message implicates Puppy in the murders, and Battu urges him to act. Battu begins investigating Puppy's past, uncovering a mysterious phone call from her "Mom" that hints at hidden connections.

videos.title: Batasha Ke Aadhe Nakshe Ki Kahani
videos.overview: Battu's suspicions about Puppy grow, leading him to Devraj, who reveals shocking information about Rumpa. With Puppy's intentions questioned, a shadowy pursuit of the theatre's treasure intensifies, drawing Panouti and Battu into a dangerous alliance.

videos.title: Asli Rasmon Waali Nakli Shadi

videos.title: Panouti Ki Shadi Ke Side Effects

videos.title: Parde Ke Peeche Kya Hai?

_verifiedMetadata.name: BLUETICK
_verifiedMetadata.description: #BLUETICK ☑️ portrays the compelling narrative of a young influencer from a middle-class background who relentlessly pursues fame. She stops at nothing to maintain her status, blurring the line between reel and real, which ultimately leads to her downfall. The story unfolds as she navigates the consequences of her actions and strives to find redemption.

videos.title: The Talent Management Agency
videos.overview: In the vibrant city of Mumbai, Pallavi, an influencer seeking to transcend social media fame, clashes with her best friend Ritu over a career move. Neglecting warnings, Pallavi’s actions lead to unintended consequences.

videos.title: Dizzying Heights
videos.overview: Pallavi challenges tradition on a podcast, recounting past online struggles, failed collaborations and inorganic tactics to gain visibility. In the present, her moral stance against a brand backfires while the news of her father's illness makes her anxious.

videos.title: The Real Job
videos.overview: Pallavi's flashback reveals family tension over her career choices and a decline in online followers including her and Ritu's failure to impress a brand manager and her past overnight fame sparked by a horrifying incident. While at present she grapples with the mixed reactions to her latest post.

videos.title: The Inflection Point
videos.overview: Past reveals how Pallavi's family disapproves, leading to deletion of her viral video. Viraj urges her to host an online session with influencers, boosting older videos and earning her the coveted Blue Tick. Presently, she exposes the brand, facing legal consequences.

videos.title: The Lost Cause
videos.overview: Pallavi’s attempt to resolve the crisis goes awry. The past reveals a reel to real romance with Viraj. Left feeling desolate, Pallavi tries to rectify the situation, just as Ritu reaches out again since the argument. They’re both left in utter shock at what happens next.

videos.title: The Final Upload
videos.overview: In the hospital, Pallavi faces her mother amid distress. Malvika's smear campaign ends with exposed intentions. Betrayed by influencers, Pallavi schemes to reclaim her online presence, re-evaluating priorities with a revealing truth.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Tribhuvan Mishra CA Topper
_verifiedMetadata.description: Middle-class man seeks secret escort services during financial woes. Entangled in lies, murder and gang, he becomes what he once despised - corrupt.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Pill
_verifiedMetadata.description: Pill unravels the deep-set rot in the Indian pharmaceutical industry. Dr. Prakash along with three whistle-blowers face a powerful pharma giant Forever Cure to expose the corrupt nexus of pharma, middlemen, and doctors through which a pill reaches the common man. Will the good be able to overcome the evil?

videos.title: The Transfer
videos.overview: Dr. Prakash uncovers dysfunction within the Medicine Authority of India while Forever Cure Pharma eyes expansion, sparking a clash of interests and ethical dilemmas.

videos.title: The File
videos.overview: Noor, the journalist finds a dossier on a discontinued antibiotic by Forever Cure Pharma. Dr. Prakash learns of a failed inspection at their Gurgaon facility. Suspicion grows, leading to a compelling investigation.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: Noor shares scant details of the discontinued antibiotic on social media, catching Gursimrat's attention, who informs Dr. Prakash. Despite Neelima's dismissal, Dr. Prakash persists, determined to join forces with Noor in their quest for truth.

videos.title: The Drug Test
videos.overview: Forever Cure Pharma's CEO, Bramha Gill, stunned by outcry over trial deaths, seeks CM's help. Dr. Prakash orders Gurgaon plant re-inspection; no evidence found. An insider who discovers the truth is being forced to shut down.

videos.title: The Bribe
videos.overview: Amidst damaging articles, Bramha Gill rushes to the US for FMA approval of their cancer drug. Dr. Prakash faces a setback when he finds his mentor has joined hands with the enemy. Determined, Prakash opts to meet MCGI's Mr. Raman.

videos.title: The Despair
videos.overview: Denied by superiors, Prakash takes Forever Cure Pharma to court for plant inspection. Court orders an inspection only to uncover the rot in the practices of Forever cure pharma.

videos.title: The Conspiracy
videos.overview: Dr. Prakash decides to test drugs by his own means but faces a setback. Yet he approaches the supreme court, what is up his sleeve?

videos.title: The Catharsis
videos.overview: It is race against time for Dr, Prakash and team in court. Their only hope, Ashish struggles for his life in a hit and run attack. Will the common man win?

_verifiedMetadata.name: 36 Days

As they clamour to unravel her mysteries, all their lies and hidden identities begin destroying them, culminating in absolute horror. Neha Sharma, Amruta Khanvilkar, Sharib Hashmi, Chandan Roy Sanyal, Shruti Seth, Sushant Divgikar and Purab Kohli star in the crime-thriller of a 36-day journey to the fateful moment that upends the lives of Goa’s Casa De Magnolia residents.

videos.overview: Aayush narrates his 26th script - Dhoom Dhadaka - with the hope of getting it produced with his name in the credit, but he stumbles upon unprecedented troubles from producer Rakesh Raman and actor Kunal Kumar.
