_verifiedMetadata.description: A slice-of-life show that explores the lives of 5 quirky school teenagers who've just entered 11th Commerce, as they navigate friendships, heartbreaks, peer pressures, more importantly figuring out who they really want to be. All this in a society that finds it difficult to cope with the fast-changing Gen Z world.

videos.title: Bhutte Bane Popcorn
videos.overview: It’s first day for Class 11 commerce students at KLPD. BBFs Anirban and Raman have their very first fight as Anirban decides to change his section to be with her all-time crush, topper Stuti. Meanwhile, Stuti is sad as principal announces that this year’s headgirl and headboy will be only from science section.

videos.title: Stuti Ko Kaise Pataun?
videos.overview: Dreams come true for Anirban as Stuti chooses to sit next to him. In a hilarious act, Raman interviews candidates to replace Anirban from the position of his best friend. On the other hand, Stuti is shocked when she gets to know that her best friend Kudrat has been chosen as the perfect head girl.

videos.title: Kisne Mara Atom Bomb?
videos.overview: Raman comes up with a 3-rule strategy to help Anirban impress Stuti, but Dimple doesn’t agree. Stuti is facing a difficult choice, and finally she. makes a radical decision to save her Head Girl dream.

videos.title: POV: CCTV
videos.overview: Stuti’s decision to switch to Science has left Anirban in great turmoil. Stuti’s crazy plan ‘to have it all’ has Kudrat worried. Stuti pays the price of her bad choices but Anirban manages to save the day for her, and finally the ice is broken.

videos.title: Masala Mass Bunk
videos.overview: An act of discrimination by Principal Shukla against commerce students pisses Dimple off and she decides to put him in his place, by planning a mass bunk. Stuti is against it, but Dimple lies to her and puts her in a difficult position.

videos.title: Stuti Ko Kaise Manau?
videos.overview: After the whole bunking mess, Stuti is now ignoring Anirban. Anirban who really want to make things better, try all the things to make her feel better. While Mukund is now after Raman. He has decided to make his life hell.

videos.title: Mistri Bane Kalakar
videos.overview: Anirban apologizes to Stuti but she is adamant. Mukund gets in a big fight Raman and Dimple. A crazy prank takes place in class, and Raman is wrongly pulled up.

videos.title: 200 Ka Ek
videos.overview: Stuti forgives Anirban. Raman wants revenge from Mukund. Dimple makes a nasty plan, but at the time of execution, Raman screws up and their BIG plan to avenge their ‘image’ bites them back and how!

videos.title: Surprise Test Pro Max
videos.overview: The principal drops the surprise test bomb on commerce students. Dimple ends up smuggling Topper Stuti’s notes to earn a quick buck! Mukund uses the ace up his sleeve to deal with the test. Anirban and Stuti are in for a surprise that may put a dent in their newly blossoming friendship.

videos.title: Stuti Kahan Hai Yaar?
videos.overview: Stuti gives Anirban a serious dressing down, following which, he has a spat with Raman and Dimple. Determined to show students their place, Principal Shukla springs up a Surprise Test 2.0. A bizarre fallout of the test leaves Anirban, Stuti, Raman, Dimple and Mukund accidentally locked inside the store room with no network. The only way for them to get out is by working together as a team.

videos.title: Who's the hottie?
videos.overview: The first parent-principal meeting doesn’t go well for Mukund. Raman decides to cheer up Mukund, realizing that the big bad bully is actually just a lonely kid. Stuti is missing from the school the next day after the meeting. Commode Raja’s news of her accident shatters Anirban.

videos.title: Gaurav-Bhagao Andolan
videos.overview: As Cancel Commode Raja’s scoop on Stuti turns out to be fake, Cancel Commode Raja trends in school. Anirban finally musters courage and decides it’s time to tell Stuti how he feels. But hilarity ensues when his hopes are dashed by Mr Perfect – the new brawn with brains boy in school. While Dimple has finally cracked the formula for her start-up.

videos.title: That's What Friends Do
videos.overview: Anirban and his buddies finally expose the new dazzling and discover what the handsome truth hidden behind his face is.

videos.title: Dosti Ka Interval
videos.overview: Anirban is furious with Stuti, but Stuti makes every attempt to reestablish his friendship with Anirban, while mobile phones are still banned in school, which has a significant impact on Dimple's life. Finally, Stuti hands over her notes to Anirban, and the two share a moment together.

videos.title: Analysis-e-Anirban
videos.overview: In this episode, unexpected emotions begin to surface within Stuti as she realizes there is a burgeoning affection for Anirban deep within her heart. Simultaneously, Dimple finds herself contemplating whether she has stumbled upon the love of her life

videos.title: School Bani Pathshala
videos.overview: The school was thrown into chaos when the principal introduced a new rule segregating boys and girls, creating a deep division among the students. Dimple's heart shattered as she was affected by the consequences of this rule, feeling the pain of separation and loss.

videos.title: Gender-Bender!
videos.overview: As a bizarre reaction to the canoodling couple, Principal tops the phone ban rule - Girls and boys can’t talk to each other! The school suddenly gives off a black and white era vibe. The only lucky one is Dimple, who can arrange a meet-cute with her crush with no fear of being caught – because her crush is a girl.

videos.title: Head Girl Kaun Hai?
videos.overview: Dimple confesses her feelings to Harshita. Anirban, Raman and Mukund face the threat of suspension. The whole school turns up in support of them, but in a new avatar. Gender Bender it is! Meanwhile, Principal Shukla’s ad hoc actions are questioned by a well-meaning school board member.

videos.title: Abey Yeh Kya Ho Gaya?
videos.overview: Anirban wants Stuti to stay back at any cost. But how? With both anger and hormones raging, he executes his amateur plan to get the principal sacked, and have Stuti become the head-girl. Surprisingly, he even succeeds well almost. Just as he’s about to confess his feelings to Stuti, things take an unprecedented turn.

videos.title: Stuti Roko Andolan
videos.overview: When Anirban musters up the courage to confess his feelings to Stuti, she reveals that she is leaving the school, shocking everyone. Anirban and his friends hatch a plan to convince her to stay. Will they succeed in keeping their friend at school?

videos.title: Stuti Roko Andolan 2.0
videos.overview: Despite their best efforts, Anirban and his friends fail to convince Stuti. Unyielding, Anirban initiates Plan B. These persistent efforts make Stuti realize how important her friends are to her, and she decides she cannot leave them behind.

videos.title: RamBan Ka Jhagda?
videos.overview: While everyone is happy for Stuti, Principal Cholla has different plans for her responsibilities. Additionally, Cholla's announcement about new house allotments has left her school friends extremely worried. What are they planning next?

videos.title: The House Of School Friends
videos.overview: When Gaurav cleverly separates everyone into different houses, Dimples uncovers his ulterior motive. Determined to thwart his plans and reunite her friends, she devises 'The House of School Friends' operation.

videos.title: Aswachata Abhiyan
videos.overview: School friends plan to get revenge on Principal Cholla by meddling in ACIS visit, forgetting how it might negatively impact Stuti's position as head girl. Despite Anirban's efforts to stop them, it's already too late.

videos.title: Honest Anirban
videos.overview: Zorawar gets angry seeing litter everywhere and notes it in his diary. Anirban uses paint thrown on a blackboard to create a painting. ACIS inspector Zorawar is impressed by Anirban's art, which covers Raman's mistake.

videos.title: And The Oscar Goes To
videos.overview: The drawing teacher admires Anirban’s art. The group persuades Raman to audition, and he agrees to participate. However, Raman gets cold feet and disappears, prompting the entire group to search for him.

videos.title: Stuti Is Punished!
videos.overview: All friends, exhausted from searching for Raman, are surprised when he enters the auditorium in a new avatar. Raman auditions but isn't selected. Dimple despite all the stress manage to celebrate Mukund's birthday.

videos.title: Golgappa Overflow Ho Gaya!
videos.overview: Gaurav has forced the gang to do his work. Mukund devises a revenge plan against him. As a result, Gaurav is punished, and the gang is now plotting to remove him from his position as head boy.

videos.title: Head Boy Haye Haye!
videos.overview: The gang learns Gaurav is forging the Principal's signature and devises a plan. Caught on CCTV, Gaurav is demoted from Head Boy. Anirban decides to help Nilesh.

videos.title: And The Head Boy Is…
videos.overview: Principal appoints Anirban as Head Boy, shocking the gang. Stuti reveals she convinced the principal. Mr. Mehta informs us about the quiz. Stuti, initially upset, changes her mind seeing Principal using the stress bag.

videos.title: Dimple Ki Toh Lag Gayi
videos.overview: Stuti preps the auditorium for the quiz while Anirban, confused and panicked, is taken to the stress relief corner by her. Raman and others sing to welcome Mr. Zorawar, who starts the quiz with the audience.

videos.title: Unit Test Ya Picnic?
videos.overview: Students of KLPD face unconventional punishments after a surprise inspection by Mukund's strict mother. With the school at risk, they must choose between a picnic or saving their 11th and 12th grades.

videos.title: Padhai-Vadhai Sabh Dhokha Hai
videos.overview: Facing pressure from upcoming exams and a retest, students discuss their struggles and strategies. The results bring mixed emotions, and attention shifts to the cultural fest, a crucial factor in the school's evaluation.

videos.title: Movie Kaun Kaun Dekhega?
videos.overview: To convince their strict principal for movie, students turn a surprise celebration into an appreciation event. However, the movie is a dull documentary, prompting students to sneak out, leading to unexpected twists in relationships.

videos.title: Haww, Kiss???
videos.overview: After the video emerges, Raman, Mukund, and Dimple confront Anirban and Stuti, triggering chaos. Stuti grapples with the fallout while Anirban tries to repair their friendship amid school tensions and peer judgment.

videos.title: Clash Of The Genders!
videos.overview: Stuti's rejection of Anirban sparks a dare-filled rivalry between boys and girls. Rising tensions lead to pranks and challenges that strain friendships and reveal underlying emotions.

videos.title: Rehearsal Time!
videos.overview: In a chaotic library escape, Mukund injures himself, prompting the group to rally around him. This leads to heartwarming moments and a reconciliation between Stuti and Anirban.

videos.title: Kya Phata Raman!
videos.overview: In the school auditorium, cultural performance rehearsals create tension when Raman is excluded. Ananda Ma'am pairs Kudrat with Gaurav, but Raman's return in high-heeled shoes surprises everyone. Tables turn when he injures his ankle.

videos.title: Stuti, Yeh Tune Kya Kiya?
videos.overview: In the school auditorium, chaos ensues when Ananda Ma'am falls ill during cultural performance preparations. Anirban steps up to create a last-minute background, but backstage revelations of Chola's deceit spark a student rebellion.

videos.title: New Girl In Class
videos.overview: Stuti and Anirban's almost-love story faces new hurdles, while Principal Bhola's ban on extracurricular activities stirs up tension. In the midst of canteen laughter, they cross paths with a new girl, Yashika.

videos.title: Mission: Who Is Yashika?
videos.overview: A new student, Yashika, joins the school, quickly catching Anirban's attention as he begins to show genuine care for her. Stuti, noticing Anirban's growing interest in Yashika, starts to feel a pang of jealousy. As these emotions surface, tension brews between Stuti and Anirban, complicating their friendship.

videos.title: KLPD Mein Junk Food Ban
videos.overview: Principal Cholla implements a strict ban on junk food in the school canteen, replacing it with healthier options in an effort to promote student well-being. However, not everyone is on board with the new rules. Raman and his group of friends, unhappy with the change, secretly smuggle in junk food, distributing it among the students.

videos.title: Business Girl Dimple Rocks!
videos.overview: Chaos erupts in the school as several students begin vomiting, seemingly due to food poisoning. Concerned and determined to find the culprit, Dimple takes it upon herself to investigate the canteen's ingredients, suspecting foul play. Her suspicions quickly fall on Raju, and she sets out to trap him, believing he's responsible for the incident.

videos.title: Kebab Mein Haddi?
videos.overview: Students in class were asked to do a marketing survey in pairs, Since Yashika is a new student, she was given the previlege to chose her partner first, she picked Anirban. Stuti was seen being jealous of this. Then Mukund chose Dimple, which left Stuti with no choice but Raman. They all head to Agarwal sweets for survey where Stuti and Anirban are seated next each other.

videos.title: And The Best Jodi Is...?
videos.overview: Students had a presentation after the market survey wherein Yashika was seen having panic attacks. She was feeling uneasy, Anirban noticed it and tried to console her by holding her hands. She eventually started feeling better. Stuti was sitting with Raman, she noticed them holding hands which made her feel jealous.

videos.title: Fight For Seat!
videos.overview: Cholla punishes the students and replaces the benches with mattresses. The students jump over it and have fun, Stuti sees it and tries to stop everyone, Anirban is dragged away by Yashita, Stuti goes and sits next to gaurav. Anirban gets jealous. Students eventually are fed up of the mattresses. The canteen guy offers students to sit on a chair in exchange of money.

videos.title: Tables Have Turned
videos.overview: Gaurav enters, everyone is furious. Everyone warns him not to tell Cholla, he replies that he himself is frustrated with his dad. Anirban says that they cannot trust him, Stuti takes Gaurav's side. Anirban is now jealous. Gaurav helps in cutting the wire. The power has been cut not only in Cholla's cabin but the whole school. Everyone blames Gaurav, Stuti takes his side and speaks on his behalf.

videos.title: Walk Of Shame
videos.overview: Everyone tries to find Dimple, that's when they come across scrabble competition, Stuti and Yashika decide to team up for it. Cholla punishes Raman and Mukund. Stuti gets on stage for preparation, Anirban wishes luck to her. Yashika gets panic attacks seeing the stage, Anirban tries to comfort her, Stuti sees it and is jealous.

videos.title: May The Best Girl Win
videos.overview: Anirban finds the owl gifted to Stuti on floor. Raman and Mukund finally reach Dimple in the hospital. They all chill together. Stuti and Yashika win the 1st round. Gaurav and his partner win too. Now it is Stuti vs Yashika and Gaurav vs his partner. Gaurav makes it look like his partner is cheating, Principal bans all extra curricular activites.

videos.title: No More Masti In KLPD!
videos.overview: Stuti tries to convince Cholla to remove the ban but he ignores her request. Anirban comes on stage and blames Gaurav for falsely accusing his partner, Stuti interferes and asks Anirban to stay out of their fight. Everyone leaves Anirban alone on stage, except Yashika, she thanks Anirban for being there for her. She is shown admiring Anirban. Everyone gathers and welcomes Dimple.

videos.title: Matter Ab Serious Hai
videos.overview: Principal walks out of his office and observes furious students protecting by performing a street play, Cholla is still not convinced. Dimple warns Cholla if he doesnt lift the ban, Yashika would post the street play video online and everyone would blame Cholla. He then says that due to this, student's marks would be deducted. Stuti pleads him not to deduct marks.

videos.title: Commode Raja's Face Revealed
videos.overview: Raman and Mukund's antics have finally exhausted the principal's patience, leading him to humiliate them by making them do a chicken dance in front of the entire school. Dimple, determined to expose the prankster Commode Raja.

videos.title: School Friends Ka Plan Backfired
videos.overview: Thinking they've caught Commode Raja, the students ambush a figure in a hoodie only to find it's Principal Cholla, sick and annoyed. Just then, Commode Raja sends a taunting message, prompting the group to try a seance.

videos.title: Mission Red Flag To Green Flag
videos.overview: Anirban tries to impress Stuti, frustrated by her misunderstandings, and sets out to prove he's a "green flag." However, his attempts, including praising Yashika as a "whole green forest," only make Stuti jealous and push her further away.

videos.title: Scream Out Loud
videos.overview: Yashika teases Anirban, saying he could be her boyfriend, but he laughs it off, insisting they're just friends. Determined to prove he's confident and tackle one of Stuti's "red flags," Anirban suddenly starts dancing, hoping to impress her. Meanwhile, he and Stuti, as head boy and head girl, are called to the principal's office.

videos.title: Sitare vs Bechare
videos.overview: Dimple reveals Principal Cholla's truth to the trustee, exposing how Cholla had restricted extracurricular activities due to their seniors' poor performance. Cholla, in turn, proposes a competition where extracurriculars will be allowed for the winning team. The students are divided into two teams: those who scored above 70 and those below.

videos.overview: Madhav's family arrives in Alampuram, where Ranjith asks for his help. Kanaga invites the group for dinner and a stay. Priya's irritation with Madhav's financial troubles increases.

videos.title: Ranjith Discovers the Divine
videos.overview: Madhav's family and Ranjith travel to Pithapuram. Ranjith discovers the divine within while Madhav's fate becomes uncertain. Priya contemplates divorce if Madhav asks her father for help.

videos.title: Tribal Beliefs
videos.overview: Madhav collects sacred soil from the Girija Devi temple. Ranjith learns about tribal beliefs, and Madhav apologises to Pranav. The group spends the night in Kolkata. Priya is shocked by a revelation.

videos.title: Fiery Confrontations
videos.overview: In Guwahati, a fiery confrontation erupts between Priya and Madhav. The pressure starts mounting on Madhav. Ranjith's conversations and experiences prompt him to write about his journey.

videos.title: Going Separate Ways
videos.overview: In Prayagraj, Priya decides to end the trip, but Madhav pleads with her to wait until they reach Kashi. Ranjith receives some disappointing news about his health. Madhav's family splits as the members begin their individual journeys.

videos.title: Priya and Revathi's Epiphany
videos.overview: Ranjith's mother urges him to complete his book. Priya's conversation with Revathi leads her to embrace the uncertainty of their journey. Madhav and Pranav go to Kashmir, and Madhav receives sacred soil.

videos.title: Unexpected Encounters
videos.overview: Ranjith's encounter with a scientist sparks his interest in astrophysics and ancient wisdom. Madhav and Pranav meet an aghora. Priya searches for answers in Mahur as Madhav tries to reach her.

videos.title: Back Together
videos.overview: Revathi and Pranav have questions for their parents. Priya and Madhav cross paths and get back together when they learn about Ranjith's health. Ranjith encourages Madhav to visit Kanchi.

videos.title: The Final Transformation
videos.overview: In Kanchi, Ranjith's selfless act leaves Priya and Madhav in awe. The family reconciles and travels to Sri Lanka, where Madhav immerses the sacred soil from all the 18 peeths in the ocean.

videos.title: Love Like A Poem

videos.title: I Hate Love

videos.title: The Day It All Changed

videos.title: Matchmaker

videos.title: Broken Threads

videos.title: Fumbling Words

videos.title: Not Again, Please?
videos.overview: It’s an occasion of jubilation and high spirits as everyone gathers for Aditi’s child’s birthday. While Karan realizes that Liz is back with Sameer, she sees that he’s moved on with Anjali.

videos.title: Stuck Like Magna Tiles

videos.title: Masti Ki Internshala
videos.overview: Everyone has a summer internship except for three freshers, Mohit, Prasad and Pandey. In pursuit of excellence, these three idiots learn that the only way to make their CVs impressive is, 'To Lie!'.

videos.title: Startup Karte Hain Bro!

videos.title: Bell Curve ka Ghanta
videos.overview: The ECE department is full of toppers. The class average is reaching sky-high levels. At this point, can the boys welcome two more toppers into their branch?

videos.overview: Pandey and the boys decide to protest against quality of food in the mess. Who will win this game of hunger? Mess Maharaj or The Boys.

videos.overview: Antari and the boys go on a journey of fire and ashes from living happily with cigarettes to endless trials of leaving it. In the process they learn amazing things about themselves.

videos.title: Karwachauth ka Chaand
videos.overview: As outrageous as it may sound, committed people in the campus are observing the traditional festival of Karwachauth. Some will succeed to solidify their bond and some will fail.

videos.overview: As if sending grade reports to home was not enough, Pawan Mishra has scheduled a Parents Teacher Meet. From Mess Maharaj to students everyone struggles to make things right before the parents arrive.

videos.title: Banarasiyaa
videos.overview: After successfully losing the startup competition in the first year, boys decide to give entrepreneurship another go. This time for a more personal cause.

videos.title: RAC Ticket
videos.overview: Valentine's day is around the corner. Couples are struggling to meet each other's expectations. While single males wish they can opt for temporary blindness till these festivities are over.

videos.title: Fest ka Bhokaal!
videos.overview: Mohit and Prasad join the organizing team of the college fest ULLAAS. But a careless mistake jeopardizes the whole fest. With institute reputations at stake can the gang salvage ULLAAS?

videos.title: French Kiss
videos.overview: Shubhra and Antari crack the esteemed Le Sage Scholarship and are shortlisted for a foreign internship in France. Will Nishant and Pandey support their partners and celebrate this victory or become insecure due to the much-hyped libido of French men?

videos.overview: After the plan to buy a kickass electrical model from Kabaadi backfires, boys run around to find a way to score 40 out of 60 in the finals. Without the help of Shubhra and Antari can they do it?

videos.overview: A not-so-willing Arvind Shukla gains admission into Trivenipur University and is favoured by the president of the college for hostel accommodation. Little does he know that he has entered a college known for the political rivalry between two leaders, Bindu Singh and Govind Maurya.

videos.title: Feels Like Hell
videos.overview: Welcomed by the seniors in the traditional manner, Arvind turns the tables and gives them a piece of his mind. From making new friends to understanding the dynamics of college politics, Arvind’s journey has just begun.

videos.title: Say Hello To The Devil
videos.overview: As love begins to bloom for Arvind, he warms up to the place he wasn't keen to set foot on. A man of values, Arvind slowly starts to become a part of the college's political web.

videos.overview: In a fraction of a second, Arvind's life takes a turn when he sees his first love committing suicide because of the humiliation she faces. Her actions were instigated by none other than the college president, Bindu Singh.

videos.title: Everything Is Fair In Love And War
videos.overview: Govind Maurya schemes an alliance with Arvind due to pressure from the higher-ups in the political game. Projected as the reason for his girlfriend’s death, Arvind decides to take revenge on Bindu Singh with the help of Govind and his best friend, Ajay.

videos.title: Welcome To Politics
videos.overview: After Arvind shoots Bindu in his hostel room, Mrityunjay, a police officer, deduces that Bindu's murder was a personal vendetta and decides to destroy Arvind. Meanwhile, Govind Maurya, who has not taken the moves of the political higher-ups kindly, finds the initial seeds of jealousy towards Arvind sown in his mind.

videos.title: Blood Vs Books
videos.overview: Govind capitalises on Bindu's comatose state and threatens the road contractor to give him Bindu's share. Meanwhile, all the forces come together to get Arvind out from jail. Arvind, focusing on studying in jail for his upcoming exams, gets coaxed into meeting a dangerous criminal from Meerut, who becomes his new sworn enemy.

videos.title: What's Brewing?
videos.overview: Arvind’s rising popularity in the university has started to concern Govind, who fears he will end up losing control. Govind decides to take matters into his own hands and destroys the college road but is caught by Mrityunjay. Govind’s impulsive act costs him the power to contest the election as President to none other than Arvind Shukla.

videos.title: Hello I Am Arvind Shukla..REBOOTED

videos.title: Welcome to the Club of Aashiqs

videos.title: Darr Ke Aage Kiss Hai
videos.overview: Ritu joins a coaching class in Bhopal and notices Anuj on the first day. She introduces herself to Anuj, which startles him. He seeks advice from friends on how to impress her. Ritu asks Anuj to help her explore the city but he cancels at the last minute. Anuj writes a love letter and must now confess his feelings to Ritu and pray she feels the same way.

videos.title: Eent Ka Jawab Patthar Se
videos.overview: Ritu unknowingly catches the eye of Samrat, the school's boxing champion. Samrat warns Anuj to back off from Ritu or else there's going to be a fight. Initially, Anuj is scared stiff but soon he realizes that to keep Ritu as his girlfriend and to save his own face, he must prepare for this mano-a-mano showdown. He's gotta fight for his girl. He just doesn't know how.

videos.title: How Well Do You Know Ritu?
videos.overview: Anuj gets prepared to meet Ritu's Gurgaon friends but the whole experience gets sour for him as they end up constantly making fun of him. Ritu tries to console him but they end up arguing and Anuj leaves. What follows is the first major fight between Anuj and Ritu. Will this lead to their break up or will someone apologise for their mistakes?

videos.title: Why Do You Love Me?
videos.overview: Ritu and Anuj plan their first valentine's date but they fear getting caught by the local love-hating political gang. They ask Adi, Umair and Sonal to accompany them for safety. They end up going to a fancy restaurant in Bhopal but the bill is beyond their expectation. Ritu tries to get the money while Anuj is held hostage at the restaurant.

videos.title: Sab Sambhal Lenge
videos.overview: After dating each other for more than six months Anuj and Ritu have to face what the future holds for them. Anuj's mom finds out about the relationship and grounds him completely for his exam preparations. Ritu has an important decision she needs to discuss with him but they have been completely separated by Anuj's mom. Will their relationship stay intact?

videos.title: Will You Be My Sukhi Puri?
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu's relationship faces a challenge when Ritu gets admitted to a college in Ahmedabad. Desperate to follow her, Anuj and his friends try to convince his parents that studying in Ahmedabad is the best move. Unfortunately, Anuj's mother catches on to the plot and discovers that Ritu is also going to Ahmedabad. As Ritu and Anuj prepare for the final goodbye, tensions escalate.

videos.title: Long Distance Wali Gutar Gu
videos.overview: Ritu and Anuj begin their long-distance relationship with caution and sincerity. They set alarms for breakfast, lunch, and dinner to text and call each other, ensuring their 'Gutar Gu' continues. As the pressure of fitting into their respective colleges and pursuing their passion takes a toll on their schedules, Anuj grows anxious about weakening his bond with Ritu.

videos.title: Fresh Friendship Brewing
videos.overview: Shivangi enters the world of Gutar Gu as Anuj's playwright. Little does she know that this play is Anuj's ticket to meeting Ritu in Ahmedabad and she starts to make a move on Anuj and the real test of his fidelity for Ritu begins. Shivangi and Anuj end up in situations that make Ritu question Anuj's loyalty. Anuj comes clean to Ritu but will she forgive and forget this one mistake?

videos.title: Am I Ready Yet?
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu are going to see each other after months of long-distance separation in Ahmedabad. Both are getting unsolicited advice from their respective friends on the possibility of them getting intimate with each other. As Anuj arrives in Ahmedabad, the tension between them begins to build as both try to follow the advice given by their friends.

videos.title: 3,2,1… Happy New Year
videos.overview: Ritu and Anuj have glorious and hopeful New Year's Eve plans, which also include the possibility of Anuj booking a hotel room for them. Ritu takes up an internship where her experience is not what she anticipated. Anuj stands with Ritu like a rock and comforts her. On New Year's Eve, the duo dines together in a unique set-up and we know that long distance has only strengthened their bond.

videos.title: Baat Se Hi Toh Baat Banti Hai
videos.overview: Anuj lands the final audition for a two-season web show and Ritu surprises him in Bhopal and tells him about an upcoming internship opportunity in Mumbai. If Anuj lands the part both can head to Mumbai together. Ritu declines a major internship in Singapore just to be with Anuj in Mumbai but the latter comes out of the audition without appearing for it fearing his parents will never send him.

videos.title: Welcome To Mumbai
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu finally make it to Mumbai to live out their pehla live-in! But the universe, and mummy ji, had other plans. While Anuj juggles auditions and odd hours, his mom’s mostly home, wondering where he is. Just when things couldn’t get messier, Ritu’s apartment ceiling collapse. With no hotel money and no way she's calling her parents, she turns to Anuj for help.

videos.title: Kebab Mein Mummy
videos.overview: With mummy ji still around, things at the flat start getting cramped for our favourite couple. Ritu begins house hunting, accompanied by Anuj’s Mom. Meanwhile, Anuj, desperate to send his mom back to Bhopal, ropes in his crew for a dramatic fake emergency call. These antics make Ritu even more upset, and what follows is Ritu and Anuj’s releaization.

videos.title: Live-in Waali Gutar Gu
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu finally begin living together properly as Anuj’s Mom leaves for Bhopal. They enjoy setting up their home, navigating chores, and bonding over routines. However, differences start surfacing — Anuj’s carelessness and Ritu’s growing professional responsibilities strain their relationship. Ritu starts questioning the emotional balance between love and habit.

videos.title: The First Time
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu plan to get intimate for the first time. When the moment finally arrives, nerves and awkwardness kick in. Things don’t go as expected, leaving both feeling awkward and insecure. As the tension lingers, unspoken insecurities start to creep in, about themselves, and each other. With a little help from unexpected corners, they slowly begin to navigate the messy side of intimacy.

videos.title: Gupt Gyaan 2.0
videos.overview: It’s Anuj’s birthday, and he expects a surprise. But Ritu seems distracted, leading him to feel neglected. Meanwhile, Ritu plans a surprise party with the Bhopal Gang. As the day unfolds, unexpected emotions surface, pushing both Anuj and Ritu to reflect on their future in ways they hadn’t before.

videos.title: Do We Have a Future Together?
videos.overview: The Gutar Gu gang goes on a trekking trip. Amid breathtaking views and playful moments, Anuj and Ritu’s contrasting attitudes about the future emerge. They meet ex-couple trek leaders who broke up over life goals but remain friends. This resonates with Anuj and Ritu, sparking an argument about whether love is enough when ambitions don’t align.

videos.title: Jet Lag

videos.title: Pehli Job, Dusra Pyaar
videos.overview: Tango’s struggles come to an end as he lands his first job. Sajjad’s mysterious meeting goes well. Tango has a crush on Daisy, but it’s only a matter of time before his past catches up.

videos.title: Bus-king
videos.overview: Sajjad and Zareen need to pay their rent and inform Tango about it. Tango asks his shady roommate, Shampy for help and he has a plan. They get into trouble for busking at the Piccadilly circus.

videos.title: Halloween Mubarak

videos.overview: Tango’s visa expires and now he is officially a Kaccha. When Daisy refuses to forgive him, he agrees to Shampy’s scheme – Fake Marriage. Will this scheme help or land him in a bigger mess?

videos.title: Love Bite
videos.overview: A new revelation has Tango angry and happy at the same time. He decides to focus on being happy and visits the bar. A drunk Tango returns home only to be bitten by a venomous spider.

videos.title: The Kaccha Heist
videos.overview: Patel kicks the ‘kacchas’ out of the house and Tango tries to cheer them up. Shampy needs money for his mother’s operation, so the kacchas come together and plan a heist.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Angrezi Mat Jhaad
_verifiedMetadata.description:
Mana English na aane ki wajah se mili hai tumko haar, kabhi nahi kar paaye pyaar ka izhaar aur kabhi gawar keh kar chale gaye dost yaar lekin abh ho jaao taiyyar aur keh do "Angrezi Mat Jhaad"

Featuring Mayur More (also known for his role as Vaibhav in Kota Factory), Deepak Kumar Mishra (well known director of our famous show Panchayat) and Pratish Mehta (popular for for Pandya Vlog)

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hindi section ka star performer Sandeep (Mayur More, who has also worked in Kota Factory) khaa jaata hai Angrezi ke aage maat, lekin sawal yeh hai ki kya uska yeh darr de jaayega usko uske zindagi ki har cheezo mein maat?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: It's time for an office party, Sandeep has come out to break the English wall between himself and Krish! Do you think you will be able to express your feelings?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In the frustration of not knowing English, Sandeep misbehaved in front of Namita because of which he was fined.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sandeep's patience is over, now he is going to start the journey of learning English, but will this path be easy for him!

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Chadha hai Sandeep pe English department mein jaane ka bukhaar lekin uski yeh ichha laa rahi hai office dosti mein daraar. Abh kya Sandeep chhod dega Dost Yaar ya phir Angrezi ka ki thought?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Crimes Aaj Kal
_verifiedMetadata.description: Crimes Aaj Kal is a thrilling web show hosted by Vikrant Massey that showcases the stories of modern-day crimes committed by modern-day criminals, based on true events happening all around the country.

videos.title: Reel Vs Real
videos.overview: Has Aditya really been kidnapped or is he faking it? It’s a reel that reveals the kidnapping. Cops believe Aditya is doing this on purpose it’s fake. Aditya’s girlfriend Monica reveals that he was planning a reel like this. Is it really a Reel or a real kidnapping?

videos.title: The Broken Heart
videos.overview: Francis is threatened to stay away from Sophia. Cops find out he was threatened by Sanjay. 24 year old Sanjay when reached is found murdered. A girl’s photos are found in his room. Is this Sophia? What is the game here? Who killed Sanjay?

videos.title: Kill The Enemy
videos.overview: Abhay is accused of killing his mother and younger brother in cold blood. His father Rakesh doesn’t believe that his Abhay could have done this. Cops have no doubt that it is Abhay. A psychologist comes in to make Abhay speak. Did Abhay committed this crime? If yes, why?

videos.title: The Last Party
videos.overview: Naina, Ronak, Basant, Sandeep, Ashima have come to Goa, for the New Year eve. A party amongst the friends. The Party ends up in the death of Naina. A fall from the balcony. Is it an accidental fall, after getting drunk too much? Or something else?

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Anuj Rawat, commits suicide. His fiance Natasha suspects foul play though cops don’t find any foul play in the suicide. But Natasha’s doubts prove true. Investigation into Anuj’s recent past reveals shocking details. Was it really a suicide? Why?

videos.title: No Way Out
videos.overview: Namrata Wadkar decides to take her own life one afternoon, when her parents are not at home. She would have hung herself by the fan, she has already written the suicide note. But then it’s only her suicide note that has been found. What happened to Namrata?

videos.title: War Of Words
videos.overview: Avantika Gera, 2nd year Computer Engineering student is shot dead in broad daylight in Pune. Her one sided lover and a local politician’s son Vikas Naik and her boy-friend Sunil are in dock. Who killed Avantika and why?

videos.title: The Scapegoat
videos.overview: 7 year old Prithvi is dropped by his cousin Navin for Prithvi’s maths tuition outside the house of the teacher, Shankar Nagar. But Shankar claims Prithvi didn’t come for tuitions at all that day. Where would a 7 year old child disappear?

videos.title: The Missing Links
videos.overview: 18 year old Geeta Singh, in Jodhpur, leaves home, leaving behind a note that she is going with someone she loves and wants to start a new life. Could she fulfil her wish? What happened to her? Similar to Inspector rishi

videos.title: Pursuit Of Desire
videos.overview: Sumit, a class 8 student, fights with his parents everyday wanting a mobile phone. His parents have made it clear to him that he will get it only after 10th standard. One day Sumit goes out and doesn’t return back home. Where is Sumit? What happened to him? Like Mirzapur

videos.title: The Vicious Circle
videos.overview: Prajakta Tiwari, a missing saleswoman, entangled in a mysterious love story with Vaibhav Prasad. Surveillance reveals Vaibhav's connection to Rashmi Kushwaha, whose tragic suicide sparks questions. Was it a love triangle, jealousy, or a sinister plot? Uncover the secrets in this gripping tale of passion and deceit.

videos.title: Dangerous Pursuits
videos.overview: In a tale of love, betrayal, and a mysterious murder, a past incident resurfaces. A web of secrets connects Nazneen, Anwar, and a businessman's demise. As the plot unfolds, motives blur, leaving questions about innocence and revenge. Uncover the truth in this gripping narrative.

videos.title: Murder Most Foul
videos.overview: In the Mumbai corporate office's sinister depths, techie Sneha, 26, meets a chilling end. Amidst workplace rivalries, the murder weapon's mysterious entry stirs intrigue. Raghav, Vinita, and Ashutosh emerge as suspects, each harboring secrets. The plot thickens with a love triangle, a one-sided obsession, and a shocking revelation about Sneha's friend, Maira. What was the motive?

videos.title: Suppressed Anger
videos.overview: Prakash Munjal, a transport company owner in Bhopal, and his wife Savita meet a grim fate. Daughters point fingers at cousins and a tech prodigy from Pune. Dark family secrets surface, but the true orchestrator remains concealed. Who's the puppet master behind this labyrinth of betrayals? Like Mirzapur

videos.title: Gone Too Far
videos.overview: 24 year old Shilpa Goradia, finds a newborn baby girl, murdered and abandoned near her house. Cops Feel that Shilpa is not telling the entire truth. What is the truth?

videos.title: Gone Girl
videos.overview: Sanjana Doshi, a 23-year-old student attending college in London, has ceased communication with her uncle, Rajesh Doshi, and aunt, Bhavna Doshi, residing in Anand, Gujarat. Has an unforeseen event occurred to her?

videos.title: Whispers of Fate
videos.overview: Swati Kanwar, a 21-year-old, has gone missing, yet her family hesitates to file a formal missing person report. Concerned friends of Swati turn to the police, urging them to uncover the truth behind her disappearance. Where has Swati vanished to?

videos.title: The Vanishing
videos.overview: 21 year old Suyash Kolhe, a 2nd year engineering student, in Pune, goes missing. Suyash stays with his sister, Mansi (19) years old, also a student. They both stay on rent in a small flat. The strongest suspicion is on Mansi, who is having an affair with a guy Anand and Suyash was opposed to it. But if it's a forced disappearance, then where are the signs of it?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Hunter - Tootega Nahi, Todega
_verifiedMetadata.description: Hunter is an action thriller web series that follows Suniel Shetty as ACP Vikram in his journey to the dark alleys of Mumbai's crime world. A mission to find a missing woman leads him juggling between his past and future.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Baalveer
_verifiedMetadata.description: Returning for Season 3, Baalveer, a young superhero who fights evil forces with his magical powers and protects children from harm, is unaware of his scheming superiors' plan to betray him. Stripped of his powers and identity, he leads a mundane life until an unexpected event reignites his abilities. With help from Kaashvi, a girl he partners up with, he embarks on a journey to reclaim his powers and identity while battling his enemies. Will Baalveer become the ultimate hero he once was?

videos.title: Baalveer Ki Entry
videos.overview: Everyone is looking for Baalveer in Udaka Lok. Baalveer's grand entry amazes his friends.

videos.title: Baalveer Kasam Kaal
videos.overview: Baalveer passes the test given to him by Maha Mahi Mutaan. Baalveer is confident that he will be able to face and defeat the evil Aageel. Will Baalveer's confidence prove to be his downfall?

videos.title: Kaashvi's Life In Danger
videos.overview: Aageel abducts Kaashvi to retrieve the Maha Jadoo. Baalveer tries to save a cable car from falling off a cliff. Meanwhile, Maha Mahi Uttan talks to Adishi about Baalveer's antics.

videos.title: Baalveer Ki Kasam
videos.overview: Aageel abducts Kaashvi to retrieve the Maha Jadoo. Baalveer tries to save a cable car from falling off a cliff. Meanwhile, Maha Mahi Uttan talks to Adishi about Baalveer's antics.

videos.title: Baalveer The Protector
videos.overview: Baalveer reads out the rules of Shashvan Lok and pledges to protect the Earth, humanity and the Universe. Kaashvi’s parents decide to go to Imbaash Lok together to save Kaashvi. Will they make it out alive?

videos.title: Baalveer Ka Suraksha Kavach
videos.overview: Aageel sends her henchmen to find Kaashvi and bring her back alive. Maha Mahi Uttan gives magical armour to Baalveer to protect him from Aageel's Maha Jadoo. Meanwhile, Kaashvi's mother sacrifices all of her magical powers in order to protect her daughter. What will happen now?

videos.title: Baalveer Ka Faisla
videos.overview: Shashmaagh urges Uttan to arrest Baalveer and punish him for harming innocent people. Meanwhile, Aageel comes up with a vicious plan to lure Baalveer into her trap.

videos.title: Baalveer Faces A Trial
videos.overview: Shashmaagh presses charges against Baalveer for the loss of innocent lives. Aageel realises she won't be able to extract what she needs from Dharti Lok without making a few sacrifices.

videos.title: Accha Jadoo Aur Bura Jadoo
videos.overview: Aageel wants to prevent Baalveer from meeting Kaashvi. Baalveer goes to Dharti Lok to find the reason behind Tuer’s death. Meanwhile, Aageel finds a way to destroy Baalveer through Kaashvi. Will Aageel succeed in her mission?

videos.title: Aageel In Udaka Lok
videos.overview:
10. Aageel In Udaka Lok

FULL_HD124 mins16 Apr 2023

Uttan wants to take Baalveer’s power without killing him. Aageel goes to Udaka Lok to take her Maha Jadoo from Kaashvi. Later, Uttan and Shashmaagh attack Baalveer and capture him.

videos.title: Udaka Lok Ki Deewar
videos.overview: Baalveer decides to leave Udaka Lok and continue his duties of protecting the world from somewhere else. However, Shashmaagh takes Adishi hostage, which compels Baalveer to return.

videos.title: Baalveer Zinda Hai
videos.overview: Bardol tries to commit suicide because he thinks he has been discovered by one of his enemies, but Bhaskar stops him. Later, Tetra and Andher inform Aageel that Baalveer is alive and stop her from attacking Shashvan Lok.

videos.title: Baalveer On Dharti Lok
videos.overview: Andher suggests that Aageel shouldn’t go to Dharti Lok. Later, Maha Mahim asks Bardol to find a place for Baalveer on Dharti Lok which only he would know about.

videos.title: Baalveer's Family Time
videos.overview: Awaiting his trial, Baalveer spends quality time with his family. Meanwhile, Aageel sends a beacon to locate her Maha Jadoo.

videos.title: Baalveer's Real Identity
videos.overview: Maha Mahim gives magical pills to Bardol to control Baalveer's anger. Eva and Navya throw a party to thank Baalveer for saving their lives, while Bardol and Bhaskar try to prevent Baalveer from remembering his real identity.

videos.title: Baalveer Shaant Ho Gaya Hai
videos.overview: Baalveer is attacked and becomes unconscious before his memory returns. While Kaashvi reunites with her mother, Aageel waits for her plan to bear fruit. Will Kaashvi be a victim of Aageel's magic?

videos.title: Kaashvi Ka Naya Roop
videos.overview: Kaashvi attacks a few goons who tease her. Bardol tells Bhaskar that extremely new powerful magic has been activated on Dharti Lok, and Baalveer is not safe anymore. Meanwhile, Baalveer gets attacked. What will happen now?

videos.title: The Plan To Poison Baalveer
videos.overview: While the plan to poison Baalveer is set into motion, his mother gets worried about Baalveer's safety. Later, Baalveer is handed over the spiked drink. Will Baalveer be poisoned to death?

videos.title: Aageel On Dharti Lok
videos.overview: Bardol informs Maha Mahim that Aageel has come to Dharti Lok. Shashmaag plays a trick on Aageel. Later, someone steals Tetra and Andher’s magic while Maha Mahim punishes Shashmaag for stealing the poison that can kill Baalveer.

videos.title: Shashmaag Ka Sauda
videos.overview: Aageel is conflicted and decides to talk to Shashmaag, who has an enticing offer for her. Meanwhile, Kaashvi is in danger of being assassinated. Later, Aageel reaches Chambal Lok to meet with Shashmaag. What happens next?

videos.title: Aageel Meets Veer
videos.overview: Aageel runs away from Shashmaag and Uttan. Andher and Tetra inform Aageel that they have found Baalveer on Dharti Lok. Later, Aageel disguises himself as a human and meets Baalveer.

videos.title: Dhokebaaz Shashmaag
videos.overview: Aageel reaches Veer's residence and wonders why he did not recognise her. Meanwhile, Shashmaag gets blackmailed. Later, on Aageel's orders, Veer's family is attacked. Will Aageel's plan to resurface Baalveer succeed?

videos.title: Black Box Ka Footage
videos.overview: Shashmaag opens the black box and reviews the footage that clearly shows him at fault. Meanwhile, Baalveer's mother tip-toes behind Shashmaag and realises that he had framed Baalveer. How will this latest revelation affect the situation?

videos.title: Baalveer's Mother In Danger
videos.overview: Aageel takes Bardol to Imbaash Lok. Baalveer puts on a magic show for his family members. Later, Shashmaag tortures Baalveer’s mother. Will Baalveer come to save his mother?

videos.title: Jadui Swagat
videos.overview: Kaashvi misses her mother. Meanwhile, Baalveer welcomes the boss of the event company, Kiara in a magical way. Later, Baalveer sings a song to impress Kiara. Will Baalveer's efforts bear any fruit?

videos.title: Aageel Arrives To Kill Veer
videos.overview: Shashmaag tortures Baalveer's mother. While Veer is in the middle of showing a magic trick, Aageel arrives to kill him. On seeing Kaashvi there, Aageel decides to kill her as well. Will Aageel succeed?

videos.title: Baalveer's Memory
videos.overview: Maha Jadoo starts giving Baalveer power and he takes his original form. Aageel and Baalveer fight each other. Later, Baalveer finds his poster and tries to remember his identity.

videos.title: Baalveer Ke Liye Sandesh
videos.overview: Aageel plan to use Bardol to take out Maha Jadoo from Kaashvi. Later, Shashmaag shows Maha Mahim the proof that he had tampered with to make Maha Mahim believe that Baalveer deserves punishment. Later, Aageel calls Khirjoj to help her with Maha Jadoo.

videos.title: Baalveer Ke Mann Ke Sawal
videos.overview: Navya starts speaking and Baalveer realises he has powers. Shashvan Lok's army enters Imbaash Lok. Later, Aageel asks Bardol to send a safe signal to Shashvan Lok.

videos.title: Baalveer In His Original Form
videos.overview: Baalveer saves a kid’s life and finds out he has magical powers. Later, Aageel tells Kaashvi the truth about her mother.

videos.title: Powerful Kaashvi
videos.overview: Benaam tells her story to Baalveer and asks him for his help. Kaashvi beats Khirjoj. Later, Aageel decides to turn Kaashvi into a stone.

videos.title: Baalveer Ka Magic Touch
videos.overview: Baalveer tries to stop his parents from finding out about his truth. Bardol decides to help Aageel in order to save his own life. Meanwhile, Maha Mahim sends his agents to Earth to bring Baalveer back.

videos.title: Bardol Is Missing
videos.overview: Bardol begs for forgiveness from Aageel as Aageel decides to turn him to stone. Baalveer wonders where his real mother is. Later, two people from Shashvan Lok come to Dharti Lok to look for Bardol.

videos.title: Baalveer Ki Yadash
videos.overview: Baalveer remembers everything. Benaam asks Baalveeer to save her and her people. Later, Aageel decides to use ‘Lal Darwaza’ to destroy Baalveer.

videos.title: Control Kaashvi
videos.overview: Baalveer decides to leave his house on Dharti Lok. Aageel enters the ‘Lal Darwaza’ and finds a way to destroy Baalveer. Later, Baalveer’s family thinks he got into an accident.

videos.title: Dosti Ho Toh Aisi
videos.overview: Kinkori and Dilak put Baalveer in handcuffs. Later, Kinkori and Dilak hide Baaleer from Shaashmagh. Meanwhile, Aageel plans to control Kaashvi through Maha Jadoo inside her.

videos.title: Kaashvi Ka Pehla Jurm
videos.overview: Shashmaag finds out that Baalveer is looking for his mother. Kaashvi steals an expensive goddess statue from Baalveer’s house. Later, Shashmaag captures Baalveer.

videos.title: Kaashvi's Jealousy
videos.overview: Kinkori tries to protect Baalveer. Maha Mahin asks Shashmaag about Adishi’s whereabouts. Later, Kaashvi commits another sin.

videos.title: Kaashvi Ke Andar Ka Maha Jadoo
videos.overview: Kaashvi saves a girl from getting involved in an accident. However, it becomes increasingly challenging for Kaashvi to control the immense power of the Maha Jadoo within her. Meanwhile, Shashmaag traps Baalveer in a cage. How will Baalveer manage to escape?

videos.title: Maha Mahim And Shashmaag's Trap
videos.overview: Despite Baalveer's attempts to establish communication with his mother, he encounters difficulties. Maha Mahim and Shashmaag conspire to deceive Baalveer as part of their plan to capture him. Will Baalveer succumb to their trap?

videos.title: Baalveer Fights Maha Mahim
videos.overview: Baalveer choses to fight Maha Mahim as an intense battle ensues. Meanwhile, Aageel follows up on her evil plans and hypnotises Kaashvi.

videos.title: Maha Jaadu Ki Aag
videos.overview: Baalveer's family is worried about him performing his new fire act as they are worried about his safety. Meanwhile, Aageel continues to hypnotise Kaashvi and plans on ruining Baalveer's show by replacing the fire with her magical fire.

videos.title: Aageel Controls Kaashvi
videos.overview: Aageel uses her magic to control Kaashvi as Baalveer prepares for his fire show. Meanwhile, Shashmaagh tries to steal from Uttan.

videos.title: Baalveer Ka Jadui Show
videos.overview: Shashmaag takes Kurja’s help while Aageel asks Kaashvi to kill Baalveer. Later, Benaam asks Baalveer not to use his magical powers in the magic show. What will he do now?

videos.title: The Fire Show
videos.overview: Dilak and Konkori find Baalveer’s mother in a cave. Shashmaag decides to put Kurja’s soul in Baalveer’s mother’s body. Later, Baalveer lights himself on fire.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Happy Family, Conditions Apply
_verifiedMetadata.description: Meet the Dholakias, a family of four generations living under one roof, as they navigate the ups and downs of their lives. While they appear to be picture perfect, they are endearingly, heartbreakingly human, each with their unique quirks and quibbles. Follow their journey as they try their best to navigate through all the things life throws at them.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Chashni
_verifiedMetadata.description: An untoward incident mars the loving relationship between two sisters- Chandni and Roshni. Years later, fate brings them face to face only to find out that they are daughter-in-law and mother-in-law for each other. Thus, begins a typical saas-bahu saga.

videos.title: Chandni, Roshni's Tale Begins
videos.overview: Chandni and Roshni's lives are full of hardships due to Sanjay's work rivalry. While Chandni chooses to make him proud, Roshni is the polar opposite.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Taj: Divided by Blood
_verifiedMetadata.description: In his quest to find a worthy successor for his grand legacy, Emperor Akbar sparks a war among his sons. What follows is a terrifying battle for power, filled with politics, betrayals, and bloodshed.
